creators.bio_zh: 同济大学设计创意学院的学生团队，参加了让艺术设计学生与生物学家合作的国际竞赛 Biodesign Challenge。指导教师包括周洪涛、任丽莎与 Francesca Valsecchi。
creators.why_zh: 它的获奖学生项目展示了设计学院如何与活体生物和生物技术合作。

creators.name: Liv Bargman
creators.role: Designer; Central Saint Martins MA Material Futures alumna
creators.bio: Liv Bargman is a London designer who works with biology and speculative material futures; with Nina Cutler she won the 2017 Biodesign Challenge with Quantworm Mine.
creators.why: Her work frames soil animals as industrial partners and asks what a post-extractive industry could look like.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；中央圣马丁 Material Futures 硕士
creators.bio_zh: Liv Bargman 是伦敦的设计师，关注生物学与思辨材料未来；2017 年她与 Nina Cutler 以 Quantworm Mine 获得 Biodesign Challenge 总冠军。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品把土壤动物设想为工业伙伴，追问“后开采”工业会是什么样子。

creators.name: Nina Cutler
creators.role: Designer; Central Saint Martins MA Material Futures alumna
creators.bio: Nina Cutler is a designer who co-created Quantworm Mine, the 2017 Biodesign Challenge overall winner, at Central Saint Martins.
creators.why: Co-author of one of the best-known speculative biodesign projects about bioremediation.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；中央圣马丁 Material Futures 硕士
creators.bio_zh: Nina Cutler 是设计师，在中央圣马丁与 Liv Bargman 共同创作了 2017 年 Biodesign Challenge 总冠军作品 Quantworm Mine。
creators.why_zh: 一个关于生物修复的知名思辨生物设计项目的共同作者。

creators.name: Anna Budnikova
creators.role: Architect and designer; HSE Graduate School of Urbanism alumna
creators.bio: Anna Budnikova is an architect who developed Mycokarst, a fungal biomineralisation proposal for karst sinkholes, which won Outstanding Science at the 2019 Biodesign Challenge.
creators.why: Shows biodesign working at the scale of landscape and geology.
creators.role_zh: 建筑师、设计师；莫斯科高等经济大学城市规划研究生院
creators.bio_zh: Anna Budnikova 是建筑师，她的 Mycokarst 提出用真菌矿化来加固喀斯特塌陷区，获得 2019 年 Biodesign Challenge 杰出科学奖。
creators.why_zh: 展示了生物设计在地景与地质尺度上的作用。

creators.name: Marley E. Townsend
creators.bio: Marley E. Townsend is an artist whose data and genetic portrait The Other Townsend won Outstanding Social Critique at the 2019 Biodesign Challenge.
creators.why: Brings critique of biological data collection into biodesign.
creators.bio_zh: Marley E. Townsend 是艺术家，她用数据和基因信息绘制的肖像 The Other Townsend 获得 2019 年 Biodesign Challenge 杰出社会批判奖。
creators.why_zh: 把对生物数据采集的批判带入生物设计。

creators.name: Camila Wandemberg
creators.role: Designer; California College of the Arts alumna
creators.bio: Camila Wandemberg is an Ecuadorian designer whose algae-filter face masks were Runner-Up at the 2020 Biodesign Challenge.
creators.why: A low-cost, home-made use of algae in a public-health emergency.
creators.bio_zh: Camila Wandemberg 是厄瓜多尔设计师，她的藻类滤芯口罩获得 2020 年 Biodesign Challenge 亚军。
creators.why_zh: 在公共卫生紧急状态中低成本、可在家制作地使用藻类。
creators.based_zh: 基多，厄瓜多尔 / 旧金山，美国

creators.name: Zahra Jajarmikhayat
creators.role: Designer; California College of the Arts alumna
creators.bio: Zahra Jajarmikhayat is a designer whose lemon-rind mosquito nets were Runner-Up at the 2022 Biodesign Challenge.
creators.why: Uses a plant's own chemistry as the functional part of a material.
creators.bio_zh: Zahra Jajarmikhayat 是设计师，她用柠檬皮制作的蚊帐获得 2022 年 Biodesign Challenge 亚军。
creators.why_zh: 把植物自身的化学成分变成材料的功能部分。

creators.name: Keer Hu
creators.role: Designer; Tongji University College of Design and Innovation
creators.bio: Keer Hu is a Shanghai designer who, with Shuo Yuan, created Power Mutualism, a cyanobacteria wearable that won Outstanding Science at the 2022 Biodesign Challenge and the 2021 James Dyson Award in mainland China.
creators.why: Designs a mutualistic energy loop between a human body and photosynthetic microbes.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；同济大学设计创意学院
creators.bio_zh: 胡可儿（Keer Hu）是上海的设计师，与袁硕共同设计了蓝藻可穿戴装置 Power Mutualism，获得 2022 年 Biodesign Challenge 杰出科学奖和 2021 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖中国大陆赛区冠军。
creators.why_zh: 在人体与光合微生物之间设计了一个互利共生的能量循环。

creators.name: Brad Hakes
creators.role: Artist; The University of Texas at Austin
creators.bio: Brad Hakes is an artist whose Orbweaver interventions about living with spiders were Runner-Up at the 2023 Biodesign Challenge.
creators.why: Turns a personal phobia into a multispecies design experiment.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校
creators.bio_zh: Brad Hakes 是艺术家，他关于与蜘蛛共处的系列干预作品 Orbweaver 获得 2023 年 Biodesign Challenge 亚军。
creators.why_zh: 把个人恐惧变成一次多物种设计实验。

creators.name: Melissa Ortiz
creators.role: Designer; California College of the Arts
creators.bio: Melissa Ortiz is a designer whose citizen-science water-testing tool Colores del Rio won Outstanding Social Critique at the 2023 Biodesign Challenge.
creators.why: Uses plant pigments to put river monitoring in young people's hands.
creators.bio_zh: Melissa Ortiz 是设计师，她的公民科学水质检测工具 Colores del Rio 获得 2023 年 Biodesign Challenge 杰出社会批判奖。
creators.why_zh: 用植物色素把河流监测交到年轻人手里。

creators.name: Leo Roth
creators.role: Student designer, Rye Country Day School
creators.bio: Leo Roth is a high-school designer whose PolyNation artificial flowers for pollinators was a top-8 finalist at the 2024 Biodesign Challenge.
creators.why: Designs infrastructure for insects rather than for people.
creators.role_zh: 学生设计师，Rye Country Day School
creators.bio_zh: Leo Roth 是一名高中生设计师，他为传粉者设计的人造花 PolyNation 入围 2024 年 Biodesign Challenge 前八名。
creators.why_zh: 为昆虫而不是为人设计基础设施。

creators.name: Jonah Goodman
creators.bio: Jonah Goodman is a designer whose kombucha-cellulose wound dressing ECO-SKIN won Outstanding Science at the 2025 Biodesign Challenge.
creators.why: Grows a medical material with a kitchen fermentation culture.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；帕森斯设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Jonah Goodman 是设计师，他用康普茶细菌纤维素制作的伤口敷料 ECO-SKIN 获得 2025 年 Biodesign Challenge 杰出科学奖。
creators.why_zh: 用厨房发酵菌种生长出医用材料。

creators.name: Karolina Sulich
creators.bio: Karolina Sulich is a designer whose community LAMP biosensor for heavy metals in the Gowanus Canal was a top-8 finalist at the 2025 Biodesign Challenge.
creators.why: Brings DNA-based environmental sensing to citizen scientists.
creators.bio_zh: Karolina Sulich 是设计师，她为戈瓦纳斯运河设计的社区重金属 LAMP 生物传感器入围 2025 年 Biodesign Challenge 前八名。
creators.why_zh: 把基于 DNA 的环境检测交给公民科学家。

creators.name: Etsuko Yakushimaru
creators.bio: Etsuko Yakushimaru is a Japanese pop musician and artist who works across songs, instruments, satellites and biotechnology; she leads the band Soutaiseiriron.
creators.why: Her I'm Humanity stored a pop song in the genome of a living bacterium, making DNA a medium for music.
creators.bio_zh: やくしまるえつこ（药师丸悦子）是日本流行音乐人和艺术家，作品横跨歌曲、乐器、卫星与生物技术，也是乐队“相对性理论”的核心成员。
creators.why_zh: 她的《わたしは人類》把一首流行歌写进活细菌的基因组，让 DNA 成为音乐的媒介。

creators.name: Olga Kisseleva
creators.bio: Olga Kisseleva is a Russian-born French artist who works with scientists on trees, plants and ecological data, including the long-running EDEN project.
creators.why: She treats trees as partners with rights and voices, and uses biotechnology to help endangered species.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；巴黎第一大学（索邦）教授
creators.bio_zh: Olga Kisseleva 是出生于俄罗斯的法国艺术家，长期与科学家合作研究树木、植物和生态数据，代表作是持续多年的 EDEN 项目。
creators.why_zh: 她把树视为拥有权利和声音的伙伴，并借助生物技术帮助濒危物种。

creators.name: FluidSolids
creators.bio: FluidSolids AG develops a biocomposite made from by-products of renewable raw materials that can be processed like plastic.
creators.why: Turns organic waste streams into an industrial-scale alternative to plastic.
creators.role_zh: 瑞士生物复合材料公司
creators.bio_zh: FluidSolids AG 研发一种以可再生原料副产物制成、可像塑料一样加工的生物复合材料。
creators.why_zh: 把有机废物流变成工业规模的塑料替代品。

creators.name: Avril Corroon
creators.bio: Avril Corroon is an Irish artist whose installations use moulds, fermentation and food to address housing and labour.
creators.why: She makes the mould of rented homes into a material of political critique.
creators.bio_zh: Avril Corroon 是爱尔兰艺术家，她的装置借助霉菌、发酵和食物来探讨住房与劳动问题。
creators.why_zh: 她把出租屋里的霉菌变成政治批判的材料。

creators.name: Sorawut Kittibanthorn
creators.bio: Sorawut Kittibanthorn is a Thai designer working on food systems and waste streams.
creators.why: His feather-to-food project questions what counts as edible in industrial meat production.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；埃因霍温设计学院毕业
creators.bio_zh: Sorawut Kittibanthorn 是泰国设计师，关注食物系统与废弃物流。
creators.why_zh: 他把羽毛变成食物的项目，追问工业化肉类生产中什么算是可食用的。
creators.based_zh: 埃因霍温，荷兰 / 泰国

creators.name: Yuning Chan
creators.role: Designer (Project Habitate, with Tom Hartley and Yishan Qin)
creators.bio: Yuning Chan is a designer who, with Tom Hartley and Yishan Qin, created Project Habitate, a living wearable that hosts species displaced by ash dieback.
creators.why: Proposes humans as hosts and caretakers of other species.
creators.role_zh: 设计师（与 Tom Hartley、Yishan Qin 共同创作 Project Habitate）
creators.bio_zh: Yuning Chan 是设计师，与 Tom Hartley、Yishan Qin 共同创作了 Project Habitate——一件为白蜡树枯梢病中失去栖息地的物种提供居所的活体可穿戴装置。
creators.why_zh: 提出让人类成为其他物种的宿主与照料者。

creators.name: Joana Moll
creators.bio: Joana Moll is an artist whose work examines the material and ecological costs of digital technologies.
creators.why: She connects the growth of computing to the loss of other living species.
creators.bio_zh: Joana Moll 是艺术家，研究数字技术的物质与生态代价。
creators.why_zh: 她把计算的增长与其他物种的消失联系起来。
creators.based_zh: 巴塞罗那，西班牙 / 柏林，德国

creators.name: Zhang Tianyi
creators.bio: Zhang Tianyi is a Chinese artist working on ecological art and plant intelligence.
creators.why: His Plant Intelligence Plan restores relationships between crops and animals rather than landscapes.
creators.bio_zh: 张天一是中国艺术家，关注生态艺术与植物智能。
creators.why_zh: 他的“植物智能计划”修复的是作物与动物之间的关系，而不是地景本身。

creators.name: Helena Nikonole
creators.bio: Helena Nikonole is a new-media artist working with AI, bio art and DIY biotechnology.
creators.why: Treats the skin microbiome as an interface between species.
creators.bio_zh: Helena Nikonole 是新媒体艺术家，创作涉及人工智能、生物艺术和 DIY 生物技术。
creators.why_zh: 把皮肤微生物组视为物种之间的界面。

creators.name: Jakob Kukula
creators.bio: Jakob Kukula is a Berlin designer who created SpreeBerlin, a sensing buoy and platform that gives the river Spree a public voice.
creators.why: Gives a river a political voice through data.
creators.bio_zh: Jakob Kukula 是柏林设计师，创作了 SpreeBerlin——一个让施普雷河拥有公共发声渠道的传感浮标与平台。
creators.why_zh: 借助数据赋予一条河流政治声音。

creators.name: Sarah Selby
creators.bio: Sarah Selby is a British artist working with DNA data storage and critical technology.
creators.why: Uses synthetic DNA to carry human stories into bureaucratic systems.
creators.bio_zh: Sarah Selby 是英国艺术家，创作涉及 DNA 数据存储与批判性技术。
creators.why_zh: 用合成 DNA 把个人故事带入官僚系统。

creators.name: Cooking Sections
creators.role: Spatial practice (Daniel Fernández Pascual and Alon Schwabe)
creators.bio: Cooking Sections is a London-based duo that examines the systems that organise the world through food, using installation, performance and site-specific interventions.
creators.why: Their CLIMAVORE diet adapts eating to climate change and repairs habitats.
creators.role_zh: 空间实践工作室（Daniel Fernández Pascual 与 Alon Schwabe）
creators.bio_zh: Cooking Sections 是伦敦的双人组合，通过装置、表演和在地干预，研究以食物组织世界的各种系统。
creators.why_zh: 他们的 CLIMAVORE 饮食让饮食方式适应气候变化并修复栖息地。

creators.name: Camila Marambio
creators.bio: Camila Marambio is a Chilean curator who founded Ensayos, a nomadic research programme on the ecology of Tierra del Fuego, and curated the Chilean Pavilion Turba Tol Hol-Hol Tol.
creators.why: Links peatland conservation with Selk'nam culture and art.
creators.bio_zh: Camila Marambio 是智利策展人，创办了研究火地岛生态的游牧式研究项目 Ensayos，并策划了智利馆《Turba Tol Hol-Hol Tol》。
creators.why_zh: 把泥炭地保护与塞尔克南文化和艺术联系在一起。

creators.name: Vasily Sitnikov
creators.bio: Vasily Sitnikov is an architect who develops ice formwork for casting concrete, including façades that host plants, insects and birds.
creators.why: Designs building skins as habitat for other species.
creators.bio_zh: Vasily Sitnikov 是建筑师，研发用冰作模板浇筑混凝土的工艺，包括能容纳植物、昆虫和鸟类的立面。
creators.why_zh: 把建筑表皮设计成其他物种的栖息地。

creators.name: Marina Otero Verzier
creators.bio: Marina Otero Verzier is a Spanish architect whose research addresses data infrastructure, extraction and care.
creators.why: Couples the heat of computing with living decomposers.
creators.bio_zh: Marina Otero Verzier 是西班牙建筑师，研究数据基础设施、资源开采与照护。
creators.why_zh: 把计算产生的热与活的分解者耦合起来。
creators.based_zh: 马德里，西班牙 / 鹿特丹，荷兰

creators.name: Marco Barotti
creators.bio: Marco Barotti is an Italian media artist whose sound sculptures respond to environmental data and ecosystems.
creators.why: Uses sound as a tool for restoring reefs, not only for representing them.
creators.bio_zh: Marco Barotti 是意大利媒体艺术家，他的声音雕塑对环境数据和生态系统作出回应。
creators.why_zh: 把声音当作修复珊瑚礁的工具，而不只是表现它们的手段。

creators.name: Christopher Bellamy
creators.bio: Christopher Bellamy is a British biodesigner who develops living materials with bioluminescent microalgae.
creators.why: Makes living light materials that survive on sunlight alone.
creators.role_zh: 生物设计师；Biocrafted 创始人
creators.bio_zh: Christopher Bellamy 是英国生物设计师，研发含有发光微藻的活体材料。
creators.why_zh: 制作仅靠阳光就能存活的活体发光材料。

creators.name: Erzë Dinarama
creators.bio: Erzë Dinarama is a Kosovar artist whose research-based works deal with water, drought and the politics of ecological thresholds.
creators.why: Stages communication between aquatic insects to make drought legible.
creators.bio_zh: Erzë Dinarama 是科索沃艺术家，以研究为基础的作品关注水、干旱以及生态阈值的政治。
creators.why_zh: 通过呈现水生昆虫之间的交流，让干旱变得可被感知。
creators.based_zh: 都灵，意大利 / 科索沃

creators.name: Paola Torres Núñez del Prado
creators.bio: Paola Torres Núñez del Prado is a Peruvian artist who combines textiles, sound and technology, drawing on Andean knowledge systems.
creators.why: Her textiles sense and sing through living lichens.
creators.bio_zh: Paola Torres Núñez del Prado 是秘鲁艺术家，结合纺织、声音与技术，并借鉴安第斯知识体系。
creators.why_zh: 她的织物借助活地衣感知并“歌唱”。
creators.based_zh: 斯德哥尔摩，瑞典 / 秘鲁

creators.name: Rimini Protokoll
creators.role: Theatre collective (Helgard Haug, Stefan Kaegi, Daniel Wetzel)
creators.bio: Rimini Protokoll is a theatre collective known for documentary and participatory works; Holy Shit was made by Stefan Kaegi with Caroline Barneaud.
creators.why: Brings the human microbiome onto the stage as a co-author of identity.
creators.role_zh: 剧场团体（Helgard Haug、Stefan Kaegi、Daniel Wetzel）
creators.bio_zh: Rimini Protokoll 是以纪实和参与式作品闻名的剧场团体；《Holy Shit》由 Stefan Kaegi 与 Caroline Barneaud 创作。
creators.why_zh: 把人体微生物组作为“身份的共同作者”搬上舞台。

creators.name: Yumi Sasaki
creators.bio: Yumi Sasaki is a Japanese artist who with Dorita Takido created Bug's Beat, which lets people hear and feel an insect's footsteps.
creators.why: Shifts human scale to meet an insect's world.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家（与 Dorita Takido 合作）
creators.bio_zh: 佐佐木有美（Yumi Sasaki）是日本艺术家，与 Dorita Takido 共同创作了《Bug's Beat》，让人听到并感受到昆虫的脚步声。
creators.why_zh: 改变人的尺度感，去接近昆虫的世界。

creators.name: AMAM
creators.bio: AMAM is a Tokyo design collective (Kosuke Araki, Noriaki Maetani, Akira Muraoka) that won the 2016 Lexus Design Award Grand Prix with Agar Plasticity.
creators.why: Showed how a familiar Japanese food ingredient from seaweed could replace plastic packaging.
creators.bio_zh: AMAM 是东京的设计团体（荒木宏介、前谷典昭、村冈明），以 Agar Plasticity 获得 2016 年雷克萨斯设计奖大奖。
creators.why_zh: 展示了一种来自海藻、日本人熟悉的食材如何替代塑料包装。

creators.name: Takuma Yamazaki
creators.role: Designer; Lexus Design Award 2016 panel finalist
creators.bio: Takuma Yamazaki is a Japanese designer whose Bio-Vide leaf-litter material was a 2016 Lexus Design Award finalist.
creators.why: Treats seasonal leaf litter as a renewable material.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；2016 年雷克萨斯设计奖入围者
creators.bio_zh: 山崎拓马是日本设计师，他用落叶制作的材料 Bio-Vide 入围 2016 年雷克萨斯设计奖。
creators.why_zh: 把季节性落叶视为可再生材料。

creators.name: Paul & Garrett Sutherlin Santo
creators.bio: Paul and Garrett Sutherlin Santo are designers who combine natural biopolymers with digital fabrication; their Biocraft was a 2020 Lexus Design Award finalist.
creators.why: Designs printed objects that take up CO2 and feed soil as they degrade.
creators.bio_zh: Paul 与 Garrett Sutherlin Santo 是设计师，把天然生物聚合物与数字制造结合；他们的 Biocraft 入围 2020 年雷克萨斯设计奖。
creators.why_zh: 设计在降解时吸收二氧化碳、滋养土壤的打印物件。

creators.name: Hyunseok An
creators.role: Designer; Rhode Island School of Design
creators.bio: Hyunseok An is a Korean designer whose domestic microalgae farm Coral was a 2020 Lexus Design Award finalist.
creators.why: Makes growing algae as ordinary as keeping potted herbs.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；罗德岛设计学院
creators.bio_zh: 安贤锡是韩国设计师，他的家用微藻培养装置 Coral 入围 2020 年雷克萨斯设计奖。
creators.why_zh: 让养藻像种盆栽香草一样平常。
creators.based_zh: 普罗维登斯，美国 / 韩国

creators.name: Chitofarm (Charlotte Böhning & Mary Lempres)
creators.bio: Charlotte Böhning and Mary Lempres designed Chitofarm, a mealworm-powered biodigester for polystyrene, a 2022 Lexus Design Award finalist.
creators.why: Uses insects as both waste processors and material sources.
creators.bio_zh: Charlotte Böhning 与 Mary Lempres 设计了以黄粉虫处理聚苯乙烯的生物消化器 Chitofarm，入围 2022 年雷克萨斯设计奖。
creators.why_zh: 让昆虫同时成为垃圾处理者和材料来源。

creators.name: Kyeongho Park
creators.bio: Kyeongho Park is a Korean designer who with Yejin Heo created Zero Bag, a dissolving alginate package that won the 2023 Lexus Design Award.
creators.why: Makes packaging disappear into the wash.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；汉阳大学 ERICA 校区
creators.bio_zh: 朴庆浩是韩国设计师，与许艺珍共同设计了可溶解的海藻酸盐包装 Zero Bag，获 2023 年雷克萨斯设计奖。
creators.why_zh: 让包装在洗涤中消失。

creators.name: Julian Schwarze
creators.bio: Julian Schwarze is a German designer whose mobile bee-colony system Bee2Bee was an International Top 20 project in the 2016 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Designs mobile care infrastructure for pollinators in farmland.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；奥芬巴赫设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Julian Schwarze 是德国设计师，他的移动蜂群系统 Bee2Bee 入选 2016 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖国际 20 强。
creators.why_zh: 为农田里的传粉者设计可移动的照护设施。

creators.name: Sheng-Hung Lee
creators.bio: Sheng-Hung Lee is a Taiwanese designer who with Wan Kee Lee created TetraPOT, a mangrove-planting sea-defence block, a 2016 James Dyson Award International Top 20 project.
creators.why: Lets trees gradually take over the job of concrete coastal defences.
creators.bio_zh: 李胜宏是台湾设计师，与李云琪共同设计了种植红树林的防波块 TetraPOT，入选 2016 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖国际 20 强。
creators.why_zh: 让树逐渐接替混凝土海岸防护的工作。

creators.name: Carvey Ehren Maigue
creators.bio: Carvey Ehren Maigue is a Filipino engineer whose AuREUS solar material made from crop waste won the first James Dyson Award Sustainability prize in 2020.
creators.why: Turns rotting crops into light-harvesting windows.
creators.bio_zh: Carvey Ehren Maigue 是菲律宾工程师，他用农作物废料制成的太阳能材料 AuREUS 获得 2020 年首届詹姆斯·戴森设计奖可持续发展奖。
creators.why_zh: 把腐烂的农作物变成收集光能的窗户。

creators.name: Niamh Damery
creators.bio: Niamh Damery is an Irish designer whose mycelium beehive Econooc for native black bees was a 2020 James Dyson Award International Top 20 project.
creators.why: Grows a hollow-tree habitat for wild bees.
creators.bio_zh: Niamh Damery 是爱尔兰设计师，她为本地黑蜂设计的菌丝体蜂巢 Econooc 入选 2020 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖国际 20 强。
creators.why_zh: 为野生蜜蜂“种”出一个树洞般的栖息地。

creators.name: Elias Thaddäus Pfuner
creators.bio: Elias Thaddäus Pfuner is a designer who with Mario Kapsalis created Nemo, a coral-restoration service, the 2020 James Dyson Award national winner in Sweden.
creators.why: Designs tools for scaling up reef restoration work.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；于默奥设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Elias Thaddäus Pfuner 是设计师，与 Mario Kapsalis 共同设计了珊瑚修复服务 Nemo，获 2020 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖瑞典冠军。
creators.why_zh: 为扩大珊瑚礁修复规模设计工具。

creators.name: OFlow team (Shawn Navarednam, Kai Jie Chow, Frederick Wong)
creators.bio: Shawn Navarednam, Kai Jie Chow and Frederick Wong designed OFlow, a bacterial biofilm filter for microplastics, UK runner-up in the 2020 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Uses sticky bacterial biofilms to catch microplastics.
creators.bio_zh: Shawn Navarednam、Kai Jie Chow 与 Frederick Wong 设计了用细菌生物膜过滤微塑料的 OFlow，获 2020 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖英国亚军。
creators.why_zh: 利用有黏性的细菌生物膜捕获微塑料。

creators.name: Menlin Ng
creators.bio: Menlin Ng is a Malaysian designer who developed Citra, a leather-like material from citrus peel, a 2021 James Dyson Award International Top 20 project.
creators.why: Turns fruit waste into packaging leather.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；马来西亚理科大学
creators.bio_zh: Menlin Ng 是马来西亚设计师，研发了用柑橘皮制成的类皮革材料 Citra，入选 2021 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖国际 20 强。
creators.why_zh: 把水果废料变成包装用“皮革”。

creators.name: Philip Potthast
creators.bio: Philip Potthast is a German designer whose bee-centred hive HIIVE was a 2021 James Dyson Award International Top 20 project.
creators.why: Designs a hive around bee behaviour rather than beekeeper convenience.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；柏林应用技术大学
creators.bio_zh: Philip Potthast 是德国设计师，他以蜜蜂为中心设计的蜂箱 HIIVE 入选 2021 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖国际 20 强。
creators.why_zh: 围绕蜜蜂的行为而不是养蜂人的方便来设计蜂箱。

creators.name: Izabela Świca
creators.role: Designer; University of Warmia and Mazury
creators.bio: Izabela Świca is a Polish designer whose algae–fungi biofertiliser capsule was a 2021 James Dyson Award national runner-up in Poland.
creators.why: Uses microbial partnerships to rebuild degraded soil.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；瓦尔米亚-马祖里大学
creators.bio_zh: Izabela Świca 是波兰设计师，她的藻类-真菌生物肥料胶囊获得 2021 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖波兰亚军。
creators.why_zh: 借助微生物之间的合作重建退化土壤。

creators.name: Gabe Tavas
creators.bio: Gabe Tavas is an American designer who created Pyrus, a wood-like material from kombucha cellulose, a 2021 James Dyson Award International Top 20 project.
creators.why: Grows a substitute for exotic hardwoods from brewery waste.
creators.bio_zh: Gabe Tavas 是美国设计师，用康普茶纤维素制成类木材料 Pyrus，入选 2021 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖国际 20 强。
creators.why_zh: 用酿造废料“种”出珍稀硬木的替代品。

creators.name: Berta Daina
creators.bio: Berta Daina is a Spanish designer whose home bioplastic kit Agro Biomaterials was a 2022 James Dyson Award International Top 20 project.
creators.why: Makes biomaterial cooking a household practice.
creators.bio_zh: Berta Daina 是西班牙设计师，她的家用生物塑料套件 Agro Biomaterials 入选 2022 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖国际 20 强。
creators.why_zh: 让“烹饪”生物材料成为家常事。

creators.name: MicroBuild Masonry (Adrian Simone & Rania Al-Sheikhly)
creators.bio: Adrian Simone and Rania Al-Sheikhly developed Bio-Brick, masonry bound by bacteria, Canadian runner-up in the 2022 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Grows bricks at room temperature instead of firing them.
creators.bio_zh: Adrian Simone 与 Rania Al-Sheikhly 研发了由细菌黏结的砌块 Bio-Brick，获 2022 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖加拿大亚军。
creators.why_zh: 在常温下“长”出砖，而不是烧制。

creators.name: DISPERSEED team (Universitat Politècnica de València)
creators.bio: Irene Badía Madrigal, Diego Polo García, Carmen Amorós Egea and colleagues designed DISPERSEED, Spanish runner-up in the 2022 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Enlists birds and animals to replant burned forests.
creators.bio_zh: Irene Badía Madrigal、Diego Polo García、Carmen Amorós Egea 等人设计了 DISPERSEED，获 2022 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖西班牙亚军。
creators.why_zh: 请鸟类和动物帮忙为烧毁的森林重新播种。

creators.name: Divya Verma
creators.bio: Divya Verma is an Indian designer whose algae leather Kudarat was Indian runner-up in the 2022 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Makes a compostable leather from algae and waste fibres.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；印度国立设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Divya Verma 是印度设计师，她的藻类皮革 Kudarat 获得 2022 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖印度亚军。
creators.why_zh: 用藻类和废弃纤维制成可堆肥的皮革。

creators.name: BIOTEOS (Romain Dhenin)
creators.bio: Romain Dhenin founded BIOTEOS, which developed the microalgae air purifier OXYLON, French runner-up in the 2022 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Lets algae eat indoor air pollution.
creators.bio_zh: Romain Dhenin 创办了 BIOTEOS，研发微藻空气净化器 OXYLON，获 2022 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖法国亚军。
creators.why_zh: 让藻类“吃掉”室内空气污染。

creators.name: Friedrich Gerlach
creators.bio: Friedrich Gerlach is a German designer who with Julia Huhnholz made the Biocement Chair, German runner-up in the 2023 James Dyson Award and a Green Concept Award finalist.
creators.why: Communicates biocement research through a usable object.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；包豪斯魏玛大学
creators.bio_zh: Friedrich Gerlach 是德国设计师，与 Julia Huhnholz 共同制作了生物水泥椅，获 2023 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖德国亚军，并入围绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 通过一件可用的物品传达生物水泥研究。

creators.name: Cellsense team (Georgia Tech)
creators.bio: Stefan Colton, Aradhita Parasrampuria and J Sebastian Garcia Medina designed Cellsense algae sequins, US runner-up in the 2023 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Replaces plastic glitter with algae-based sparkle.
creators.bio_zh: Stefan Colton、Aradhita Parasrampuria 与 J Sebastian Garcia Medina 设计了藻类亮片 Cellsense，获 2023 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖美国亚军。
creators.why_zh: 用藻类材料替代塑料闪粉。

creators.name: O-GA team (Silpakorn University)
creators.bio: Sorrawitch Upcha and team designed O-GA, algae cultivation units for a renewable-energy countryside, Thai national winner of the 2023 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Imagines algae farming as village-scale energy infrastructure.
creators.bio_zh: Sorrawitch Upcha 等人设计了面向可再生能源乡村的藻类培养装置 O-GA，获 2023 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖泰国冠军。
creators.why_zh: 把养藻设想为村庄尺度的能源基础设施。

creators.name: Eden Harrison
creators.role: Designer; Royal College of Art & Imperial College London
creators.bio: Eden Harrison is a British designer whose reef dB structure damps offshore wind noise while providing reef habitat, UK runner-up in the 2023 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Designs energy infrastructure that also shelters marine life.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；皇家艺术学院 & 帝国理工学院
creators.bio_zh: Eden Harrison 是英国设计师，他的 reef dB 结构在降低海上风电噪声的同时提供礁石栖息地，获 2023 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖英国亚军。
creators.why_zh: 设计同时庇护海洋生物的能源基础设施。

creators.name: ALGBIO (Selen Şenal & Ceyda Güneş)
creators.bio: Selen Şenal and Ceyda Güneş developed ALGBIO, a microalgae system that treats wastewater and makes bioproducts, Turkish national winner of the 2024 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Couples water treatment and carbon capture through algae growth.
creators.bio_zh: Selen Şenal 与 Ceyda Güneş 研发了 ALGBIO——一个处理废水并生产生物产品的微藻系统，获 2024 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖土耳其冠军。
creators.why_zh: 通过藻类生长把污水处理与碳捕获结合起来。

creators.name: Carbon Polymerizing System team (Mahidol University)
creators.bio: Saharat Chawaruechai, Sumeth Klomchitcharoen and Kanyapat Ploypradith designed a carbon-to-PHB bacterial system, Thai national winner of the 2024 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Feeds captured carbon to bacteria that make bioplastic.
creators.bio_zh: Saharat Chawaruechai、Sumeth Klomchitcharoen 与 Kanyapat Ploypradith 设计了把碳转化为 PHB 的细菌系统，获 2024 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖泰国冠军。
creators.why_zh: 把捕获的碳喂给能制造生物塑料的细菌。

creators.name: Kyran Knauf
creators.bio: Kyran Knauf is a designer whose home cricket farm Crikorama won the 2024 James Dyson Award in the Netherlands.
creators.why: Brings insect farming into the kitchen as a full life cycle.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；埃因霍温设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Kyran Knauf 是设计师，他的家用蟋蟀养殖机 Crikorama 获得 2024 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖荷兰冠军。
creators.why_zh: 把昆虫养殖的完整生命周期带进厨房。

creators.name: PlantPoxy team (KMUTT)
creators.bio: Jitapa Muangsiri and team developed PlantPoxy, a fungal biocontrol coating for seeds, Thai runner-up in the 2024 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Replaces pesticides with a living fungal coating.
creators.bio_zh: Jitapa Muangsiri 等人研发了给种子包衣的真菌生防涂层 PlantPoxy，获 2024 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖泰国亚军。
creators.why_zh: 用活的真菌涂层替代农药。

creators.name: Anton Vervoort
creators.bio: Anton Vervoort is a Belgian designer whose mussel-hosting structure The Reef was a 2024 James Dyson Award International Top 20 project.
creators.why: Recruits filter-feeding mussels to clean nutrient-polluted water.
creators.bio_zh: Anton Vervoort 是比利时设计师，他的贻贝栖息结构 The Reef 入选 2024 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖国际 20 强。
creators.why_zh: 请滤食性贻贝来净化富营养化的水体。

creators.name: Markos Georgiou
creators.bio: Markos Georgiou is a designer whose bacterial-cellulose bioreactor Hydra was UK runner-up in the 2025 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Grows three-dimensional products directly in a bioreactor.
creators.bio_zh: Markos Georgiou 是设计师，他的细菌纤维素生物反应器 Hydra 获得 2025 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖英国亚军。
creators.why_zh: 在生物反应器中直接“长”出三维产品。

creators.name: Tak Keung Chan
creators.role: Designer; The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
creators.bio: Tak Keung Chan is a Hong Kong designer whose oyster-reef structure Reef of Hope won the 2025 James Dyson Award in Hong Kong.
creators.why: Designs reef geometry around the needs of oyster larvae.
creators.bio_zh: 陈德强是香港设计师，他的牡蛎礁结构 Reef of Hope 获得 2025 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖香港冠军。
creators.why_zh: 围绕牡蛎幼体的需要设计礁体几何形态。

creators.name: SoilRevive team (Chia-Yi Liu & Yen-Chun Chen)
creators.bio: Chia-Yi Liu and Yen-Chun Chen designed SoilRevive, a microbial bioremediation station, Taiwanese runner-up in the 2025 James Dyson Award.
creators.why: Times microbial releases to how plants recover.
creators.bio_zh: 刘家怡与陈彦均设计了微生物修复站 SoilRevive，获 2025 年詹姆斯·戴森设计奖台湾地区亚军。
creators.why_zh: 根据植物的恢复情况来安排微生物的释放时机。

creators.name: Tjeerd Veenhoven
creators.bio: Tjeerd Veenhoven is a Dutch designer who develops materials from plants and algae, from palm-leaf leather to seaweed yarn.
creators.why: He turns overlooked biomass into textile processes.
creators.bio_zh: Tjeerd Veenhoven 是荷兰设计师，用植物和藻类开发材料，从棕榈叶皮革到海藻纱线。
creators.why_zh: 他把被忽视的生物质变成纺织工艺。

creators.name: Orange Fiber
creators.bio: Orange Fiber, founded by Adriana Santanocito and Enrica Arena, makes a silk-like textile from Sicilian citrus-juice by-products.
creators.why: One of the first fashion fibres made from food-industry waste.
creators.bio_zh: Orange Fiber 由 Adriana Santanocito 与 Enrica Arena 创立，用西西里柑橘榨汁副产品制作丝绸般的面料。
creators.why_zh: 最早用食品工业废料制成的时尚纤维之一。

creators.name: VEGEA
creators.bio: VEGEA is an Italian company that makes leather alternatives from grape marc left over from winemaking.
creators.why: Links wine regions to fashion materials.
creators.bio_zh: VEGEA 是意大利公司，用酿酒剩下的葡萄渣制作皮革替代品。
creators.why_zh: 把葡萄酒产区与时尚材料连接起来。

creators.name: Circular Systems
creators.bio: Circular Systems is a materials company whose Agraloop process turns food-crop residues into textile fibres.
creators.why: Creates farmer income from biomass that would otherwise be burned.
creators.bio_zh: Circular Systems 是一家材料公司，其 Agraloop 工艺把粮食作物残余物转化为纺织纤维。
creators.why_zh: 让本会被焚烧的生物质为农民带来收入。

creators.name: Algaeing
creators.bio: Algaeing, founded by Renana Krebs, formulates algae biomass into bio-based fibres and dyes.
creators.why: Brings algae into the textile supply chain.
creators.bio_zh: Algaeing 由 Renana Krebs 创立，把藻类生物质配制成生物基纤维和染料。
creators.why_zh: 把藻类带入纺织供应链。

creators.name: Le Qara
creators.bio: Le Qara is a Peruvian biomaterials company, founded by Isemar and Jacqueline Cruz Loayza, that grows leather-like material with microorganisms.
creators.why: Uses local flower and fruit waste as the food for a grown material.
creators.bio_zh: Le Qara 是秘鲁生物材料公司，由 Isemar 与 Jacqueline Cruz Loayza 创立，用微生物培养类皮革材料。
creators.why_zh: 把本地花卉和水果废料作为“生长”材料的养料。

creators.name: Green Nettle Textile
creators.bio: Green Nettle Textile is a Kenyan venture that cultivates the giant nettle and processes it into linen-like fabric.
creators.why: A low-water wild plant becomes a livelihood for smallholder farmers.
creators.bio_zh: Green Nettle Textile 是肯尼亚企业，种植巨型荨麻并把它加工成类似亚麻的面料。
creators.why_zh: 一种耗水少的野生植物成为小农的生计。

creators.name: Galy
creators.bio: Galy, founded by Luciano Bueno, grows cotton fibre from plant cells in bioreactors.
creators.why: Decouples a crop from fields and weather.
creators.bio_zh: Galy 由 Luciano Bueno 创立，在生物反应器中用植物细胞培养棉纤维。
creators.why_zh: 让一种作物脱离田地和天气。

creators.name: Ponda
creators.bio: Ponda (formerly SaltyCo), founded by Finlay Duncan and Julian Ellis-Brown at the Royal College of Art, makes fibres from Typha grown on rewetted peatlands.
creators.why: Its business model pays farmers to rewet carbon-storing wetlands.
creators.bio_zh: Ponda（原名 SaltyCo）由 Finlay Duncan 与 Julian Ellis-Brown 在皇家艺术学院创立，用在再湿化泥炭地种植的香蒲制作纤维。
creators.why_zh: 它的商业模式让农民通过恢复储碳湿地获得收入。

creators.name: PLSTC
creators.bio: PLSTC (Fashion to Food) is an Australian team that bio-engineers bacteria to digest polyester textile waste into edible biomass.
creators.why: Proposes that plastic clothing could end up as food.
creators.bio_zh: PLSTC（Fashion to Food）是澳大利亚团队，改造细菌来把涤纶纺织废料消化成可食用的生物质。
creators.why_zh: 提出塑料衣物最终可以变成食物。

creators.name: Rubi Laboratories
creators.bio: Rubi Laboratories, founded by twin sisters Neeka and Leila Mashouf, turns captured CO2 into cellulose with enzymes.
creators.why: Makes textile cellulose without trees.
creators.bio_zh: Rubi Laboratories 由双胞胎姐妹 Neeka 与 Leila Mashouf 创立，用酶把捕获的二氧化碳转化为纤维素。
creators.why_zh: 不用树木就能制造纺织用纤维素。

creators.name: ALT TEX
creators.bio: ALT TEX, founded by Myra Arshad and Avani Patel, ferments food waste into a biodegradable polyester alternative.
creators.why: Targets fashion's most common fossil fibre.
creators.bio_zh: ALT TEX 由 Myra Arshad 与 Avani Patel 创立，把食物垃圾发酵成可降解的涤纶替代品。
creators.why_zh: 瞄准时尚业最常见的化石基纤维。

creators.name: KBCols Sciences
creators.bio: KBCols Sciences, founded by Vaishali Kulkarni, produces natural textile colourants from bacteria isolated from India's biodiversity.
creators.why: Builds a dye palette from local microbial diversity.
creators.bio_zh: KBCols Sciences 由 Vaishali Kulkarni 创立，用从印度生物多样性中分离的细菌生产天然纺织色素。
creators.why_zh: 用本地微生物多样性构建一套染料色板。

creators.name: PhycoLabs
creators.bio: PhycoLabs is a Brazilian biotech start-up developing textile fibres from marine algae.
creators.why: Brings seaweed into Latin American textile innovation.
creators.bio_zh: PhycoLabs 是巴西生物技术初创公司，用海藻开发纺织纤维。
creators.why_zh: 把海藻带入拉丁美洲的纺织创新。

creators.name: Brilliant Dyes
creators.bio: Brilliant Dyes is a London start-up extracting pigments such as phycocyanin from cyanobacteria through a low-energy biorefinery.
creators.why: Makes vivid blues from photosynthetic microbes.
creators.bio_zh: Brilliant Dyes 是伦敦的初创公司，通过低能耗生物精炼从蓝藻中提取藻蓝蛋白等色素。
creators.why_zh: 从光合微生物中获取鲜艳的蓝色。

creators.name: ArtSilk
creators.bio: ArtSilk, founded by researchers Anna Rising and Benjamin Schmuck, spins fibre from spider-silk-inspired proteins made by microorganisms.
creators.why: Spins artificial spider silk without heat or harsh chemicals.
creators.bio_zh: ArtSilk 由研究者 Anna Rising 与 Benjamin Schmuck 创立，用微生物生产的仿蛛丝蛋白纺成纤维。
creators.why_zh: 在不加热、不用强化学品的条件下纺出人造蛛丝。

creators.name: Keltex
creators.bio: Keltex is a Tanzanian venture that combines AI-optimised seaweed farming with biopolymer extraction to make leather alternatives.
creators.why: Adds value to seaweed farmed largely by women in coastal communities.
creators.bio_zh: Keltex 是坦桑尼亚企业，把 AI 优化的海藻养殖与生物聚合物提取结合，制作皮革替代品。
creators.why_zh: 为沿海社区中主要由女性养殖的海藻增加价值。

creators.name: Microbeworks
creators.bio: Microbeworks is an Indian start-up whose MicroBlue dye is brewed by microbial fermentation for existing dyeing machinery.
creators.why: Designs a microbial dye that fits the factories that already exist.
creators.bio_zh: Microbeworks 是印度初创公司，其 MicroBlue 染料通过微生物发酵生产，可直接用于现有染色设备。
creators.why_zh: 设计一种适配现有工厂的微生物染料。

creators.name: Tera Mira
creators.bio: Tera Mira, founded by Jeanne Begon-Lours and Lucy Dain-Williams, wet-spins seaweed into stretch fibres.
creators.why: A bio-based stretch fibre that keeps garments recyclable.
creators.bio_zh: Tera Mira 由 Jeanne Begon-Lours 与 Lucy Dain-Williams 创立，把海藻湿法纺成弹性纤维。
creators.why_zh: 一种让服装仍可回收的生物基弹力纤维。

creators.name: Coral Vita
creators.bio: Coral Vita, founded by Sam Teicher and Gator Halpern, runs land-based coral farms for reef restoration.
creators.why: Industrialises coral growing so restoration can match the scale of loss.
creators.bio_zh: Coral Vita 由 Sam Teicher 与 Gator Halpern 创立，经营陆基珊瑚养殖场，用于珊瑚礁修复。
creators.why_zh: 把珊瑚培育产业化，让修复能跟上损失的规模。

creators.name: Sanergy
creators.bio: Sanergy is a Kenyan sanitation company that turns human and organic waste into insect protein and fertiliser.
creators.why: Uses black soldier flies as the workers of a circular city.
creators.bio_zh: Sanergy 是肯尼亚的卫生设施公司，把人类粪便和有机垃圾转化为昆虫蛋白和肥料。
creators.why_zh: 让黑水虻成为循环城市的“工人”。

creators.name: Yi Zhijian
creators.bio: Yi Zhijian is a professor at Chongqing Jiaotong University who developed 'desert soilization', turning sand into soil-like ground with a plant-derived binder.
creators.why: Rethinks soil as a material property that can be designed.
creators.bio_zh: 易志坚是重庆交通大学教授，研发了“沙漠土壤化”技术，用植物来源的黏结剂把沙子变成类似土壤的地面。
creators.why_zh: 把土壤重新理解为可以被设计的材料属性。

creators.name: Phool
creators.bio: Phool, founded by Ankit Agarwal, recycles temple flower offerings from the Ganges into incense, packaging foam and Fleather.
creators.why: Turns a river-polluting ritual waste into materials and jobs for women.
creators.bio_zh: Phool 由 Ankit Agarwal 创立，把恒河边寺庙的献花回收制成香、包装泡沫和花卉皮革 Fleather。
creators.why_zh: 把污染河流的仪式废物变成材料和女性就业机会。

creators.name: Hutan
creators.bio: Hutan is a community-based conservation organisation founded by Isabelle Lackman and Marc Ancrenaz that reforests wildlife corridors in Sabah.
creators.why: Designs landscapes for orangutans and elephants to move again.
creators.bio_zh: Hutan 是由 Isabelle Lackman 与 Marc Ancrenaz 创立的社区保护组织，在沙巴重建野生动物走廊。
creators.why_zh: 为猩猩和大象重新设计可以通行的景观。

creators.name: LanzaTech
creators.bio: LanzaTech, led by Jennifer Holmgren, uses gas-fermenting bacteria to turn industrial off-gases into ethanol and chemicals.
creators.why: Treats pollution as a feedstock for microbes.
creators.bio_zh: LanzaTech 由 Jennifer Holmgren 领导，利用气体发酵细菌把工业废气转化为乙醇和化学品。
creators.why_zh: 把污染视为微生物的原料。

creators.name: SeaForester
creators.bio: SeaForester, co-founded by Jan Verbeek, restores kelp forests by seeding small stones with seaweed spores ('green gravel').
creators.why: A low-tech method to replant underwater forests at scale.
creators.bio_zh: SeaForester 由 Jan Verbeek 等人创立，通过在小石子上播种海藻孢子（“绿色砾石”）来恢复海藻林。
creators.why_zh: 用低技术方法大规模重新种植水下森林。

creators.name: Aquacycl
creators.bio: Aquacycl, founded by Orianna Bretschger, treats industrial wastewater with microbial fuel cells.
creators.why: Makes wastewater treatment generate power instead of using it.
creators.bio_zh: Aquacycl 由 Orianna Bretschger 创立，用微生物燃料电池处理工业废水。
creators.why_zh: 让污水处理发电而不是耗电。

creators.name: Sea Forest
creators.bio: Sea Forest, founded by Sam Elsom, farms the red seaweed Asparagopsis to cut methane from cattle.
creators.why: Uses a seaweed to change the metabolism of livestock.
creators.bio_zh: Sea Forest 由 Sam Elsom 创立，养殖红藻海门冬（Asparagopsis）以减少牛的甲烷排放。
creators.why_zh: 用一种海藻改变牲畜的代谢。

creators.name: Coast 4C
creators.bio: Coast 4C is a Philippine social enterprise building a regenerative seaweed supply chain with small-scale fishing communities.
creators.why: Links seaweed farming, livelihoods and coastal restoration.
creators.bio_zh: Coast 4C 是菲律宾社会企业，与小规模渔业社区共建再生型海藻供应链。
creators.why_zh: 把海藻养殖、生计和海岸修复连接起来。

creators.name: Green Spot Technologies
creators.bio: Green Spot Technologies upcycles food-processing waste into ingredients with solid-state fermentation (Ferment'Up).
creators.why: Uses fermentation to turn by-products into food.
creators.bio_zh: Green Spot Technologies 用固态发酵把食品加工废料升级为食品原料（Ferment'Up）。
creators.why_zh: 用发酵把副产品变成食物。

creators.name: MYCL (Mycotech Lab)
creators.bio: MYCL, co-founded by Adi Reza Nugroho and Annisa Wibi Ismarlanti, grows the mycelium leather Mylea on agricultural waste.
creators.why: Pays farmers for waste so they stop burning it.
creators.bio_zh: MYCL 由 Adi Reza Nugroho 与 Annisa Wibi Ismarlanti 等人创立，在农业废料上培养菌丝体皮革 Mylea。
creators.why_zh: 向农民收购废料，让他们不再焚烧。

creators.name: MiAlgae
creators.bio: MiAlgae, founded by Douglas Martin, grows omega-3 microalgae on whisky-distillery by-products for fish feed.
creators.why: Replaces wild fish in fish food with algae.
creators.bio_zh: MiAlgae 由 Douglas Martin 创立，用威士忌酒厂副产物培养富含 omega-3 的微藻，作为鱼饲料。
creators.why_zh: 用藻类替代鱼饲料中的野生鱼。

creators.name: Natural Fiber Welding
creators.bio: Natural Fiber Welding, founded by Luke Haverhals, makes plastic-free materials such as the leather alternative MIRUM.
creators.why: Shows a plant-based leather that needs no plastic binder.
creators.bio_zh: Natural Fiber Welding 由 Luke Haverhals 创立，生产不含塑料的材料，如皮革替代品 MIRUM。
creators.why_zh: 展示一种不需要塑料黏合剂的植物基皮革。

creators.name: NatureMetrics
creators.bio: NatureMetrics, founded by Kat Bruce, measures biodiversity from environmental DNA in water and soil samples.
creators.why: Makes the presence of many species measurable from a scoop of water.
creators.bio_zh: NatureMetrics 由 Kat Bruce 创立，通过水和土壤样本中的环境 DNA 测量生物多样性。
creators.why_zh: 只需一勺水就能测出众多物种的存在。

creators.name: Bios Urn (Gerard Moliné & Martín Ruiz de Azúa)
creators.bio: Gerard Moliné and Martín Ruiz de Azúa designed the Bios Urn, a biodegradable urn that grows a tree from cremated ashes.
creators.why: A classic design that turns burial into growth.
creators.bio_zh: Gerard Moliné 与 Martín Ruiz de Azúa 设计了 Bios Urn——一种让骨灰长成一棵树的可降解骨灰盒。
creators.why_zh: 一件把安葬变成生长的经典设计。

creators.name: GreenWave
creators.bio: GreenWave, founded by fisherman Bren Smith, develops and trains farmers in regenerative 3D ocean farming of seaweed and shellfish.
creators.why: A farm model that needs no feed, fresh water or fertiliser.
creators.bio_zh: GreenWave 由渔民 Bren Smith 创立，推广并培训农民进行海藻与贝类的再生型立体海洋养殖。
creators.why_zh: 一种不需要饲料、淡水和化肥的养殖模式。

creators.name: Sahara Forest Project
creators.bio: The Sahara Forest Project combines seawater-cooled greenhouses, solar power and desalination to grow food and revegetate deserts; design by Exploration Architecture.
creators.why: Designs a desert system in which outputs of one process feed the next.
creators.bio_zh: 撒哈拉森林项目把海水冷却温室、太阳能和海水淡化结合起来，在沙漠中种植粮食和恢复植被，由 Exploration Architecture 设计。
creators.why_zh: 设计一个前一个环节的产出成为下一个环节投入的沙漠系统。
creators.based_zh: 奥斯陆，挪威 / 约旦 / 卡塔尔

creators.name: Seedballs Kenya
creators.bio: Seedballs Kenya, founded by Teddy Kinyanjui and Elsen Karstad, coats native seeds in charcoal dust for large-scale reforestation.
creators.why: A low-cost seed technology anyone can throw.
creators.bio_zh: Seedballs Kenya 由 Teddy Kinyanjui 与 Elsen Karstad 创立，把本地种子裹上炭粉，用于大规模植被恢复。
creators.why_zh: 一种人人都能投掷的低成本种子技术。

creators.name: Solar Foods
creators.bio: Solar Foods grows the protein Solein from hydrogen-oxidising bacteria fed on CO2 and electricity.
creators.why: Makes food without farmland.
creators.bio_zh: Solar Foods 用以二氧化碳和电能为食的氢氧化细菌生产蛋白质 Solein。
creators.why_zh: 不用农田就能生产食物。

creators.name: Carbios
creators.bio: Carbios develops enzymes that break down PET plastic and polyester into monomers for recycling.
creators.why: Uses an engineered compost enzyme for infinite recycling.
creators.bio_zh: Carbios 研发能把 PET 塑料和涤纶分解为单体以便回收的酶。
creators.why_zh: 用工程化的堆肥酶实现无限循环回收。

creators.name: Flash Forest
creators.bio: Flash Forest uses drones to map land and fire germinated seed pods to reforest burned and logged areas.
creators.why: Speeds up reforestation with aerial seeding.
creators.bio_zh: Flash Forest 用无人机测绘土地并发射已发芽的种子荚，为烧毁和采伐过的土地造林。
creators.why_zh: 用空中播种加快造林速度。

creators.name: BIOMILQ
creators.bio: BIOMILQ, founded by Leila Strickland and Michelle Egger, cultures human mammary cells to produce milk components outside the body.
creators.why: Raises questions about bodies, care and cell culture.
creators.bio_zh: BIOMILQ 由 Leila Strickland 与 Michelle Egger 创立，培养人类乳腺细胞在体外生产乳汁成分。
creators.why_zh: 引发关于身体、照护与细胞培养的讨论。

creators.name: Great Wrap
creators.bio: Great Wrap, founded by Julia Kaisinger and Jordy Kay, makes compostable cling and stretch wrap from potato waste.
creators.why: Replaces one of the most common single-use plastics.
creators.bio_zh: Great Wrap 由 Julia Kaisinger 与 Jordy Kay 创立，用土豆废料制作可堆肥的保鲜膜和缠绕膜。
creators.why_zh: 替代最常见的一次性塑料之一。

creators.name: junya.ishigami+associates
creators.bio: junya.ishigami+associates is the Tokyo architecture office of Junya Ishigami, known for architecture that blurs building and landscape.
creators.why: Art Biotop moved a whole forest tree by tree.
creators.bio_zh: junya.ishigami+associates 是石上纯也的东京建筑事务所，以模糊建筑与景观边界的作品著称。
creators.why_zh: Art Biotop 把一片森林一棵一棵地搬了过来。

creators.name: Jan Klingler
creators.bio: Jan Klingler is a designer whose Bacteria Lamps preserve colonies of bacteria sampled from people and places in glass.
creators.why: Makes the invisible microbial signature of a person into an object.
creators.bio_zh: Jan Klingler 是设计师，他的“细菌灯”把从人和地方采集的细菌菌落封存在玻璃中。
creators.why_zh: 把一个人看不见的微生物特征变成一件物品。

creators.name: crafting plastics! studio
creators.bio: crafting plastics! studio (Vlasta Kubušová, Miroslav Král) develops the oil-free bioplastic NUATAN with Slovak scientists.
creators.why: Designs a bioplastic with a planned lifespan.
creators.bio_zh: crafting plastics! studio（Vlasta Kubušová、Miroslav Král）与斯洛伐克科学家共同研发不含石油的生物塑料 NUATAN。
creators.why_zh: 设计一种具有预定寿命的生物塑料。
creators.based_zh: 布拉迪斯拉发，斯洛伐克

creators.name: Shneel Malik
creators.role: Architect and researcher, Bio-ID Lab, UCL
creators.bio: Shneel Malik is an architect and researcher at UCL's Bio-ID Lab who developed the algae bioremediation tile wall Indus with Brenda Parker and Marcos Cruz.
creators.why: Brings microalgae bioremediation to craft communities through ceramics.
creators.role_zh: 建筑师、研究者，伦敦大学学院 Bio-ID Lab
creators.bio_zh: Shneel Malik 是伦敦大学学院 Bio-ID Lab 的建筑师和研究者，与 Brenda Parker、Marcos Cruz 共同研发藻类生物修复瓷砖墙 Indus。
creators.why_zh: 通过陶瓷把微藻生物修复带给手工艺社区。

creators.name: Crème (Jun Aizaki)
creators.bio: Crème is Jun Aizaki's Brooklyn design and architecture studio, known for the gourd-grown HyO-Cup.
creators.why: Lets a plant do the manufacturing.
creators.bio_zh: Crème 是 Jun Aizaki 在布鲁克林的设计与建筑工作室，以用葫芦生长而成的 HyO-Cup 闻名。
creators.why_zh: 让植物来完成制造。

creators.name: Playfool
creators.bio: Playfool is the design studio of Daniel Coppen and Saki Maruyama, making playful objects and games.
creators.why: Forest Crayons bring forest species into children's hands.
creators.bio_zh: Playfool 是 Daniel Coppen 与丸山纱季的设计工作室，创作有趣的物件和游戏。
creators.why_zh: Forest Crayons 把森林中的树种交到孩子手中。

creators.name: Turenscape
creators.bio: Turenscape is the landscape architecture firm founded by Kongjian Yu, known for 'sponge city' designs that work with water.
creators.why: Replaces hard infrastructure with landscapes that host other species.
creators.bio_zh: 土人设计由俞孔坚创立，以与水合作的“海绵城市”设计著称。
creators.why_zh: 用容纳其他物种的景观替代硬质基础设施。

creators.name: Monc
creators.bio: Monc is a London design brand that packages its products in inserts grown from mushroom mycelium.
creators.why: Brings grown packaging into consumer retail.
creators.bio_zh: Monc 是伦敦的设计品牌，用蘑菇菌丝体生长而成的内衬来包装产品。
creators.why_zh: 把“长”出来的包装带入零售。

creators.name: Margent Farm
creators.bio: Margent Farm grows hemp and makes bio-composite building products from it on the same farm.
creators.why: Links a field directly to building components.
creators.bio_zh: Margent Farm 种植大麻（工业大麻），并在同一农场把它加工成生物复合建筑材料。
creators.why_zh: 把一片田地直接连接到建筑构件。

creators.name: Frank Kolkman
creators.bio: Frank Kolkman is a Dutch designer who works on DIY medicine and technology; his Designs for Flies won the 2016 Dutch Design Award for Service & Systems.
creators.why: Moves lab biology into patients' homes.
creators.bio_zh: Frank Kolkman 是荷兰设计师，关注 DIY 医疗与技术；他的 Designs for Flies 获得 2016 年荷兰设计奖“服务与系统”类奖项。
creators.why_zh: 把实验室生物学搬进患者家中。

creators.name: Jelte van Abbema
creators.bio: Jelte van Abbema is a Dutch graphic designer who won the 2009 Dutch Design Award for Young Designer, partly for Symbiose, a poster column overgrown by bacteria.
creators.why: Treats printed graphics as a living, changing surface.
creators.bio_zh: Jelte van Abbema 是荷兰平面设计师，2009 年获荷兰设计奖青年设计师奖，获奖作品之一是被细菌覆盖的海报柱 Symbiose。
creators.why_zh: 把印刷图形当作活的、会变化的表面。

creators.name: Except Integrated Sustainability
creators.bio: Except Integrated Sustainability is a Rotterdam design and research consultancy for sustainable systems.
creators.why: Its Polydome models a greenhouse on a natural ecosystem.
creators.bio_zh: Except Integrated Sustainability 是鹿特丹的可持续系统设计与研究咨询公司。
creators.why_zh: 它的 Polydome 以自然生态系统为模板设计温室。

creators.name: Studio Makkink & Bey
creators.role: Design studio (Rianne Makkink and Jurgen Bey)
creators.bio: Studio Makkink & Bey is a Rotterdam design studio working across architecture, landscape and objects.
creators.why: Plans a city district around local living resources.
creators.role_zh: 设计工作室（Rianne Makkink 与 Jurgen Bey）
creators.bio_zh: Studio Makkink & Bey 是鹿特丹的设计工作室，工作横跨建筑、景观与物件。
creators.why_zh: 围绕本地的生命资源来规划城区。

creators.name: Omlab
creators.bio: Omlab is a Dutch studio designing nature-inclusive building products, such as 3D-printed starter homes for swallows.
creators.why: Designs temporary homes for birds displaced by new construction.
creators.bio_zh: Omlab 是荷兰的设计工作室，设计包容自然的建筑产品，例如 3D 打印的燕子“入门住宅”。
creators.why_zh: 为因新建工程失去家园的鸟类设计临时住所。

creators.name: Christien Meindertsma
creators.bio: Christien Meindertsma is a Dutch designer known for tracing the full life of materials such as flax, wool and pigs.
creators.why: Designs from a whole plant or animal rather than from a finished material.
creators.bio_zh: Christien Meindertsma 是荷兰设计师，以追溯亚麻、羊毛、猪等材料的完整生命历程而著称。
creators.why_zh: 从整株植物或整只动物出发设计，而不是从成品材料出发。

creators.name: Zsofia Kollar
creators.role: Designer; founder of Human Material Loop
creators.bio: Zsofia Kollar is a designer who founded Human Material Loop, turning waste human hair into textiles.
creators.why: Reframes human hair as an abundant keratin fibre.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；Human Material Loop 创始人
creators.bio_zh: Zsofia Kollar 是设计师，创立了 Human Material Loop，把废弃人发变成纺织品。
creators.why_zh: 把人发重新定义为丰富的角蛋白纤维。

creators.name: Auke Bleij
creators.bio: Auke Bleij co-founded Respyre, which develops bioreceptive concrete that moss colonises spontaneously.
creators.why: Turns grey walls into living green infrastructure.
creators.bio_zh: Auke Bleij 联合创立了 Respyre，研发能让苔藓自发生长的生物亲和性混凝土。
creators.why_zh: 把灰色墙面变成活的绿色基础设施。

creators.name: Bas Emaus
creators.bio: Bas Emaus founded JiTiBa Algae Technologies, which uses immobilised microalgae for wastewater treatment.
creators.why: Translates algae biotechnology into urban infrastructure.
creators.bio_zh: Bas Emaus 创立了 JiTiBa Algae Technologies，利用固定化微藻处理污水。
creators.why_zh: 把藻类生物技术转化为城市基础设施。

creators.name: Aerseeds (Bike & Begum Ayaskan)
creators.role: Design duo, Royal College of Art
creators.bio: Twin designers Bike and Begum Ayaskan created Aerseeds, winner of the 2022 Terra Carta Design Lab.
creators.why: Borrow the flight of winged seeds for reforestation.
creators.role_zh: 设计双人组，皇家艺术学院
creators.bio_zh: 双胞胎设计师 Bike 与 Begum Ayaskan 创作了 Aerseeds，获 2022 年 Terra Carta 设计实验室奖。
creators.why_zh: 借用翅果的飞行方式来造林。

creators.name: Shellworks
creators.bio: Shellworks is a London company founded by RCA graduates Insiya Jafferjee and Amir Afshar that makes packaging from the microbial biopolymer Vivomer.
creators.why: Packaging that soil and ocean microbes recognise as food.
creators.bio_zh: Shellworks 是由皇家艺术学院毕业生 Insiya Jafferjee 与 Amir Afshar 创办的伦敦公司，用微生物生物聚合物 Vivomer 制作包装。
creators.why_zh: 让土壤和海洋微生物视为食物的包装。

creators.name: Primordial (RCA team)
creators.role: Student venture, Royal College of Art
creators.bio: Primordial is an RCA team developing low-cost photobioreactors for microalgae.
creators.why: Makes algae carbon capture cheap enough to scale.
creators.role_zh: 皇家艺术学院学生创业团队
creators.bio_zh: Primordial 是皇家艺术学院团队，研发低成本微藻光生物反应器。
creators.why_zh: 让藻类碳捕获便宜到可以规模化。

creators.name: Resting Reef (Louise Skajem & Aura Murillo)
creators.role: Design duo, Royal College of Art
creators.bio: Louise Skajem and Aura Murillo founded Resting Reef, a marine burial service using reef structures.
creators.why: Turns remembrance into habitat.
creators.role_zh: 设计双人组，皇家艺术学院
creators.bio_zh: Louise Skajem 与 Aura Murillo 创立了 Resting Reef——一种以人工礁为载体的海葬服务。
creators.why_zh: 把纪念变成栖息地。

creators.name: Home Grown (RCA team)
creators.role: Student team, Royal College of Art
creators.bio: Home Grown is an RCA team making consumer electronics from bio-based, locally sourced materials.
creators.why: Brings grown materials into electronics casings.
creators.role_zh: 皇家艺术学院学生团队
creators.bio_zh: Home Grown 是皇家艺术学院团队，用本地生物基材料制作消费电子产品。
creators.why_zh: 把“长”出来的材料用于电子产品外壳。

creators.name: Weird Ecologies (RCA team)
creators.role: Student team, Royal College of Art
creators.bio: Weird Ecologies is an RCA team designing devices that support toxin-tolerant organisms on contaminated land.
creators.why: Works with organisms that thrive in toxicity instead of fencing sites off.
creators.role_zh: 皇家艺术学院学生团队
creators.bio_zh: Weird Ecologies 是皇家艺术学院团队，设计在污染土地上支持耐毒生物的装置。
creators.why_zh: 与在毒性中繁盛的生物合作，而不是把场地围起来。

creators.name: RISD Terra Carta teams
creators.role: Student teams, Rhode Island School of Design
creators.bio: Student teams from the Rhode Island School of Design that won the 2024 Terra Carta Design Lab with BIOPOD and Shellf Life.
creators.why: Two winning bio-based proposals for waterfronts and seafood waste.
creators.role_zh: 罗德岛设计学院学生团队
creators.bio_zh: 罗德岛设计学院的学生团队，以 BIOPOD 和 Shellf Life 获得 2024 年 Terra Carta 设计实验室奖。
creators.why_zh: 两个面向滨水区与海鲜废料的获奖生物基方案。

creators.name: Emma Money
creators.bio: Emma Money is a designer who co-developed Cyanoskin, a living paint with cyanobacteria, with Holly Souza-Newman and Antoinette Nothomb.
creators.why: Turns blank façades into photosynthetic surfaces.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；Cyanoskin 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: Emma Money 是设计师，与 Holly Souza-Newman、Antoinette Nothomb 共同研发含蓝藻的活体涂料 Cyanoskin。
creators.why_zh: 把空白的建筑立面变成进行光合作用的表面。

creators.name: SEAGRAFT team (RCA)
creators.role: Student team, Royal College of Art
creators.bio: Hongyu Wu, Mingchuan Yang, Zexi Gong, Mengna Gao and Xiaozhuo Jiang designed SEAGRAFT, a tool for planting seagrass.
creators.why: Designs a planting tool for underwater meadows.
creators.role_zh: 皇家艺术学院学生团队
creators.bio_zh: Hongyu Wu、Mingchuan Yang、Zexi Gong、Mengna Gao 与 Xiaozhuo Jiang 设计了种植海草的工具 SEAGRAFT。
creators.why_zh: 为水下草甸设计种植工具。

creators.name: WildWatch team (NID Ahmedabad)
creators.role: Student team, National Institute of Design
creators.bio: Students at India's National Institute of Design who won the 2024 Terra Carta Design Lab with WildWatch, a wildlife-collision warning system.
creators.why: Designs roads that notice animals.
creators.role_zh: 印度国立设计学院学生团队
creators.bio_zh: 印度国立设计学院的学生，以野生动物碰撞预警系统 WildWatch 获得 2024 年 Terra Carta 设计实验室奖。
creators.why_zh: 设计能“注意到”动物的道路。

creators.name: Ekaterina Semenova
creators.bio: Ekaterina Semenova is a designer whose Care for Milk turns leftover milk into a ceramic glaze.
creators.why: Uses a food waste as a functional coating.
creators.bio_zh: Ekaterina Semenova 是设计师，她的 Care for Milk 把剩牛奶变成陶瓷釉层。
creators.why_zh: 把食物废料用作功能性涂层。

creators.name: Sanne Visser
creators.bio: Sanne Visser is a Dutch material designer who spins human hair into ropes and textiles.
creators.why: Shows the tensile strength hidden in hair waste.
creators.bio_zh: Sanne Visser 是荷兰材料设计师，把人发纺成绳索和纺织品。
creators.why_zh: 展示了人发废料中隐藏的抗拉强度。

creators.name: Buro Belén
creators.bio: Buro Belén is an Amsterdam studio working with colour, textiles and natural dyes.
creators.why: Designs with fading as a quality of living colour.
creators.bio_zh: Buro Belén 是阿姆斯特丹的设计工作室，研究色彩、纺织与天然染料。
creators.why_zh: 把褪色视为“活”颜色的一种品质来设计。

creators.name: Ingrid Nijhoff
creators.bio: Ingrid Nijhoff is a Dutch designer who grew inks from pigment-producing bacteria in Living Pixels.
creators.why: Makes a colour palette from bacteria collected from everyday life.
creators.bio_zh: Ingrid Nijhoff 是荷兰设计师，在 Living Pixels 中用产色素细菌培养墨水。
creators.why_zh: 用从日常生活中采集的细菌制作色板。

creators.name: Aagje Hoekstra
creators.bio: Aagje Hoekstra is a Dutch designer who made a chitosan bioplastic from mealworm beetle wing cases.
creators.why: Finds a material stream in insect farming waste.
creators.bio_zh: Aagje Hoekstra 是荷兰设计师，用黄粉虫甲虫的鞘翅制成壳聚糖生物塑料。
creators.why_zh: 在昆虫养殖废料中发现材料来源。

creators.name: Milo Dool
creators.bio: Milo Dool is a Dutch designer whose Pendant Lights use beech wood transformed by white-rot fungi.
creators.why: Shows fungal decay as a design quality.
creators.bio_zh: Milo Dool 是荷兰设计师，他的吊灯使用被白腐真菌改变过的山毛榉木。
creators.why_zh: 把真菌腐朽展示为一种设计品质。

creators.name: Nina van den Broek
creators.bio: Nina van den Broek is a Dutch designer who made Ivorish, an ivory substitute from human milk teeth, at Waag's Open Wetlab.
creators.why: Questions animal materials by offering a human one.
creators.bio_zh: Nina van den Broek 是荷兰设计师，在 Waag 开放湿实验室用人类乳牙制作象牙替代品 Ivorish。
creators.why_zh: 用人体材料来质疑动物材料。

creators.name: Formafantasma
creators.bio: Formafantasma is a research-driven design studio known for projects on materials, extraction and ecology.
creators.why: Botanica imagined design without oil, using natural polymers.
creators.bio_zh: Formafantasma 是以研究为导向的设计工作室，以关于材料、资源开采与生态的项目著称。
creators.why_zh: Botanica 设想了没有石油的设计，使用天然聚合物。
creators.based_zh: 阿姆斯特丹，荷兰 / 米兰，意大利

creators.name: Lieske Schreuder
creators.bio: Lieske Schreuder is a Dutch designer who fed garden snails coloured paper to make a linoleum-like material from their droppings.
creators.why: Treats snails as small material producers.
creators.bio_zh: Lieske Schreuder 是荷兰设计师，给花园蜗牛喂彩色纸，用它们的粪便制成类似油毡的材料。
creators.why_zh: 把蜗牛当作小型材料生产者。

creators.name: Gionata Gatto
creators.bio: Gionata Gatto is an Italian designer whose Agricola lamps are made from agricultural by-products bound with natural gums.
creators.why: Uses crop waste that would otherwise be burned.
creators.bio_zh: Gionata Gatto 是意大利设计师，他的 Agricola 灯具由天然树胶黏结的农业副产品制成。
creators.why_zh: 利用本会被焚烧的作物废料。

creators.name: Claudy Jongstra
creators.bio: Claudy Jongstra is a Dutch textile artist who keeps her own flock of Drenthe Heath sheep and grows dye plants for her felted works.
creators.why: Integrates farming, biodiversity and textile art in one practice.
creators.bio_zh: Claudy Jongstra 是荷兰纺织艺术家，自己饲养德伦特荒原羊群并种植染料植物，用于她的毛毡作品。
creators.why_zh: 把农牧、生物多样性与纺织艺术整合在同一实践中。

creators.name: Celestine Briët
creators.bio: Celestine Briët is a Dutch designer whose BeLeaf material is made from fallen leaves.
creators.why: Designs objects meant to decay back into the tree they hang in.
creators.bio_zh: Celestine Briët 是荷兰设计师，她的 BeLeaf 材料由落叶制成。
creators.why_zh: 设计会腐烂回到所挂树木之下的物件。

creators.name: BeeHaven team (Yao Yulu, Liu Xinyi, Dai Yanning)
creators.bio: BeeHaven team (Yao Yulu, Liu Xinyi, Dai Yanning) is a designer from China Academy of Art whose project BeeHaven was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Grows urban bee homes from scanned tree cavities.
creators.bio_zh: BeeHaven team (Yao Yulu, Liu Xinyi, Dai Yanning) 是来自中国美术学院的设计师，项目 BeeHaven 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 按扫描的树洞形态“长”出城市蜂巢。

creators.name: Peerasin Punxh Hutaphaet
creators.bio: Peerasin Punxh Hutaphaet is a designer from Central Saint Martins whose project GROWinK was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Replaces printer ink with fungal pigments and bacterial spores.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Peerasin Punxh Hutaphaet 是来自中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院的设计师，项目 GROWinK 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 用真菌色素和细菌孢子替代打印墨水。

creators.name: Hang Su
creators.bio: Hang Su is a designer from Politecnico di Milano whose project Phytosphere was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Gives plants robotic bodies driven by their own signals.
creators.bio_zh: Hang Su 是来自米兰理工大学的设计师，项目 Phytosphere 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 给植物装上由其自身信号驱动的机器人身体。

creators.name: Kelpi
creators.bio: Kelpi is a Bristol start-up developing seaweed-derived barrier coatings for paper and card packaging.
creators.why: Lets paper packaging replace plastic films.
creators.bio_zh: Kelpi 是布里斯托的初创公司，研发用于纸张和纸板包装的海藻来源阻隔涂层。
creators.why_zh: 让纸包装取代塑料薄膜。

creators.name: Sealeo (Diana Epel & Emanuele Griccioli)
creators.bio: Diana Epel and Emanuele Griccioli founded Sealeo, which makes seaweed-based thermal packaging for pharmaceutical cold chains.
creators.why: Replaces foam boxes and gel packs with seaweed.
creators.bio_zh: Diana Epel 与 Emanuele Griccioli 创办了 Sealeo，为药品冷链制作海藻基保温包装。
creators.why_zh: 用海藻替代泡沫箱和冰袋。

creators.name: Foamlab
creators.bio: Foamlab, with designer-researcher Elvin Karana, grows lightweight foams from bacterial cellulose.
creators.why: Grows a plastic-foam replacement with bacteria.
creators.role_zh: 生物制造初创公司（与 Elvin Karana 合作）
creators.bio_zh: Foamlab 与设计研究者 Elvin Karana 合作，用细菌纤维素培养轻质泡沫材料。
creators.why_zh: 用细菌“种”出塑料泡沫的替代品。

creators.name: Julian Yasin Buchgraber
creators.bio: Julian Yasin Buchgraber is a designer from FH Joanneum whose project Algae Harvester was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Uses a fridge's waste heat to grow food.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；约安内姆应用科学大学
creators.bio_zh: Julian Yasin Buchgraber 是来自约安内姆应用科学大学的设计师，项目 Algae Harvester 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 利用冰箱废热培养食物。

creators.name: Alejandro Alfaro Enguídanos
creators.bio: Alejandro Alfaro Enguídanos is a designer from EASD Alicante whose project Algee was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Prints furniture from cyanobacteria-made plastic.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；阿利坎特高等设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Alejandro Alfaro Enguídanos 是来自阿利坎特高等设计学院的设计师，项目 Algee 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 用蓝藻生产的塑料打印家具。

creators.name: Judith Antonia Zbanek
creators.bio: Judith Antonia Zbanek is a designer from HTW Dresden whose project Mycelium & Fiber was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Guides fungal growth with woven textiles.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；德累斯顿应用技术大学
creators.bio_zh: Judith Antonia Zbanek 是来自德累斯顿应用技术大学的设计师，项目 Mycelium & Fiber 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 用织物引导真菌生长。

creators.name: Emily Salvi
creators.role: Designer; Bartlett School of Architecture, UCL
creators.bio: Emily Salvi is a designer from Bartlett School of Architecture, UCL whose project The MECC was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Houses methane-eating microbes in a façade.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；伦敦大学学院巴特莱特建筑学院
creators.bio_zh: Emily Salvi 是来自伦敦大学学院巴特莱特建筑学院的设计师，项目 The MECC 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 让“吃”甲烷的微生物住进建筑立面。

creators.name: Joanna Cheng
creators.role: Designer; University of the Arts London
creators.bio: Joanna Cheng is a designer from University of the Arts London whose project AstroFeast was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Designs a living yeast food for space travel.
creators.bio_zh: Joanna Cheng 是来自伦敦艺术大学的设计师，项目 AstroFeast 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 为太空旅行设计活酵母食物。

creators.name: Ye Wen
creators.bio: Ye Wen is a designer from Hunan University whose project Algae-Symbiont was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Brings algae cultures into furniture.
creators.bio_zh: Ye Wen 是来自湖南大学的设计师，项目 Algae-Symbiont 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 把藻类培养融入家具。

creators.name: After Life team (RCA)
creators.bio: After Life team (RCA) is a designer from Royal College of Art whose project After Life was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Designs memorial reefs that support coral life.
creators.bio_zh: After Life team (RCA) 是来自皇家艺术学院的设计师，项目 After Life 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 设计支持珊瑚生命的纪念礁。

creators.name: Paolina Kühr
creators.bio: Paolina Kühr is a designer from Elisava whose project Sea Glass was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Grows glass from diatoms instead of mining sand.
creators.bio_zh: Paolina Kühr 是来自Elisava 设计学院的设计师，项目 Sea Glass 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 用硅藻“种”玻璃，而不是开采沙子。

creators.name: Living Tex'Celium team (University of Stuttgart)
creators.bio: Living Tex'Celium team (University of Stuttgart) is a designer from University of Stuttgart whose project Living Tex'Celium was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Uses living fungus to bio-weld building modules on site.
creators.bio_zh: Living Tex'Celium team (University of Stuttgart) 是来自斯图加特大学的设计师，项目 Living Tex'Celium 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 用活真菌在现场“生物焊接”建筑模块。

creators.name: Lotte Wigman
creators.bio: Lotte Wigman is a designer from Design Academy Eindhoven whose project Negotiating Boundaries was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Designs a building material meant to be shared with marine life.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；埃因霍温设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Lotte Wigman 是来自埃因霍温设计学院的设计师，项目 Negotiating Boundaries 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 设计一种本就打算与海洋生物共享的建筑材料。

creators.name: Arnaud Tantet
creators.bio: Arnaud Tantet is a designer from ECAL whose project Brio was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Lets mealworms carve plastic waste into objects.
creators.bio_zh: Arnaud Tantet 是来自洛桑艺术大学（ECAL）的设计师，项目 Brio 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。

creators.name: Ailton Pereira

creators.why: Ferments agricultural waste into colours.

creators.bio_zh: Ailton Pereira 是来自隆德里纳州立大学的设计师，项目 AIPER 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 把农业废料发酵成颜色。

creators.name: Bence Czibik
creators.bio: Bence Czibik is a designer from Széchenyi István University whose project HyphaL was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Uses mycelium's acoustic damping in a studio speaker.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；塞切尼·伊什特万大学
creators.bio_zh: Bence Czibik 是来自塞切尼·伊什特万大学的设计师，项目 HyphaL 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 在录音棚音箱中利用菌丝体的声学阻尼。

creators.name: Jonne Verheij & Lidewei Reitsma
creators.bio: Jonne Verheij & Lidewei Reitsma is a designer from Studio Jonne Verheij whose project Interwoven was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Makes fungal electrical signals visible and audible.
creators.bio_zh: Jonne Verheij & Lidewei Reitsma 是来自Studio Jonne Verheij的设计师，项目 Interwoven 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 让真菌的电信号变得可见可闻。

creators.name: Monika Brandić Lipińska
creators.role: Designer; Hub for Biotechnology in the Built Environment
creators.bio: Monika Brandić Lipińska is a designer from Hub for Biotechnology in the Built Environment whose project Mycolith was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Uses mycelium to bind lunar and Martian soil.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；建成环境生物技术中心
creators.bio_zh: Monika Brandić Lipińska 是来自建成环境生物技术中心的设计师，项目 Mycolith 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 用菌丝体黏结月球和火星土壤。

creators.name: Boqun Huang
creators.bio: Boqun Huang is a designer from Central Saint Martins whose project GROWN BLUR was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Adapts ikat weaving to algae dyes.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Boqun Huang 是来自中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院的设计师，项目 GROWN BLUR 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 让伊卡织法适配藻类染料。

creators.name: Paula Andrea Molina
creators.bio: Paula Andrea Molina is a designer from Central Saint Martins whose project Printing Herbarium was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Replaces screen printing with living moss.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Paula Andrea Molina 是来自中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院的设计师，项目 Printing Herbarium 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 用活苔藓替代丝网印刷。

creators.name: Jesse Adler
creators.bio: Jesse Adler is a designer from Central Saint Martins whose project Alchemical Mycology was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Develops fungal pigments for textiles and paint.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Jesse Adler 是来自中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院的设计师，项目 Alchemical Mycology 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 为纺织与颜料开发真菌色素。

creators.name: Xuewei Zhao
creators.role: Designer; Central Academy of Fine Arts
creators.bio: Xuewei Zhao is a designer from Central Academy of Fine Arts whose project Mr. Kombucha's Lab was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Opens SCOBY material making to everyone.
creators.bio_zh: Xuewei Zhao 是来自中央美术学院的设计师，项目 Mr. Kombucha's Lab 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 让所有人都能用 SCOBY 制作材料。

creators.name: Annah-Ololade Sangosanya
creators.bio: Annah-Ololade Sangosanya is a designer from IAAC whose project The Purhyphae project was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Feeds textile waste to fungi.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；加泰罗尼亚高级建筑研究院（IAAC）
creators.bio_zh: Annah-Ololade Sangosanya 是来自加泰罗尼亚高级建筑研究院（IAAC）的设计师，项目 The Purhyphae project 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 把纺织废料喂给真菌。

creators.name: Lucrezia Alessandroni
creators.bio: Lucrezia Alessandroni is a designer from Central Saint Martins whose project The Soothing Cup was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Designs an intimate care ritual with helpful microbes.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Lucrezia Alessandroni 是来自中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院的设计师，项目 The Soothing Cup 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 设计与有益微生物之间的亲密照护仪式。

creators.name: Cinzia Ferrari
creators.bio: Cinzia Ferrari is a designer from Central Saint Martins whose project CyanoFabbrica was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Lets cyanobacteria bind objects into form.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院
creators.bio_zh: Cinzia Ferrari 是来自中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院的设计师，项目 CyanoFabbrica 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 让蓝藻把材料黏结成物件。

creators.name: Mycomerge team (Mai Thi Nguyen & Daniela Solueva)
creators.bio: Mycomerge team (Mai Thi Nguyen & Daniela Solueva) is a designer from University of Stuttgart whose project Mycomerge was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Grows every part of a stool.
creators.bio_zh: Mycomerge team (Mai Thi Nguyen & Daniela Solueva) 是来自斯图加特大学的设计师，项目 Mycomerge 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: “种”出凳子的每一个部件。

creators.name: Natalia Piórecka
creators.bio: Natalia Piórecka is a designer from Newcastle University / UCL whose project MYCOsella was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Designs a chair whose life cycle ends in compost.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；纽卡斯尔大学 / 伦敦大学学院
creators.bio_zh: Natalia Piórecka 是来自纽卡斯尔大学 / 伦敦大学学院的设计师，项目 MYCOsella 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 设计一把生命周期以堆肥告终的椅子。

creators.name: Shonali Shetty
creators.bio: Shonali Shetty is a designer from Mesh Labs whose project AeR was selected by the Green Product / Green Concept Award.
creators.why: Bioprints photosynthetic walls for indoor climate.
creators.bio_zh: Shonali Shetty 是来自Mesh Labs的设计师，项目 AeR 入选绿色产品奖 / 绿色概念奖。
creators.why_zh: 为室内气候生物打印能进行光合作用的墙面。

creators.name: Ana Goidea
creators.bio: Ana Goidea is an architect and researcher at Lund University who, with David Andréen, 3D-printed and grew the mycelium column Protomycokion.
creators.why: Combines computational design with living mycelium in architecture.
creators.role_zh: 建筑师、研究者，隆德大学
creators.bio_zh: Ana Goidea 是隆德大学的建筑师和研究者，与 David Andréen 共同 3D 打印并培养了菌丝体柱 Protomycokion。
creators.why_zh: 在建筑中把计算设计与活菌丝体结合起来。

creators.name: Fergus Telfer
creators.bio: Fergus Telfer is a Scottish designer who grew Scobio, a packaging film from gin-distillery waste.
creators.why: Turns distillery waste into bacterial film.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；格拉斯哥艺术学院
creators.bio_zh: Fergus Telfer 是苏格兰设计师，用金酒酒厂废料培养出包装薄膜 Scobio。
creators.why_zh: 把酒厂废料变成细菌薄膜。

creators.name: Maurizio Vrenna
creators.bio: Maurizio Vrenna is an Italian designer who designed The Algae Grower, a home spirulina bioreactor.
creators.why: Makes daily microalgae food a home routine.
creators.bio_zh: Maurizio Vrenna 是意大利设计师，设计了家用螺旋藻生物反应器 The Algae Grower。
creators.why_zh: 让每天吃微藻成为家庭日常。

creators.name: Luca Alessandrini
creators.bio: Luca Alessandrini is a designer who made a violin from silkworm and spider silk composites.
creators.why: Tunes an instrument's sound through biological fibres.
creators.bio_zh: Luca Alessandrini 是设计师，用蚕丝和蛛丝复合材料制作了小提琴。
creators.why_zh: 通过生物纤维调校乐器的声音。

creators.name: Monica Louise Hartvigsen
creators.bio: Monica Louise Hartvigsen is a Danish designer who developed bacterial dyeing of textiles with DTU laboratories and Gabriel Textile.
creators.why: Scales bacterial dyeing towards industry.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；丹麦皇家艺术学院
creators.bio_zh: Monica Louise Hartvigsen 是丹麦设计师，与丹麦技术大学实验室和 Gabriel Textile 合作开发细菌纺织染色。
creators.why_zh: 推动细菌染色走向工业化。

creators.name: Maija Järviniemi & Outi Mustonen
creators.bio: Maija Järviniemi and Outi Mustonen made edible tableware from bacterial cellulose and pine-bark flour at Aalto University.
creators.why: Revives a wartime food with biofabrication.
creators.bio_zh: Maija Järviniemi 与 Outi Mustonen 在阿尔托大学用细菌纤维素和松树内皮粉制作可食用餐具。
creators.why_zh: 用生物制造复兴一种战时食物。

creators.name: Shaina Garfield
creators.bio: Shaina Garfield is an American designer who created the Leaves Biocoffin, a burial shroud seeded with fungal spores.
creators.why: Designs burial as decomposition with fungal partners.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；普瑞特艺术学院
creators.bio_zh: Shaina Garfield 是美国设计师，创作了带有真菌孢子的殡葬裹尸袋 Leaves Biocoffin。
creators.why_zh: 把安葬设计成与真菌伙伴共同完成的分解过程。

creators.name: Yihan Liu & Yang Zhang
creators.bio: Yihan Liu and Yang Zhang designed Coral Reef Rescuer, a robot system for coral restoration.
creators.why: Uses robots as carers for reefs.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；浙江大学 / 南昌大学
creators.bio_zh: 刘一涵与张扬设计了珊瑚修复机器人系统 Coral Reef Rescuer。
creators.why_zh: 让机器人成为珊瑚礁的照料者。

creators.name: Pierre Charreau, Martin Hertig & Pauline Lemberger
creators.bio: ECAL students who turned household cacti into touch-sensitive musical instruments.
creators.why: Makes a prickly plant into an interface people want to touch.
creators.bio_zh: 把家中仙人掌变成触摸感应乐器的洛桑艺术大学学生。
creators.why_zh: 把多刺植物变成人们愿意触摸的界面。

creators.name: Vidhi Mehta
creators.role: Designer; Royal College of Art / Imperial College London
creators.bio: Vidhi Mehta is a designer who created Post/Biotics, a citizen-science toolkit for discovering antibiotics in local soils and plants.
creators.why: Opens antibiotic discovery to students and citizens.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；皇家艺术学院 / 帝国理工学院
creators.bio_zh: Vidhi Mehta 是设计师，创作了在本地土壤和植物中发现抗生素的公民科学工具包 Post/Biotics。
creators.why_zh: 把抗生素发现向学生和公民开放。

creators.name: Isidora Correa
creators.bio: Isidora Correa is a Chilean artist working with extremophile bacteria and lithium extraction; she won the 2026 Falling Walls Art & Science Breakthrough.
creators.why: Proposes microbial recovery as an alternative to extractivism.
creators.bio_zh: Isidora Correa 是智利艺术家，研究嗜极细菌与锂开采，获得 2026 年 Falling Walls 艺术与科学突破奖。
creators.why_zh: 提出以微生物回收替代开采主义。

creators.name: Entangled Others
creators.role: Artist duo (Sofia Crespo, Feileacan Kirkbride McCormick)
creators.bio: Entangled Others is an artist duo using machine learning and scientific data to explore ecology and nonhuman life.
creators.why: Builds interfaces to little-known deep-sea life.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家双人组（Sofia Crespo、Feileacan Kirkbride McCormick）
creators.bio_zh: Entangled Others 是一个艺术家双人组，利用机器学习和科学数据探索生态与非人类生命。
creators.why_zh: 为鲜为人知的深海生命建造界面。

creators.name: Fara Peluso
creators.bio: Fara Peluso is an Italian artist and designer in Berlin who works with algae as a living and material collaborator.
creators.why: Makes algae bioplastic into records and objects.
creators.bio_zh: Fara Peluso 是在柏林工作的意大利艺术家、设计师，把藻类当作有生命的材料合作者。
creators.why_zh: 把藻类生物塑料做成唱片和物件。

creators.name: Kat Austen
creators.bio: Kat Austen is a British artist working on environmental change through sound, sculpture and science.
creators.why: Listens to trees' responses to pollution.
creators.bio_zh: Kat Austen 是英国艺术家，通过声音、雕塑和科学研究环境变化。
creators.why_zh: 倾听树木对污染的反应。
creators.based_zh: 柏林，德国 / 伦敦，英国

creators.name: Ana María Gómez López
creators.bio: Ana María Gómez López is a Colombian artist whose self-experiments merge her body with plant life.
creators.why: Challenges the human–nature divide through her own body.
creators.bio_zh: Ana María Gómez López 是哥伦比亚艺术家，她以自我实验把身体与植物生命融合。
creators.why_zh: 用自己的身体挑战人与自然的二分。

creators.name: iGEM Team Cambridge
creators.bio: The Cambridge student team competed in iGEM, the International Genetically Engineered Machine competition, with a project that crossed synthetic biology and design.
creators.why: An example of how synthetic-biology students framed their work as design and communication.

creators.why_zh: 展示了合成生物学学生如何把自己的工作当作设计与传播来构思。

creators.name: Kazuhito Takadoi
creators.bio: Kazuhito Takadoi is a Japanese artist in the UK who grows the grasses, reeds and branches he weaves into sculptures; he won the 2019 LOEWE Foundation Craft Prize.
creators.why: Makes craft that starts with growing the material.
creators.bio_zh: 高道一人（Kazuhito Takadoi）是旅英日本艺术家，他亲手种植用于编织雕塑的草、芦苇和枝条，获得 2019 年罗意威基金会工艺奖。
creators.why_zh: 让工艺从“种”材料开始。

creators.name: Honoka
creators.bio: Honoka is a Japanese design studio that 3D-prints furniture from a composite of igusa rush grass, the plant used for tatami mats.
creators.why: Revives a vanishing plant craft with digital fabrication.
creators.bio_zh: Honoka 是日本设计工作室，用榻榻米原料蔺草（igusa）复合材料 3D 打印家具。
creators.why_zh: 用数字制造复兴一种正在消失的植物手工艺。

creators.name: Fragmentario (María-Elena Pombo)
creators.bio: Fragmentario is María-Elena Pombo's studio designing materials from food and ocean waste, such as avocado seed and sargassum.
creators.why: Combines two waste streams into a building material.
creators.bio_zh: Fragmentario 是 María-Elena Pombo 的设计工作室，用食物和海洋废料（如牛油果核和马尾藻）设计材料。
creators.why_zh: 把两种废物流结合成建筑材料。

creators.name: Vollebak
creators.bio: Vollebak is a London clothing company known for experimental garments, including a T-shirt made from plants and algae.
creators.why: Designs clothing meant to be buried and disappear.
creators.role_zh: 服装公司（Steve 与 Nick Tidball）
creators.bio_zh: Vollebak 是伦敦的服装公司，以实验性服装著称，其中包括一件由植物和藻类制成的 T 恤。
creators.why_zh: 设计可以被埋掉并消失的衣服。

works.title: MyoTomato
works.description: Students proposed tomatoes engineered to make myoglobin, the iron-rich protein that gives meat its colour and taste, and began inserting a beef-derived gene into tomato plants.
works.description_zh: 学生们提出让番茄合成肌红蛋白——赋予肉类颜色和味道的富铁蛋白——并开始把一段来自牛的基因导入番茄植株。
works.idea_en: A crop can be redesigned to carry the nutrition we now take from animals.
works.idea_zh: 可以重新设计作物，让它承担我们现在从动物身上获取的营养。
works.method: Agrobacterium-mediated transformation was used to insert a myoglobin DNA sequence into the tomato genome.
works.method_zh: 用农杆菌介导转化，把肌红蛋白的 DNA 序列插入番茄基因组。

works.title: Mutua
works.description: A wall panel for the home on which lichen or slime mould grows, acting both as a living artwork and as a biosensor that shows changes in the indoor environment.
works.description_zh: 一种家用墙板，上面生长着地衣或黏菌，它既是活的艺术品，也是显示室内环境变化的生物传感器。
works.idea_en: Let organisms that react to their surroundings become the home's sensor display.
works.idea_zh: 让对环境敏感的生物成为家里的传感显示屏。
works.method: Lichen and slime mould respond visibly to humidity, light and pollution, so their growth patterns on the panel read out indoor conditions (visualised speculatively).
works.method_zh: 地衣和黏菌会对湿度、光照和污染作出可见反应，它们在墙板上的生长形态因此成为室内环境的读数（以思辨方式呈现）。

works.title: Quantworm Mine
works.description: Quantworm Industries is a fictional nanotech wormery on former coal-mining sites in South Wales, where earthworms clean contaminated soil and turn heavy metals into quantum dots for solar panels.
works.description_zh: Quantworm Industries 是一座虚构的纳米技术蚯蚓养殖场，位于南威尔士的废弃煤矿区：蚯蚓净化受污染的土壤，并把重金属转化成可用于太阳能板的量子点。
works.idea_en: A post-industrial landscape can be healed by animals that also become its new industry.
works.idea_zh: 后工业地景可以由动物修复，而这些动物也成为新的产业。
works.method: Builds on research showing that earthworms biosynthesise cadmium telluride quantum dots from metals in soil; the project designs worm miners' tools, starter kits and a speculative supply chain.
works.method_zh: 基于蚯蚓能从土壤金属中生物合成碲化镉量子点的研究，项目设计了“蚯蚓矿工”的工具、入门套件和一条思辨供应链。

works.title: UK 2029
works.description: A set of artefacts, photographs and texts that imagine the United Kingdom in 2029, when biotechnology has become ordinary and is shaped by the country's politics after Brexit.
works.description_zh: 一组物件、照片和文字，想象 2029 年的英国：生物技术已变得日常，并被脱欧后的政治所塑造。
works.idea_en: Speculating on biotech is also speculating on politics: who regulates, who profits, who is left out.
works.idea_zh: 对生物技术的思辨也是对政治的思辨：谁监管、谁获利、谁被排除在外。
works.method: Design fiction: the team produced props and scenarios for everyday biotech products in a near-future Britain.
works.method_zh: 设计虚构：团队为近未来英国的日常生物技术产品制作了道具和情景。

works.title: Beecosystem
works.description: A proposal that links brewing and beekeeping: genetically modified brewer's yeast makes hop beta acids during fermentation, which can flavour beer and also protect honeybees from parasitic Varroa mites.
works.description_zh: 一个把酿酒与养蜂连接起来的提案：转基因啤酒酵母在发酵中产生啤酒花 β-酸，既可以给啤酒调味，也能保护蜜蜂免受瓦螨寄生。
works.idea_en: One engineered microbe can serve two industries and a third species at once.
works.idea_zh: 一种工程微生物可以同时服务两个产业和第三个物种。
