works.method: Brewer's yeast would be engineered with the hop pathway for beta acids, known miticides used by beekeepers.
works.method_zh: 对啤酒酵母进行工程改造，使其带有合成 β-酸的啤酒花代谢通路；β-酸是养蜂人使用的杀螨成分。

works.title: MYCOmmunity Toilet
works.description: A low-cost, waterless, off-grid toilet for under-resourced communities in which fungal mycelium decomposes human waste; when full, the unit is composted and used to grow trees, grasses and crops.
works.description_zh: 一种面向资源匮乏社区的低成本、无水、离网厕所，由真菌菌丝体分解人类粪便；装满后整个单元可堆肥，用来种树、种草和种庄稼。
works.idea_en: Sanitation can be a growth cycle rather than a waste-disposal problem.
works.idea_zh: 卫生设施可以是一个生长循环，而不是废物处理问题。
works.method: Fungal mycelium colonises a biodegradable container and breaks down solid waste into fertiliser without water or power.
works.method_zh: 真菌菌丝体长满一个可降解的容器，在无水无电的条件下把固体粪便分解成肥料。

works.title: Sorbit
works.description: A fully biodegradable diaper made of bacterial cellulose grown on citrus agricultural waste: soft, water-repellent outside and absorbent inside.
works.description_zh: 一种完全可降解的纸尿裤，材料是在柑橘农业废料上培养的细菌纤维素：外层柔软防水，内层吸水。
works.idea_en: Grow a disposable product from waste so it can return to soil instead of landfill.
works.idea_zh: 用废料“种”出一次性产品，让它能回归土壤而不是进入填埋场。
works.method: Cellulose-producing bacteria were cultured on citrus waste, then the cellulose sheets were processed into layered diaper components.
works.method_zh: 在柑橘废料上培养产纤维素的细菌，再把纤维素片加工成分层的尿布部件。

works.title: Apigiene Hive
works.description: A redesigned Langstroth beehive with a fibrous brush holding diatoms from zebra-mussel habitats; bees brush past it on entering, which removes Varroa mites from their bodies.
works.description_zh: 一种改良的朗式蜂箱，入口处设有装着硅藻的纤维刷；蜜蜂进出时擦过刷子，身上的瓦螨就会被清除。
works.idea_en: Design the hive entrance as a grooming tool for the colony.
works.idea_zh: 把蜂箱入口设计成蜂群的“梳理工具”。
works.method: Sharp silica shells of diatoms abrade mites mechanically, avoiding chemical miticides inside the hive.
works.method_zh: 硅藻坚硬的硅质外壳以物理方式磨掉螨虫，避免在蜂箱内使用化学杀螨剂。

works.title: Woocoa
works.description: A biodegradable wool-like textile made from unused Colombian hemp and coconut fibres, softened and bleached with lignin-degrading compounds extracted from oyster mushrooms.
works.description_zh: 一种可降解的仿羊毛织物，原料是哥伦比亚未被利用的大麻和椰子纤维，并用从平菇中提取的木质素降解成分进行软化和脱色。
works.idea_en: Fungal enzymes can do the finishing work that harsh chemicals do in textile mills.
works.idea_zh: 真菌酶可以完成纺织厂里原本由强化学品完成的后整理工序。
works.method: Enzymes from Pleurotus ostreatus break down lignin in the plant fibres, making them softer and lighter in colour.
works.method_zh: 来自平菇（Pleurotus ostreatus）的酶分解植物纤维中的木质素，使纤维更柔软、颜色更浅。

works.title: PseudoFreeze
works.description: A battery-free cooling system for transporting vaccines that uses the ice-nucleating protein of the bacterium Pseudomonas syringae.
works.description_zh: 一种无需电池的疫苗运输冷却系统，利用丁香假单胞菌（Pseudomonas syringae）的冰核蛋白。
works.idea_en: A bacterium's trick for freezing leaves can become cold-chain infrastructure.
works.idea_zh: 细菌让叶片结冰的本事可以变成冷链基础设施。
works.method: The INA (ice nucleation active) protein makes water freeze at higher temperatures; the team built a carrier bag and lab tests around it to keep vials cold without power.
works.method_zh: INA（冰核活性）蛋白让水在较高温度下结冰；团队围绕它做了运输包和实验测试，在无电条件下保持疫苗瓶低温。

works.title: GIY Bio Buddies
works.description: A kit that lets children grow and design their own toys from kombucha leather and mycelium, as an alternative to plastic toys.
works.description_zh: 一套让孩子用康普茶皮革和菌丝体“种”出并设计自己玩具的工具包，用来替代塑料玩具。
works.idea_en: Children can learn material culture by growing their toys instead of buying them.
works.idea_zh: 孩子可以通过“种”玩具而不是买玩具来理解物质文化。
works.method: Kombucha SCOBY cellulose is dried into leather-like sheets and mycelium is grown in moulds; the kit packages recipes and templates.
works.method_zh: 把康普茶菌膜（SCOBY）纤维素晾干成类皮革片材，菌丝体在模具中生长；工具包提供配方和模板。

works.title: Death on Mars
works.description: A proposal for living memorials on a future Mars colony: plants whose genomes store photos, videos, recipes and stories of the dead, released when people interact with the plant.
works.description_zh: 一个关于未来火星殖民地“活纪念碑”的提案：植物的基因组里储存着逝者的照片、视频、食谱和故事，人与植物互动时这些记忆被唤起。
works.idea_en: A plant can become an archive and a grave at once.
works.idea_zh: 植物可以同时是档案馆和墓碑。
works.method: Imagines genome editing plus a synthetic chromosome that encodes computer data in DNA.
works.method_zh: 设想通过基因编辑和一条在 DNA 中编码计算机数据的合成染色体来实现。

works.title: Mycokarst
works.description: For a karst ravine in Kazan, Russia, the project proposes fungi that mineralise calcite into limestone to reinforce the soil and reduce the collapse of roads and houses into sinkholes.
works.description_zh: 针对俄罗斯喀山的一条喀斯特沟谷，项目提出用真菌把方解石矿化成石灰岩，加固土壤，减少道路和房屋陷入塌陷坑。
works.idea_en: Let fungi rebuild the rock that water dissolves.
works.idea_zh: 让真菌重建被水溶蚀的岩石。
works.method: Based on fungal biomineralisation of calcium carbonate; the design maps sites and prototypes fungal-reinforced soil forms.
works.method_zh: 基于真菌对碳酸钙的生物矿化；设计绘制了场地并试制了真菌加固的土壤形态。

works.title: The Other Townsend
works.description: A literal and data portrait of a 'theoretical sibling', built by hand-tracking a family's moods, sleep, texting, genetics and browsing history for seven days.
works.description_zh: 一幅“理论上的兄弟姐妹”的真实肖像与数据肖像：艺术家花七天手工记录了家人的情绪、睡眠、短信、基因和浏览记录。
works.idea_en: Collecting biological and personal data by hand exposes what corporations do silently.
works.idea_zh: 亲手采集生物与个人数据，让企业悄无声息的做法变得可见。
works.method: The artist combined family genetic information with manually logged behavioural data into drawings and a chatbot persona.
works.method_zh: 艺术家把家族基因信息和手工记录的行为数据合成为画像与一个聊天机器人角色。

works.title: Enzer
works.description: A microplastic filter that can be retrofitted to existing washing machines, combining fine filters with a powder that breaks plastic fibres down with enzymes from the bacterium Ideonella sakaiensis.
works.description_zh: 一种可加装在现有洗衣机上的微塑料过滤器，把细密滤网与一种粉剂结合，粉剂中的酶来自能降解塑料的细菌 Ideonella sakaiensis。
works.idea_en: Catch synthetic fibres at home and let a bacterial enzyme digest them.
works.idea_zh: 在家里拦截合成纤维，再让细菌酶把它们“消化”掉。
works.method: PETase-type enzymes from Ideonella sakaiensis hydrolyse PET microfibres captured by the filter.
works.method_zh: 来自 Ideonella sakaiensis 的 PETase 类酶水解被滤网截留的 PET 微纤维。
keywords: ORTA Prize for Bioinspired Textile Processes

works.title: Flora Fur
works.description: A biodegradable, animal-free fur made from the hollow seed fibres of milkweed bound with linen; milkweed and flax grown together also create habitat for monarch butterflies.
works.description_zh: 一种可降解、不用动物的“皮草”，由马利筋种子的中空纤维与亚麻结合而成；马利筋与亚麻间作种植还能为帝王蝶提供栖息地。
works.idea_en: Choose a fibre crop that also feeds a threatened pollinator.
works.idea_zh: 选择一种同时能养活受威胁传粉者的纤维作物。
works.method: Milkweed seed floss is insulating and water-repellent; it is layered onto a linen base to make a fur-like pile.
works.method_zh: 马利筋种絮保暖且疏水，被铺在亚麻基布上形成类似皮草的绒面。
keywords: Stella McCartney Prize for Sustainable Fashion

works.title: Zebra Glass
works.description: Invasive zebra and quagga mussels from the Great Lakes are harvested as the calcium carbonate source for a regional, artisanal soda-lime glass.
works.description_zh: 把五大湖入侵的斑马贻贝和斑驴贻贝收集起来，作为碳酸钙来源，烧制具有地方特色的手工钠钙玻璃。
works.idea_en: Turn an 'othered' invasive species into a local craft material.
works.idea_zh: 把被视为“他者”的入侵物种变成本地的手工材料。
works.method: Mussel shells are cleaned, crushed and calcined to replace mined limestone in the glass batch.
works.method_zh: 贻贝壳经清洗、粉碎和煅烧，替代玻璃配料中开采来的石灰石。

works.title: Culina
works.description: A future kitchen for apartment towers that combines traditional farming and cooking techniques with synthetic biology, including bioreactors and hydroponics built into the home.
works.description_zh: 为公寓楼设计的未来厨房，把传统农耕与烹饪技艺和合成生物学结合起来，家中嵌入生物反应器和水培系统。
works.idea_en: The kitchen becomes a small biofactory shared by residents.
works.idea_zh: 厨房成为居民共享的小型生物工厂。
works.method: Architectural scenarios place microbial bioreactors, fermentation rooms and hydroponic walls into a tower block.
works.method_zh: 以建筑情景的方式，把微生物生物反应器、发酵间和水培墙置入一栋塔楼。
keywords: Hub for Biotechnology in the Built Environment

works.title: LIFEBRIK
works.description: A soil 'brick' with five layers — mineral, carbon, profile, biota and cover — that makes starting an urban garden simple.
works.description_zh: 一块由矿物层、碳层、剖面层、生物层和覆盖层五层组成的土壤“砖”，让城市菜园的起步变得简单。
works.idea_en: Package living soil as a building block for city growing.
works.idea_zh: 把活的土壤打包成城市种植的积木。
works.method: Each layer reproduces a horizon of natural soil, including a biota layer with soil organisms.
works.method_zh: 每一层对应自然土壤的一个层次，其中生物层含有土壤生物。

works.title: Malgae
works.description: Planters made from sargassum, an invasive seaweed washing up on Caribbean beaches, that can be put straight into the soil where they act as fertiliser; sold as learning kits.
works.description_zh: 用马尾藻制作的花盆——马尾藻是大量冲上加勒比海滩的入侵海藻——花盆可直接埋进土里充当肥料，并作为学习套件出售。
works.idea_en: A coastal nuisance becomes a biodegradable container that feeds the plant.
works.idea_zh: 海岸上的麻烦变成可降解、还能滋养植物的容器。
works.method: Dried sargassum is processed into a mouldable material and pressed into planter forms.
works.method_zh: 晒干的马尾藻被加工成可塑材料，再压制成花盆形状。

works.title: Microbial Memories
works.description: The project traces links between microbiomes and terroir in wine and other foods and imagines capturing the flavours and scents of a place through its microorganisms.
works.description_zh: 项目追溯微生物组与葡萄酒等食物“风土”之间的联系，设想通过微生物来保存一个地方的风味和气味。
works.idea_en: A place's taste lives in its microbes, so microbes can carry memories of places.
works.idea_zh: 一个地方的味道藏在它的微生物里，因此微生物可以承载地方记忆。
works.method: Combines microbiome sampling of food environments with speculative preservation and tasting experiences.
works.method_zh: 把食物环境的微生物组采样与思辨性的保存和品尝体验结合起来。
keywords: Science Sandbox Prize for Public Engagement

works.title: Algae Filters for Reusable Masks
works.description: In response to shortages of protective equipment in Ecuador, the designer developed a low-cost method for making effective home-made Covid masks with an algae-based filter.
works.description_zh: 针对厄瓜多尔防护用品短缺，设计师开发了一种低成本方法，用藻类滤芯在家自制有效的新冠口罩。
works.idea_en: In a crisis, a biomaterial recipe people can make at home is itself a design.
works.idea_zh: 危机中，一份人人能在家做的生物材料配方本身就是设计。
works.method: An algae-derived filter layer is cast and inserted into a reusable fabric mask.
works.method_zh: 浇注成型的藻类滤层被放入可重复使用的布口罩中。

works.title: BioBlack
works.description: A natural black textile dye made by the bacterium Janthinobacterium to replace synthetic black dyes, with pop-up shops where customers see garments being dyed.
works.description_zh: 一种由细菌 Janthinobacterium 产生的天然黑色纺织染料，用来替代合成黑色染料，并设想在快闪店中让顾客现场观看服装染色。
works.idea_en: The darkest, most polluting dye colour can be grown by a microbe.
works.idea_zh: 污染最重的黑色染料可以由微生物“长”出来。
works.method: Janthinobacterium produces the dark pigment violacein-related compounds on textiles incubated with the culture.
works.method_zh: Janthinobacterium 在与菌液共同培养的织物上产生深色色素（紫色杆菌素类化合物）。

works.title: Linneo, Nourishing Beauty
works.description: Cosmetic pigments sourced from fungi to replace ingredients such as heavy metals, parabens and phthalates with biological alternatives that nourish and protect the skin.
works.description_zh: 从真菌中获取化妆品色素，用生物来源的成分替代重金属、对羟基苯甲酸酯和邻苯二甲酸酯等，同时滋养和保护皮肤。
works.idea_en: Colour in cosmetics can come from fungal metabolism instead of mined minerals.
works.idea_zh: 化妆品的颜色可以来自真菌代谢，而不是开采的矿物。
works.method: Pigment-producing fungal strains are cultured and their pigments extracted into a make-up palette.
works.method_zh: 培养能产色素的真菌菌株，提取色素制成彩妆调色盘。
keywords: MANA Prize for the Future of Beauty

works.title: DipWrap
works.description: A replacement for plastic shrink wrap on supermarket produce: fruit and vegetables are dipped in a solution that dries into a peelable, biodegradable film.
works.description_zh: 替代超市果蔬塑料收缩膜的方案：把水果蔬菜浸入一种溶液，干燥后形成可剥离、可生物降解的薄膜。
works.idea_en: Make packaging a coating you dip, not a film you wrap.
works.idea_zh: 让包装变成一层蘸上去的涂层，而不是裹上去的薄膜。
works.method: The dip combines agar from red algae, cellulose nanocrystals and carnauba wax.
works.method_zh: 浸液由红藻提取的琼脂、纤维素纳米晶和巴西棕榈蜡组成。

works.title: PermaPak
works.description: A minimally processed biopolymer packaging made from mycelial chitosan and sericin, the protein in silkworm cocoons, designed to biodegrade into a regenerative life cycle.
works.description_zh: 一种经最少加工的生物聚合物包装，由菌丝体壳聚糖和丝胶（蚕茧中的蛋白质）制成，设计为可降解并回到再生循环中。
works.idea_en: Combine a fungal and an insect by-product into a film that composts.
works.idea_zh: 把真菌副产物和昆虫副产物结合成可堆肥的薄膜。
works.method: Chitosan extracted from mycelium is blended with sericin from silk processing and cast into films and pouches.
works.method_zh: 从菌丝体中提取的壳聚糖与缫丝过程中的丝胶混合，浇注成薄膜和包装袋。
keywords: Barilla Prize for Regenerative Living Ecosystems

works.title: MUS(T)GO
works.description: A moss-based water filter that removes harmful microorganisms and retains microplastics from water.
works.description_zh: 一种以苔藓为基础的净水过滤器，可去除有害微生物并截留水中的微塑料。
works.idea_en: A humble plant's structure can do the work of an industrial filter.
works.idea_zh: 一种不起眼植物的结构可以完成工业滤芯的工作。
works.method: Moss tissue traps particles and microplastics in its dense leaflets while its surface chemistry inhibits microbes (as tested by the team).
works.method_zh: 苔藓致密的小叶截留颗粒与微塑料，其表面化学性质抑制微生物（经团队测试）。

works.title: Mosquitoes and Lemons
works.description: Mosquito nets made from lemon rinds, replacing nets treated with chemical insecticides.
works.description_zh: 用柠檬皮制成的蚊帐，替代经化学杀虫剂处理的蚊帐。
works.idea_en: The repellent can be part of the material rather than a chemical coating.
works.idea_zh: 驱蚊成分可以是材料本身，而不是化学涂层。
works.method: Lemon rind, rich in naturally repellent citrus oils, is processed into a flexible biomaterial mesh.
works.method_zh: 富含天然驱蚊柑橘油的柠檬皮被加工成柔韧的生物材料网。

works.title: Power Mutualism
works.description: A wearable that houses cyanobacteria: the body supplies moisture from sweat and breath, and the microbes' photosynthesis generates a small electrical current in return.
works.description_zh: 一种内含蓝藻的可穿戴装置：人体通过汗液和呼吸提供水分，蓝藻的光合作用反过来产生微弱电流。
works.idea_en: Wearables can run on a mutualistic exchange with living microbes.
works.idea_zh: 可穿戴设备可以依靠与活微生物的互利交换来运行。
works.method: A biophotovoltaic cell with cyanobacteria collects moisture from the wearer and converts light into electricity.
works.method_zh: 含蓝藻的生物光伏电池从佩戴者身上收集水分，并把光能转化为电能。
keywords: James Dyson Award 2021 national winner (Mainland China)

works.title: Order of the Biodivine
works.description: A speculative, immersive theatre experience about a future religion that worships interspecies symbiosis in a climate-insecure world.
works.description_zh: 一场思辨性的沉浸式戏剧体验，讲述在气候不稳定的世界里，一种崇拜跨物种共生的未来宗教。
works.idea_en: Ritual and belief are design materials for changing how people relate to other species.
works.idea_zh: 仪式与信仰也是改变人与其他物种关系的设计材料。
works.method: Performance, costumes and a trailer film stage the rites of a symbiosis-centred order.
works.method_zh: 通过表演、服装和预告片呈现一个以共生为核心的教团仪式。
keywords: Science Sandbox Prize for Public Engagement

works.title: Sista-Sis Biodoula Services
works.description: In response to high maternal mortality among African-American women, high-school students imagined a community-supported doula service that includes mRNA therapies.
works.description_zh: 针对美国非裔女性居高不下的孕产妇死亡率，高中生们设想了一种由社区支持、并提供 mRNA 疗法的导乐（陪产）服务。
works.idea_en: Biotech futures should be designed with and for the communities most failed by medicine.
works.idea_zh: 生物技术的未来应当与最被医疗体系辜负的社群一起、并为他们而设计。
works.method: Speculative service design: brand, service blueprint and video around mRNA-based care.
works.method_zh: 思辨性服务设计：围绕基于 mRNA 的护理，设计品牌、服务蓝图和影片。

works.title: Mother Nacre
works.description: A 'plastic heirloom' that encases sentimental plastic objects in biomimetic nacre (mother of pearl), the coating molluscs use to seal off irritants.
works.description_zh: 一种“塑料传家宝”：把有情感价值的塑料物件包裹在仿生珍珠层（珍珠母）里——软体动物正是用这种涂层来隔离刺激物。
works.idea_en: Treat plastic the way an oyster treats grit: seal it and make it precious.
works.idea_zh: 像牡蛎对待沙粒那样对待塑料：把它封存起来，让它变得珍贵。
works.method: Layers of calcium carbonate and organic binder are built up around the object to imitate nacre (process likely lab-based mineralisation).
works.method_zh: 在物件表面逐层沉积碳酸钙与有机黏合剂以模仿珍珠层（工艺可能是实验室矿化）。

works.title: Orbweaver
works.description: A series of interventions — photos, videos and a hacked Roomba that interprets the planar webs of orb-weaver spiders — through which the artist tries to reduce his fear of spiders.
works.description_zh: 一系列干预作品——照片、视频，以及一台被改装来“解读”圆网蛛平面蛛网的扫地机器人——艺术家借此尝试减轻自己对蜘蛛的恐惧。
works.idea_en: Living with another species can start by re-reading what it makes.
works.idea_zh: 与另一个物种共处，可以从重新“阅读”它的造物开始。
works.method: Drawing on Albert Bandura's exposure therapy, web geometries are translated into robot paths and media works.
works.method_zh: 借鉴 Albert Bandura 的暴露疗法，把蛛网几何转化为机器人的路径和影像作品。

works.title: Colores del Rio
works.description: A citizen-science tool that uses unwanted red cabbage from local farms so that young people can test river water for pH changes that signal contamination.
works.description_zh: 一个公民科学工具，利用本地农场废弃的紫甘蓝，让年轻人检测河水的 pH 变化以发现污染。
works.idea_en: Agricultural waste can become a shared instrument for caring for a river.
works.idea_zh: 农业废料可以变成共同照护河流的仪器。
works.method: Anthocyanin pigments from dehydrated red cabbage change colour with pH; they are embedded in a hand-held testing tool.
works.method_zh: 脱水紫甘蓝中的花青素会随 pH 变色，被嵌入一个手持检测工具中。

works.title: BacTerra: Designing Across Scales
works.description: A research project on biomaterials that cut building-industry carbon: inspired by plankton, molluscs and birds that make shells, the team combined clay, Bacillus subtilis and sea-urchin shells in a biomineralisation process.
works.description_zh: 一个关于降低建筑业碳排放的生物材料研究：受浮游生物、软体动物和鸟类造壳的启发，团队把黏土、枯草芽孢杆菌和海胆壳结合，形成生物矿化工艺。
works.idea_en: Borrow the shell-building chemistry of animals to bind building materials at room temperature.
works.idea_zh: 借用动物造壳的化学过程，在常温下黏结建筑材料。
works.method: Bacillus subtilis precipitates calcium carbonate that binds clay with crushed sea-urchin shell.
works.method_zh: 枯草芽孢杆菌沉淀碳酸钙，把黏土与碎海胆壳黏结在一起。

works.title: MyDeCo: MyCological DeComposition
works.description: A textile-recycling process in which Pestalotiopsis microspora, a fungus able to digest plastic, breaks down synthetic textile waste and its microfibres.
works.description_zh: 一种纺织品回收工艺：让能“吃”塑料的真菌 Pestalotiopsis microspora 分解合成纺织废料及其微纤维。
works.idea_en: Send synthetic clothing to a fungus instead of a landfill.
works.idea_zh: 把合成纤维衣物交给真菌，而不是填埋场。
works.method: The fungus is grown on shredded polyester and polyurethane textile waste as its carbon source.
works.method_zh: 以粉碎的涤纶和聚氨酯纺织废料作为碳源来培养这种真菌。

works.title: tHrIVE
works.description: Building on the Hénaff Lab's holobiont research, the team imagines a New York in which the microbes humans need collapse and honeybees are enlisted to re-inoculate the city with life-saving microbes.
works.description_zh: 基于 Hénaff 实验室的全生物体（holobiont）研究，团队设想纽约人赖以生存的微生物崩溃，于是人们请蜜蜂把救命的微生物重新“接种”回城市。
works.idea_en: Pollinators could be carriers of an entire microbial commons.
works.idea_zh: 传粉者可以是整个微生物公共资源的搬运者。
works.method: Speculative campaign: maps of hive routes, subway graphics, PPE and wheat-paste posters for a 2073 Brooklyn Navy Yard.
works.method_zh: 思辨性宣传：为 2073 年的布鲁克林海军造船厂绘制蜂巢路线图、地铁图形、防护装备和街头张贴海报。
keywords: Science Sandbox Prize for Public Engagement

works.title: LilyPad
works.description: A floating food farm for Philadelphia that irrigates with river water and uses endangered freshwater mussels to purify it; early prototypes were tested on a community centre's reservoir.
works.description_zh: 为费城设计的漂浮农场，用河水灌溉，并借助濒危淡水贻贝净化河水；早期原型在一个社区中心附近的水库上测试。
works.idea_en: A farm can double as habitat for the animals that clean its water.
works.idea_zh: 农场可以同时成为为它净水的动物的栖息地。
works.method: Filter-feeding mussels hang beneath a raft planted with crops that take up river water.
works.method_zh: 滤食性贻贝悬挂在种满作物的浮筏下方，作物吸收河水。

works.title: Brio-Kit
works.description: An educational kit in which students raise mealworms and watch them biodegrade polystyrene, learning the worm's life cycle along the way.
works.description_zh: 一套教育工具包，让学生饲养黄粉虫并观察它们降解聚苯乙烯，同时了解虫子的生命周期。
works.idea_en: Caring for a waste-eating insect is a lesson in both ecology and plastics.
works.idea_zh: 照顾一种会“吃”垃圾的昆虫，同时上了一堂生态课和塑料课。
works.method: Tenebrio molitor larvae digest polystyrene with the help of their gut bacteria; the kit provides habitat boxes and guides.
works.method_zh: 黄粉虫幼虫借助肠道细菌消化聚苯乙烯；工具包提供饲养盒和指南。

works.title: Kan Beh
works.description: An organic pesticide against the maize weevil made from the seed of Argemone mexicana and bee propolis, designed to fit traditional Guatemalan farming and protect corn.
works.description_zh: 一种对付玉米象的有机杀虫剂，由墨西哥蓟罂粟（Argemone mexicana）种子和蜂胶制成，融入危地马拉传统农耕，保护玉米。
works.idea_en: Local plants and ancestral knowledge can replace imported agrochemicals.
works.idea_zh: 本地植物与祖传知识可以替代进口农药。
works.method: Seed extract and propolis are formulated into a grain-storage treatment tested against weevils.
works.method_zh: 把种子提取物与蜂胶配制成储粮处理剂，并针对象甲进行测试。

works.title: Urban Vein
works.description: A fictional green footbridge across Singapore that replaces parts of the old city centre, used to critique how green bioeconomy projects can stay human-centred and become covert commercial ventures.
works.description_zh: 一座虚构的、横跨新加坡的绿色人行天桥，取代了老城区的部分区域；项目借此批判绿色生物经济项目如何仍以人为中心，并悄然变成商业投机。
works.idea_en: Biophilic design can hide the same logic it claims to overcome.
works.idea_zh: 亲生物设计可能掩盖它声称要克服的那套逻辑。
works.method: Architectural visualisation and narrative film present the bridge as an 'ideal ecosophical state'.
works.method_zh: 用建筑可视化和叙事影片把这座桥呈现为一个“理想的生态智慧国度”。

works.title: Shell We Dance?
works.description: Urban waste from eaten eggs and shellfish is turned into a biomaterial and a component-based building system, with moldable blocks and a matching adhesive tested at several scales.
works.description_zh: 把城市里吃剩的蛋壳和贝壳变成生物材料和一套构件化建筑系统，包括可模塑的砌块和配套黏合剂，并在多个尺度上测试。
works.idea_en: A city's food waste can be its next building stone.
works.idea_zh: 城市的食物垃圾可以是它的下一种建筑石材。
works.method: Shells are harvested, ground and bound into blocks; chemical and structural tests guide formulations and reinforcement.
works.method_zh: 收集并研磨贝壳和蛋壳，黏结成砌块；通过化学与结构测试调整配方和加固方式。

works.title: Symbiotic Stitches
works.description: A quilting project made with mycelium, slime mould and lichen that treats care as resilience and asks how humans can practise care with their nonhuman collaborators.
works.description_zh: 一个用菌丝体、黏菌和地衣完成的拼布项目，把照护视为韧性，追问人类如何与非人类合作者一起实践照护。
works.idea_en: Craft traditions of making through hard times can include other species as makers.
works.idea_zh: 在艰难时期延续的手工传统，也可以把其他物种纳入为创作者。
works.method: Quilt panels were inoculated or stitched with living fungi, slime mould and lichen and documented as they grew.
works.method_zh: 拼布面板被接种或缝入活的真菌、黏菌和地衣，并记录它们的生长。

works.title: From the Ashes
works.description: Charcoal from prescribed burns at the Grand Bay National Estuarine Research Reserve in Mississippi is turned into a handmade 'Grand Bay Ink' and an installation about why controlled fire helps the ecosystem.
works.description_zh: 把密西西比州格兰德湾国家河口研究保护区计划烧除后的木炭制成手工“格兰德湾墨水”，并做成装置，讲述受控火烧为何有益生态系统。
works.idea_en: A landscape's own residue can tell its conservation story.
works.idea_zh: 一片地景自身的残余物可以讲述它的保护故事。
works.method: Pine charcoal from managed burns is ground and bound into ink, with GPS-labelled bottles linking each batch to a burn site.
works.method_zh: 把计划烧除得到的松木炭研磨并调制成墨水，每瓶贴有 GPS 坐标，对应具体的火烧地点。

works.title: Salt Minds
works.description: An addendum to the Munsell soil colour system that uses colour as evidence of salt damage to freshwater ecosystems, meant to connect scientists, policymakers and the public.
works.description_zh: 为芒塞尔土壤比色系统增补的一套色卡，用颜色作为盐分破坏淡水生态系统的证据，连接科学家、政策制定者和公众。
works.idea_en: A shared colour language can make an invisible pollutant legible.
works.idea_zh: 一套共享的颜色语言能让看不见的污染变得可读。
works.method: Soil and sediment samples affected by road salt are catalogued and translated into colour chips.
works.method_zh: 对受道路融雪盐影响的土壤和沉积物样本进行编目，并转译成色卡。

works.title: pHen
works.description: A refillable, 3D-printable marker whose ink changes colour with pH, using pigments from bacteria and vegetables such as actinorhodin from Streptomyces coelicolor and anthocyanins from red cabbage.
works.description_zh: 一支可重复灌装、可 3D 打印的马克笔，墨水颜色随 pH 变化，色素来自细菌和蔬菜，如天蓝色链霉菌的放线紫红素和紫甘蓝的花青素。
works.idea_en: One bio-ink, many colours: let chemistry replace a box of single-use markers.
works.idea_zh: 一种生物墨水、多种颜色：用化学反应替代一盒一次性马克笔。
works.method: pH-responsive natural pigments are loaded into an open-source printable pen body with interchangeable tips.
works.method_zh: 把对 pH 敏感的天然色素装进开源、可打印、可换笔头的笔身。

works.title: BIOmatrix: Weaving Sustainability – Reflejos Marinos
works.description: Products and materials made from 'Neptune balls', fibre balls formed by the Mediterranean seagrass Posidonia oceanica that wash up on beaches.
works.description_zh: 用“海神球”制作的产品和材料——海神球是地中海海草波喜荡（Posidonia oceanica）的纤维团，被冲上海滩。
works.idea_en: A beach 'waste' made by a seagrass meadow can become a local craft material.
works.idea_zh: 由海草床形成的海滩“废物”可以变成本地手工材料。
works.method: Beach-cast Posidonia fibres are cleaned, felted and bound into sheets and objects.
works.method_zh: 清洗被冲上岸的波喜荡纤维，经毡化和黏结制成板材和物件。
keywords: Science Sandbox Prize for Public Engagement

works.title: PolyNation
works.description: 3D-printed artificial flowers made mainly from algae-based biomaterial, filled with 'C-Pollen' made from citrus waste, to support native pollinators in cities while native plants recover.
works.description_zh: 主要由藻类生物材料 3D 打印的人造花，内含用柑橘废料制成的“C-花粉”，在城市里支持本地传粉者，直到本地植物恢复。
works.idea_en: Design life support for pollinators, not only for people.
works.idea_zh: 为传粉者而不只是为人设计生命支持系统。
works.method: Algae-bioplastic flowers carry seeds and a citrus-derived pollen substitute and degrade into the soil.
works.method_zh: 藻类生物塑料花携带种子和柑橘来源的花粉替代品，并可降解回土壤。

works.title: Kelserra
works.description: A surgical adhesive modelled on how the brown alga Fucus serratus sticks to wet rocks, aimed at closing internal wounds faster in minimally invasive gynaecological surgery.
works.description_zh: 一种仿生外科黏合剂，模仿褐藻齿缘墨角藻（Fucus serratus）附着在湿润岩石上的方式，用于微创妇科手术中更快地闭合内部伤口。
works.idea_en: A seaweed's wet-grip chemistry can become a medical glue.
works.idea_zh: 海藻在潮湿中抓牢的化学机制可以变成医用胶。
works.method: The formula was tuned for wet adhesion strength, short curing time and biocompatibility.
works.method_zh: 对配方进行调整，以获得更高的湿态黏附强度、更短的固化时间和良好的生物相容性。

works.title: Chornozem
works.description: A low-cost, field-ready way to map heavy-metal contamination left by the Russian invasion in Ukraine's black-earth farmland: a modified curcumin solution mixed into fertiliser changes colour where metals are present, and repurposed drones scan the fields.
works.description_zh: 一种低成本、可在田间使用的方法，用来绘制俄乌战争在乌克兰黑土农田留下的重金属污染：把改性姜黄素溶液混入肥料，遇到金属时会变色，再由改装的军用无人机扫描农田。
works.idea_en: Military tools can be turned toward repairing the ecocide they helped cause.
works.idea_zh: 军事工具可以反过来用于修复它们参与造成的生态灭绝。
works.method: Curcumin reacts visibly with heavy metals under UV light; drone imagery and computer vision turn the reactions into contamination maps.
works.method_zh: 姜黄素在紫外光下与重金属发生可见反应；无人机影像与计算机视觉把这些反应转成污染地图。

works.title: BagasSeries
works.description: A catalogue of biocomposite products made from the sugarcane bagasse thrown away daily by juice stands at Philadelphia's FDR Park Southeast Asian Market, developed with vendors and park users.
works.description_zh: 一套生物复合材料产品目录，原料是费城 FDR 公园东南亚市场果汁摊每天丢弃的甘蔗渣，与摊主和公园使用者共同开发。
works.idea_en: Hyperlocal organic waste can supply the objects a community needs on site.
works.idea_zh: 极其本地的有机废料可以就地供应社区需要的物件。
works.method: Bagasse fibres are combined with non-toxic binders and pressed with low-energy methods into signs and useful objects.
works.method_zh: 甘蔗渣纤维与无毒黏合剂混合，以低能耗方式压制成标识和日用物件。

works.title: Risou (理藻)
works.description: Drawing on Japan's cultural bond with seaweed, Risou proposes symbiotic seaweed-based textiles that change with the wearer and show their environmental impact — vibrant when ecological duties are met.
works.description_zh: 借助日本与海藻的文化联系，Risou 提出以海藻为基础的共生纺织品，它们随穿着者变化，并显示其环境影响——履行生态责任时色彩鲜艳。
works.idea_en: Clothes could be a visible record of how we treat the sea.
works.idea_zh: 衣服可以是我们如何对待海洋的可见记录。
works.method: Seaweed-derived threads are spun, 3D-modelled and woven into speculative garments.
works.method_zh: 用海藻来源的纤维纺线，经 3D 建模后织成思辨服装。
keywords: Terra Prize for Outstanding Digital Submission

works.title: BioMandate 2045
works.description: A narrative strategy game in which the player directs a Global Biotech Regulation Agency and decides which innovations — gene editing, synthetic organisms, neural implants — get approved.
works.description_zh: 一款叙事策略游戏，玩家担任“全球生物技术监管局”局长，决定基因编辑、合成生物、神经植入等创新是否获批。
works.idea_en: Governance, not only invention, shapes biotech futures — and it can be played.
works.idea_zh: 塑造生物技术未来的不只是发明，还有治理——而治理可以被“玩”出来。
works.method: Players manage limited resources, investigate risks and balance governments, corporations and the public; each choice shifts global trust.
works.method_zh: 玩家管理有限资源、调查风险、平衡政府、企业与公众的诉求；每个选择都会影响全球信任度。

works.title: From Flood to Future
works.description: A speculative project on resilience in Mediterranean regions after the 2024 DANA floods in Valencia, proposing mycelium pavements, raised zones, a civic early-warning app and distributed governance.
works.description_zh: 一个关于地中海地区韧性的思辨项目，回应 2024 年瓦伦西亚 DANA 洪灾，提出菌丝体铺装、抬高区域、市民预警应用和分布式治理。
works.idea_en: Design for floods should open debate about care and responsibility, not only deliver fixes.
works.idea_zh: 应对洪水的设计应当开启关于照护与责任的讨论，而不只是提供修补方案。
works.method: Built from survivors' testimonies; five interventions combine biomimetic surfaces, AIoT sensing and public engagement tools.
works.method_zh: 基于幸存者的证言；五项干预结合了仿生地面、AIoT 传感和公众参与工具。

works.title: Living Records
works.description: Biologically fabricated records — bacterial-cellulose cassette tapes and biofabricated memory circuits — that hold the forgotten histories and unacknowledged labour behind the moon landing.
works.description_zh: 生物制造的“记录载体”——细菌纤维素磁带和生物制造的记忆电路——用来保存登月背后被遗忘的历史和未被承认的劳动。
works.idea_en: Whose memory gets recorded is a design choice, even in the material of the medium.
works.idea_zh: 谁的记忆被记录是一种设计选择，甚至体现在媒介的材料本身。
works.method: Bacterial cellulose sheets are grown, dried and formed into cassette-tape and circuit-like objects.
works.method_zh: 培养细菌纤维素片材，干燥后加工成磁带和电路形态的物件。

works.title: ECO-SKIN
works.description: A bioactive wound dressing made from bacterial cellulose grown by kombucha SCOBY fermentation and enhanced with Manuka honey and acetic acid.
works.description_zh: 一种生物活性伤口敷料，由康普茶菌膜发酵生成的细菌纤维素制成，并加入麦卢卡蜂蜜和醋酸。
works.idea_en: A home fermentation culture can grow a low-cost medical material.
works.idea_zh: 家庭发酵菌种可以长出低成本的医用材料。
works.method: Komagataeibacter xylinus forms a dense, hydrated pellicle that is cleaned, infused and packaged as a moisture-retaining bandage.
works.method_zh: 木醋杆菌（Komagataeibacter xylinus）形成致密含水的菌膜，经清洗、浸渍和包装成保湿绷带。

works.title: SHORE thing
works.description: Bio-beach rocks for the Maldives: one-metre geometric shells of coral sand, coconut coir and a safe bacterium, placed in the intertidal zone to slow currents and let sand build up on eroding beaches.
works.description_zh: 为马尔代夫设计的“生物海滩石”：由珊瑚砂、椰壳纤维和一种安全细菌制成的一米见方的几何壳体，放在潮间带减缓水流，让沙子在侵蚀的海滩上重新堆积。
works.idea_en: Coastal defence can be grown from local sand and degrade when its job is done.
works.idea_zh: 海岸防护可以用本地的沙“长”出来，完成使命后自行降解。
works.method: Microbially induced calcite binds sand and coir in a sand-casting technique that island communities can run themselves.
works.method_zh: 微生物诱导的方解石把沙与椰纤维黏结在一起，采用岛民社区可自行操作的砂型铸造工艺。

works.title: Meat of the Matter: A Flesh Perspective
works.description: A satirical project that provokes reflection on meat eating by proposing that people eat animals normally kept as pets, exposing the line society draws between livestock and companions.
works.description_zh: 一个讽刺项目，通过提议人们食用通常作为宠物饲养的动物，引发对吃肉的反思，揭示社会在牲畜与伴侣动物之间划出的界线。
works.idea_en: Satire can make the arbitrariness of our species categories impossible to ignore.
works.idea_zh: 讽刺能让我们对物种分类的武断变得无法忽视。
works.method: Mock products and a video campaign present the absurd proposal alongside data on emissions and animal welfare.
works.method_zh: 用仿制产品和影像宣传呈现这一荒诞提议，并附上排放与动物福利的数据。

works.title: SquidKid
works.description: An educational toy with a safe bioreactor of bioluminescent Aliivibrio fischeri bacteria that children feed and watch glow, learning to value microbial life.
works.description_zh: 一款教育玩具，内含装有发光细菌费氏弧菌（Aliivibrio fischeri）的安全生物反应器，孩子们喂养它们并观察其发光，学会珍视微生物生命。
works.idea_en: Caring for glowing microbes can teach children respect for invisible life.
works.idea_zh: 照顾会发光的微生物，能教孩子尊重看不见的生命。
works.method: The bacteria glow through quorum-sensing-controlled luciferase when their population is dense and well fed.
works.method_zh: 当细菌种群足够密集且营养充足时，受群体感应调控的荧光素酶让它们发光。

works.title: LAMP-PCR Biosensor for Heavy Metal Detection
works.description: A portable, low-cost biosensor for citizen scientists that detects heavy-metal contamination in urban waterways such as Brooklyn's Gowanus Canal by looking for microbial genes linked to bioremediation.
works.description_zh: 一种供公民科学家使用的便携低成本生物传感器，通过检测与生物修复相关的微生物基因，发现布鲁克林戈瓦纳斯运河等城市水道的重金属污染。
works.idea_en: The microbes already living in polluted water can report on the pollution.
works.idea_zh: 生活在污水里的微生物本身就能报告污染状况。
works.method: Loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) amplifies target genes from environmental DNA without lab equipment.
works.method_zh: 环介导等温扩增（LAMP）在无需实验室设备的情况下扩增环境 DNA 中的目标基因。

works.title: Kerra
works.description: A biodegradable, high-performance textile made from keratin extracted from the large share of wool that farms cannot sell, developed with Bay Area farmers.
works.description_zh: 一种可降解的高性能纺织品，原料是从农场卖不出去的大量羊毛中提取的角蛋白，与旧金山湾区农民合作开发。
works.idea_en: Reconnect material innovation with farms, animals and land.
works.idea_zh: 让材料创新重新连接农场、动物和土地。
works.method: Green-chemistry processing dissolves wool keratin and re-forms it into elastic fibres and films.
works.method_zh: 用绿色化学工艺溶解羊毛角蛋白，再重塑成有弹性的纤维和薄膜。

works.title: I'm Humanity
works.description: A pop song whose chord progression was converted into DNA and inserted into the chromosome of the cyanobacterium Synechococcus, so the music replicates with the living microbe.
works.description_zh: 一首流行歌曲的和弦进行被转换成 DNA，插入蓝藻 Synechococcus 的染色体中，使音乐随活微生物一起复制。
works.idea_en: A living organism can be a recording medium that outlasts humanity.
works.idea_zh: 活的生物可以成为比人类更长寿的录音媒介。
works.method: A cipher based on the codon table turned the chords into a 276-nucleotide sequence, which was synthesised and integrated into Synechococcus; the song was also released as music.
works.method_zh: 以密码子表为基础的密码把和弦转成 276 个核苷酸的序列，经合成后整合进 Synechococcus；这首歌也作为音乐发行。
keywords: S+T+ARTS Prize 2017 Grand Prize – Artistic Exploration

works.title: EDEN – Ethics, Durability, Ecology, Nature
works.description: A long-running art and science project with trees that began with the rebirth of the Biscarosse Elm and grew into works on protecting endangered plant species and communication between trees and people.
works.description_zh: 一个与树木合作、持续多年的艺术与科学项目，始于比斯卡罗斯古榆树的“重生”，之后发展为保护濒危植物以及树与人之间交流的一系列作品。
works.idea_en: Treat a tree as a partner whose survival art and technology can help secure.
works.idea_zh: 把树当作伙伴，用艺术和技术帮助它存活下去。
works.method: Combines plant cloning and propagation with sensors that read trees' physiological signals, in collaboration with botanists and industry.
works.method_zh: 与植物学家和企业合作，把植物克隆繁殖与读取树木生理信号的传感器结合起来。
keywords: S+T+ARTS Prize 2020 Grand Prize – Innovative Collaboration

works.title: Remix el Barrio, Food Waste Biomaterial Makers
works.description: A pilot programme in Barcelona's Poblenou district in which designers learned to turn neighbourhood food scraps into biomaterials, using artisanal techniques and digital fabrication.
works.description_zh: 巴塞罗那波布雷诺区的试点项目：设计师学习把街区的厨余变成生物材料，结合手工技艺与数字制造。
works.idea_en: A neighbourhood's food waste can feed a local craft economy.
works.idea_zh: 一个街区的食物垃圾可以养活本地的手工经济。
works.method: Peer-learning sessions at Fab Lab Barcelona developed recipes (bioplastics, composites, bacterial cellulose) from local food waste and shared them openly.
works.method_zh: 在巴塞罗那 Fab Lab 的同伴学习中，用本地厨余开发生物塑料、复合材料、细菌纤维素等配方，并开放共享。
keywords: S+T+ARTS Prize 2021 Grand Prize – Innovative Collaboration

works.title: Office for Tree Migration (OTM)
works.description: A long-term art and research project on how trees migrate north and uphill as the climate changes, including assisted-migration trials in a Finnish peatland.
works.description_zh: 一个长期的艺术与研究项目，关注气候变化下树木如何向北、向高处迁移，包括在芬兰泥炭地进行的“协助迁移”试验。
works.idea_en: Treat trees as climate refugees and design ways to help them move.
works.idea_zh: 把树当作气候难民，并设计帮助它们迁移的方法。
works.method: Phenological cameras, ecological monitoring and custom hardware and software track trees along treelines; saplings are planted in trial sites.
works.method_zh: 借助物候相机、生态监测以及自制的软硬件，追踪林线上的树木；并在试验点种植幼苗。
keywords: S+T+ARTS Prize 2026 Grand Prize – Innovative Collaboration

works.title: Water-based Digital Fabrication Platform
works.description: A robotic platform that extrudes water-based composites of chitosan, a crustacean-derived polymer, with graded mechanical and optical properties that shape themselves as they dry.
works.description_zh: 一个机器人平台，挤出以壳聚糖（来自甲壳类动物的聚合物）为基础的水性复合材料，其力学与光学性能呈梯度变化，并在干燥过程中自行成形。
works.idea_en: Use water as nature does: as the medium that builds, shapes and later dissolves structure.
works.idea_zh: 像自然那样使用水：让它成为构建、塑形、最终又溶解结构的媒介。
works.method: A multi-chamber extrusion system deposits chitosan-based gels with varying concentration; hydration differences guide self-assembly.
works.method_zh: 多腔挤出系统沉积不同浓度的壳聚糖凝胶，含水量差异引导材料自组装。

works.title: FluidSolids
works.description: A biocomposite made from by-products of renewable raw materials that can replace plastic, metal or wood and be processed with standard mass-production techniques.
works.description_zh: 一种由可再生原料副产物制成的生物复合材料，可替代塑料、金属或木材，并能用常规量产工艺加工。
works.idea_en: A bio-based material only scales if it fits existing factories.
works.idea_zh: 生物基材料只有适配现有工厂才能规模化。
works.method: Organic residues that do not compete with food supply are bound into a composite and moulded or extruded industrially.
works.method_zh: 把不与粮食供应竞争的有机残余物黏结成复合材料，再进行工业化模压或挤出。

works.title: BLP-2000D (Black List Printer)
works.description: A DIY DNA synthesiser built to print only the DNA sequences on the unofficial 'black list' that commercial synthesis companies refuse to make.
works.description_zh: 一台 DIY DNA 合成仪，专门用来“打印”商业合成公司拒绝生产的、非官方“黑名单”上的 DNA 序列。
works.idea_en: Who is allowed to write DNA is a question of access and censorship, not only of safety.
works.idea_zh: 谁有权书写 DNA，不仅是安全问题，也是获取权与审查的问题。
works.method: Low-cost microfluidics make DNA synthesis possible outside industry; the error-prone output produces mutated, harmless versions of blacklisted sequences.
works.method_zh: 低成本微流控让 DNA 合成得以在产业之外进行；容易出错的合成会产生被“黑名单”序列的突变、无害版本。

works.title: Spoiled Spores
works.description: An installation of up to 25 cheeses made with toxic black mould scraped over a year from damp rental homes in Dublin and London, responding to the housing crisis.
works.description_zh: 一件由多达 25 块奶酪组成的装置，奶酪用一年间从都柏林和伦敦潮湿出租屋中刮取的有毒黑霉菌制作，回应住房危机。
works.idea_en: Mould from a tenant's wall becomes an artisanal luxury — and a poisonous gift for the landlord.
works.idea_zh: 租客墙上的霉菌变成手工奢侈品——也是给房东的一份有毒礼物。
works.method: Mould samples collected with tenants were cultured and used as ripening cultures in cheese-making.
works.method_zh: 与租客一起采集的霉菌样本经培养后，被用作奶酪熟成的菌种。

works.title: Sounding Soil
works.description: An art, research and citizen-science project that records the sounds of soil animals, roots and water with needle microphones and shows how soil life sounds different across Switzerland.
works.description_zh: 一个艺术、研究与公民科学项目，用针式麦克风录下土壤动物、根系和水流的声音，展示瑞士各地土壤生命的不同声景。
works.idea_en: Listening to soil makes its hidden life and health audible.
works.idea_zh: 聆听土壤，让它隐藏的生命与健康状况变得可闻。
works.method: Highly sensitive probe microphones inserted in the ground record soil acoustics; a touring container and participatory recordings share them with the public.
works.method_zh: 把高灵敏度探针麦克风插入地下录制土壤声学信号；通过巡回集装箱展和参与式录音向公众分享。

works.title: A Lighter Delicacy
works.description: A proposal to turn chicken-feather waste from slaughterhouses into a new edible product, since feathers are about 91% keratin protein.
works.description_zh: 一个把屠宰场的鸡毛废料变成新型食品的提案——鸡毛约 91% 由角蛋白构成。
works.idea_en: Question what counts as food by treating slaughter waste as an ingredient.
works.idea_zh: 把屠宰废料当作食材，追问什么才算食物。
works.method: Feathers are hydrolysed to break keratin into digestible peptides and amino acids, then formed into a food product.
works.method_zh: 对羽毛进行水解，把角蛋白分解成可消化的肽和氨基酸，再制成食品。

works.title: mEat me
works.description: An artistic research project and performance in which the artist proposes her own body as material and food, growing tissue from her cells and serving it in a staged tasting.
works.description_zh: 一个艺术研究与表演项目：艺术家把自己的身体作为材料和食物，用自己的细胞培养组织，并在一场表演中供人品尝。
works.idea_en: If humans treat animals as material, the logic should apply to humans too.
works.idea_zh: 如果人类把动物当作材料，这套逻辑也应当适用于人类自己。
works.method: Cells taken from the artist's body were cultured in the lab into a small 'meat' sample presented in a performance at Kapelica Gallery.
works.method_zh: 从艺术家身体上获取的细胞在实验室中培养成少量“肉”样本，并在卡佩利卡画廊的表演中展示。

works.title: Living Light
works.description: A lamp powered by the living plant and soil bacteria inside it; the light turns on when you touch the plant.
works.description_zh: 一盏由其中的活植物和土壤细菌供电的灯；触摸植物时灯就会亮起。
works.idea_en: Everyday electricity could come from the microbes around a plant's roots.
works.idea_zh: 日常用电可以来自植物根系周围的微生物。
works.method: A plant microbial fuel cell: bacteria in the soil break down organic compounds released by roots and release electrons that are harvested by electrodes.
works.method_zh: 植物微生物燃料电池：土壤中的细菌分解根系释放的有机物并释放电子，由电极收集发电。

works.title: Project Habitate
works.description: A living wearable that lets people host the mosses, lichens and fungi losing their home as ash dieback kills Europe's ash trees, until new ash populations grow back.
works.description_zh: 一件活体可穿戴装置，让人们为因白蜡树枯梢病而失去家园的苔藓、地衣和真菌提供栖身之处，直到新的白蜡树长起来。
works.idea_en: Humans can provide ecological services as hosts for endangered organisms.
works.idea_zh: 人类可以作为濒危生物的宿主，提供生态服务。
works.method: A biomimetic material mimicking ash bark supports moss, lichen and fungal cultures on the body.
works.method_zh: 一种模仿白蜡树皮的仿生材料，让苔藓、地衣和真菌在人体上生长。

works.title: MycoMythologies
works.description: A series of biotechnological installations and myths asking how fungal networks can help humans think and practise multispecies survival in capitalist ruins.
works.description_zh: 一组生物技术装置与神话，追问真菌网络如何帮助人类在资本主义废墟中思考并实践多物种生存。
works.idea_en: Let fungal ontologies teach inclusion and care.
works.idea_zh: 让真菌的存在方式教会我们包容与照护。
works.method: Living mycelium in custom installations (Rupture, Patterning) is coupled with sensors and machines that translate its growth.
works.method_zh: 在定制装置（Rupture、Patterning）中培养活菌丝体，并与传感器和机器耦合，转译其生长。

works.title: Inanimate Species
works.description: An installation that sets the history of microprocessors since the Intel 4004 (1971) against the collapse of wildlife populations over the same decades, using insects and chips side by side.
works.description_zh: 一件装置，把自 1971 年 Intel 4004 以来的微处理器发展史，与同一时期野生动物数量的锐减并置，昆虫与芯片并排陈列。
works.idea_en: The rise of computation and the loss of species may be two sides of one story.
works.idea_zh: 计算的兴起与物种的消失可能是同一个故事的两面。
works.method: Insect specimens are paired with microprocessors by year, building a timeline of correlation.
works.method_zh: 按年份把昆虫标本与微处理器一一对应，构成一条相关性时间线。

works.title: The Plant Intelligence Plan
works.description: An ecological art project that recognises the initiative and rights of plants and uses biotechnology tools to restore relationships between commercially bred crops and animals.
works.description_zh: 一个生态艺术项目，承认植物的主动性和权利，并用生物技术工具修复商业化育种作物与动物之间被人类割裂的关系。
works.idea_en: Restore relationships between species, not only habitats.
works.idea_zh: 修复的是物种之间的关系，而不只是栖息地。
works.method: Based on plant-intelligence research, the work reintroduces signals and materials through which crops and animals interact.
works.method_zh: 基于植物智能研究，作品重新引入作物与动物相互作用的信号和物质。

works.title: Quorum Sensing: Skin Flora Signal System
works.description: DIY methods for modifying the skin microbiome so that bacteria produce flower scents when triggered by disease or fever, turning the skin into a diagnostic interface.
works.description_zh: 用 DIY 方法改造皮肤微生物组，使细菌在疾病或发烧的触发下产生花香，把皮肤变成诊断界面。
works.idea_en: The skin microbiome can be a terminal that smells when something is wrong.
works.idea_zh: 皮肤微生物组可以成为一个在出问题时会“发出气味”的终端。
works.method: Skin bacteria are engineered with plant scent genes under disease-responsive promoters (quorum-sensing logic).
works.method_zh: 把植物香味基因置于疾病响应型启动子（群体感应逻辑）之下，导入皮肤细菌。

works.title: SpreeBerlin – The Voice of a River
works.description: A sensing buoy, app and website that let Berlin's river Spree report its pollution and state to citizens, giving the river a 'political' voice.
works.description_zh: 一个由传感浮标、应用和网站组成的系统，让柏林施普雷河向市民报告自身的污染与状态，赋予河流“政治”声音。
works.idea_en: A river can speak for itself if we build it a microphone.
works.idea_zh: 只要为河流造一个“麦克风”，它就能为自己说话。
works.method: Measuring devices on a buoy record water quality and stream it to an accessible public interface.
works.method_zh: 浮标上的测量设备记录水质，并实时推送到易于理解的公共界面。

works.title: Between the Lines
works.description: Stories of people subjected to the UK border regime are encoded in synthetic DNA and slipped back into the bureaucratic paperwork that governs them.
works.description_zh: 受英国边境制度管控之人的个人故事被编码进合成 DNA，再悄悄放回管理他们的官僚文书之中。
works.idea_en: DNA storage can smuggle human experience into systems that reduce people to risk scores.
works.idea_zh: DNA 存储可以把人的经验“夹带”进那些把人简化为风险分数的系统里。
works.method: Testimonies are converted to DNA sequences, synthesised and mixed into ink used on administrative forms.
works.method_zh: 把证言转换成 DNA 序列并合成，再混入用于填写行政表格的墨水中。

works.title: CLIMAVORE
works.description: A long-term project on how to eat as humans change climates; in Skye and Raasay it helps shift from salmon farming to seaweed and shellfish that clean the water, with an intertidal table that becomes a habitat at high tide.
works.description_zh: 一个长期项目，探讨在人类改变气候的时代该如何饮食；在斯凯岛和拉赛岛，它推动从三文鱼养殖转向能净化水体的海藻和贝类，并设计了一张涨潮时会变成栖息地的潮间带餐桌。
works.idea_en: A diet can be designed to repair the habitats that feed it.
works.idea_zh: 饮食可以被设计成修复供养它的栖息地。
works.method: Menus, installations and partnerships with farmers and restaurants promote filter feeders in polluted waters and drought-resistant crops.
works.method_zh: 通过菜单、装置以及与农民和餐馆的合作，推广能在污染水体中生长的滤食性生物和耐旱作物。

works.title: Turba Tol Hol-Hol Tol
works.description: The Chilean Pavilion at the 2022 Venice Biennale: a chant-like tribute to the peatlands of Tierra del Fuego and their Sphagnum mosses, linked to the resurgence of Selk'nam culture.
works.description_zh: 2022 年威尼斯双年展智利馆：一首向火地岛泥炭地及其泥炭藓致敬的“颂歌”，并与塞尔克南文化的复兴相连。
works.idea_en: Care for a wetland can be practised through art, language and science together.
works.idea_zh: 对湿地的照护可以通过艺术、语言与科学共同实践。
works.method: An immersive installation, the SphagnumLAB, residencies in the bog and research with scientists and Selk'nam community members.
works.method_zh: 包括沉浸式装置、SphagnumLAB、泥炭地驻留，以及与科学家和塞尔克南社群成员的研究合作。

works.title: The (m)Otherhood of Meep (the bat translator)
works.description: An AI interpreter that turns the calls of grey-headed flying foxes into poetic text in real time, drawing on the artist's experience as a bat rescuer.
works.description_zh: 一个人工智能“翻译器”，把灰头狐蝠的叫声实时转成诗意的文字；作品源于艺术家作为蝙蝠救护志愿者的经历。
works.idea_en: Translation between species can be poetic rather than literal, and still build empathy.
works.idea_zh: 物种之间的翻译可以是诗意的而非字面的，同样能建立共情。
works.method: A machine-learning model trained on categorised flying-fox vocalisations maps calls to phrases, displayed via TensorFlow visuals.
works.method_zh: 用分类整理的狐蝠叫声训练机器学习模型，把叫声映射为短语，并以 TensorFlow 可视化呈现。

works.title: Korallysis
works.description: A hybrid organism of ceramic segments and coral colonies on the seabed that harvests energy from currents and waves to drive electrolysis, which accretes minerals and speeds coral growth.
works.description_zh: 一个由陶瓷构件与珊瑚群落组成的混合“生物体”，安放在海底，从洋流和波浪中获取能量驱动电解，使矿物沉积、加速珊瑚生长。
works.idea_en: A machine and a coral colony can live in mutual benefit.
works.idea_zh: 机器与珊瑚群落可以互利共生。
works.method: Kinetic generators power mineral accretion (calcium carbonate) on the ceramic structure, which also shelters juvenile fish.
works.method_zh: 动能发电装置驱动碳酸钙在陶瓷结构上沉积，这个结构同时为幼鱼提供庇护。

works.title: METABOLICA
works.description: An exhibition in five chapters in which algae and bacteria make, digest and remake sculptures from PHB bioplastic, telling a story from whaling and oil to future biochemistry.
works.description_zh: 一个分为五章的展览：藻类和细菌制造、消化、再制造 PHB 生物塑料雕塑，讲述从捕鲸、石油到未来生物化学的故事。
works.idea_en: Living organisms can be both the quarry and the chisel of sculpture.
works.idea_zh: 活的生物可以同时是雕塑的“采石场”和“凿子”。
works.method: Bacteria metabolise fatty acids from algae into polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB), which is cast into sculptures that other microbes later degrade.
works.method_zh: 细菌把藻类中的脂肪酸代谢成聚羟基丁酸酯（PHB），浇铸成雕塑，之后又被其他微生物降解。

works.title: The Urban Biotope
works.description: 15 cm thick concrete façade screens cast in ice formwork, whose deep cells give plants, insects and nesting birds a habitat around the building while absorbing noise and regulating heat.
works.description_zh: 用冰模板浇筑的 15 厘米厚混凝土立面屏风，深邃的孔腔为植物、昆虫和筑巢鸟类提供栖息地，同时吸收噪声、调节温度。
works.idea_en: A façade can be designed as an ecosystem shared with other species.
works.idea_zh: 建筑立面可以被设计成与其他物种共享的生态系统。
works.method: Ice waste from urban infrastructure is shaped into moulds that melt away, leaving complex cavities in the cast concrete.
works.method_zh: 把城市基础设施产生的废冰塑造成模具，融化后在浇筑的混凝土中留下复杂孔腔。

works.title: Computational Compost
works.description: A prototype that uses the heat emitted by computers running simulations of the universe's origin to power a vermicomposting machine with live worms and microorganisms.
works.description_zh: 一个原型装置，把运行宇宙起源模拟的计算机所散发的热量，用来驱动一台装有活蚯蚓和微生物的蚯蚓堆肥机。
works.idea_en: Data infrastructure's waste heat can sustain decomposers instead of being dumped.
works.idea_zh: 数据基础设施的废热可以养活分解者，而不是白白排放。
works.method: Server heat keeps a compost chamber at the temperature earthworms and microbes need, developed with the Donostia International Physics Center.
works.method_zh: 与多诺斯蒂亚国际物理中心合作，用服务器余热维持堆肥箱内蚯蚓和微生物所需的温度。

works.title: Coral Sonic Resilience
works.description: 3D-printed underwater sculptures that play recordings of healthy reefs to degraded coral reefs, using sound to attract fish and coral larvae back to bleached, silent sites.
works.description_zh: 3D 打印的水下雕塑向退化的珊瑚礁播放健康珊瑚礁的录音，用声音把鱼类和珊瑚幼体吸引回已白化、变得寂静的礁区。
works.idea_en: Sound can be a restoration tool, not only a way to represent nature.
works.idea_zh: 声音可以是修复工具，而不只是表现自然的方式。
works.method: Acoustic enrichment, based on research showing that reef sounds draw juvenile fish, is delivered by solar-powered speakers inside sculptural housings.
works.method_zh: 基于“珊瑚礁声音能吸引幼鱼”的研究，由雕塑外壳中的太阳能扬声器进行声学补充。
keywords: Falling Walls Art & Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025

works.title: Seeing Echoes in the Mind of a Whale
works.description: A large audiovisual installation that immerses visitors in the sound-based perception of bottlenose dolphins, humpback whales and sperm whales recorded along the Spanish coast.
works.description_zh: 一件大型视听装置，让观众沉浸在西班牙沿海宽吻海豚、座头鲸和抹香鲸以声音为主的感知世界中。
works.idea_en: Experience the ocean as a world mapped by sound rather than sight.
works.idea_zh: 把海洋当作一个由声音而非视觉绘制的世界来体验。
works.method: Hydrophone recordings and scientific data on echolocation are turned into spatial sound and visuals.
works.method_zh: 把水听器录音和回声定位的科学数据转化为空间声音与影像。

works.title: Lucid Life | Marama Ora
works.description: A living material that encapsulates bioluminescent microalgae, glows when touched and survives on sunlight for at least six months; artefacts were co-created with Polynesian artisans.
works.description_zh: 一种封装发光微藻的活体材料，触摸时会发光，仅靠阳光就能存活至少六个月；相关器物与波利尼西亚工匠共同创作。
works.idea_en: A living material can bring biotechnology out of the lab and into traditional craft.
works.idea_zh: 活体材料可以把生物技术带出实验室，融入传统手工艺。
works.method: Dinoflagellates are embedded in a hydrogel matrix inspired by coral–algae symbiosis; mechanical stress triggers their bioluminescence.
works.method_zh: 受珊瑚与藻类共生启发，把甲藻嵌入水凝胶基质；机械应力会触发它们发光。

works.title: Drumming for Love
works.description: A work that stages the vibrational 'drumming' communication of aquatic insects to investigate how drought is sensed and governed after Piedmont suspended the ecological minimum flow of its rivers.
works.description_zh: 作品呈现水生昆虫以振动“击鼓”交流的方式，探讨在意大利皮埃蒙特暂停河流生态最低流量后，干旱如何被感知与治理。
works.idea_en: The first signals of drought come from other species; listening to them is political.
works.idea_zh: 干旱最早的信号来自其他物种；倾听它们是一种政治行动。
works.method: Contact microphones capture stonefly-style substrate drumming, developed with fishermen, activists and scientists.
works.method_zh: 用接触式麦克风捕捉石蝇类昆虫在基质上的击鼓振动，与渔民、活动人士和科学家共同开发。

works.title: The Singing Textiles: Weaving Life
works.description: Woven textiles with living lichens that respond to humidity, touch and atmospheric change and express those responses as sound, presented as a garden of care and interspecies symbiosis.
works.description_zh: 织入活地衣的纺织品，地衣对湿度、触摸和大气变化作出反应，并以声音表达出来；作品被呈现为一座照护与跨物种共生的花园。
works.idea_en: A textile can be an interface where growth and sensing cannot be separated.
works.idea_zh: 织物可以是生长与感知无法分离的界面。
works.method: Electronic sensing threads measure the lichens' responses and drive a sound system; weaving draws on Andean knotting and computation.
works.method_zh: 电子传感纱线测量地衣的反应并驱动声音系统；编织借鉴安第斯结绳与计算方法。

works.title: FUNGI: Anarchist Designers
works.description: An exhibition that follows fungi as autonomous designers that shape environments — whether humans like it or not — rather than as passive materials for human use.
works.description_zh: 一个展览，把真菌看作自主塑造环境的“设计师”——无论人类是否乐意——而不是供人使用的被动材料。
works.idea_en: Stop treating fungi as material; learn design from how they act.
works.idea_zh: 别再只把真菌当材料，而要从它们的行动中学习设计。
works.method: Drawings, maps and field research trace how fungi transform landscapes, bodies and infrastructures.
works.method_zh: 通过绘图、地图和田野研究，追踪真菌如何改造地景、身体和基础设施。

works.title: Holy Shit
works.description: A theatre work by Stefan Kaegi and Caroline Barneaud about how the bacteria of the human gut influence decisions, shifting the seat of identity from the brain to the belly.
works.description_zh: Stefan Kaegi 与 Caroline Barneaud 的剧场作品，讲述人体肠道细菌如何影响我们的决定，把身份的所在从大脑移到了腹部。
works.idea_en: The self is a multispecies community, and a theatre audience can feel it.
works.idea_zh: “自我”是一个多物种群落，剧场观众可以亲身感受到这一点。
works.method: Documentary theatre combining microbiome science, volcano metaphors and audience participation.
works.method_zh: 结合微生物组科学、火山隐喻与观众参与的纪实剧场。

works.title: Bug's Beat
works.description: An installation that amplifies the footsteps of a small insect through directional speakers and a vibrating chair, so the listener hears and feels each step.
works.description_zh: 一件装置，通过定向扬声器和振动座椅放大小昆虫的脚步声，让听者听到并感受到它的每一步。
works.idea_en: Change the listener's scale and a bug becomes a giant.
works.idea_zh: 改变听者的尺度，小虫就成了巨人。
works.method: Contact microphones under the insect's arena pick up footsteps, fed to directional speakers and vibration transducers.
works.method_zh: 昆虫活动区下方的接触式麦克风拾取脚步声，并输出到定向扬声器和振动换能器。

works.title: Agar Plasticity
works.description: Agar, a gelatinous substance from red seaweed, was dried and foamed into sheets and shock-absorbing forms as a biodegradable replacement for plastic packaging; a perfume bottle was shipped from Tokyo to Milan in an agar box.
works.description_zh: 把从红藻中提取的胶状物琼脂干燥、发泡，做成片材和缓冲结构，替代塑料包装；团队用琼脂盒子把一瓶香水从东京寄到了米兰。
works.idea_en: A food ingredient from seaweed can protect goods and then return to soil or sea.
works.idea_zh: 来自海藻的食材可以保护货物，之后回到土壤或海洋。
works.method: Agar gel is freeze-dried or foamed and moulded; the material biodegrades and can even be used as a soil conditioner.
works.method_zh: 琼脂凝胶经冷冻干燥或发泡后模塑成形；材料可生物降解，甚至可作土壤改良剂。

works.title: Bio-Vide
works.description: Products made from a material formed by pressing and binding layers of fallen leaves, treating seasonal leaf litter as a renewable, biodegradable resource.
works.description_zh: 用层层压合、黏结的落叶制成材料并做成产品，把季节性落叶视为可再生、可降解的资源。
works.idea_en: What a tree sheds every autumn can be a material harvest.
works.idea_zh: 树每年秋天落下的东西可以是一次材料收成。
works.method: Leaves are layered with a binder and pressed into sheets and forms.
works.method_zh: 把树叶与黏合剂层叠后压制成片材和形体。

works.title: Biocraft
works.description: 3D-printed bio-gel scales made from natural biopolymers that absorb CO2 from the air and release nutrients into the soil as they degrade.
works.description_zh: 由天然生物聚合物 3D 打印而成的生物凝胶鳞片，能从空气中吸收二氧化碳，降解时向土壤释放养分。
works.idea_en: A printed object can be designed to do ecological work during and after its life.
works.idea_zh: 打印出来的物件可以被设计成在使用期间和之后都承担生态功能。
works.method: Biopolymer gels are extruded by a printer into scale-like tiles tuned for porosity and degradation.
works.method_zh: 打印机挤出生物聚合物凝胶，形成孔隙率与降解速度经调节的鳞片状构件。

works.title: Coral
works.description: A modular, wall-mounted photobioreactor kit for growing edible microalgae at home as easily as potted herbs; its changing greens make cultivation visible.
works.description_zh: 一套模块化的壁挂式光生物反应器，让人在家像种盆栽香草一样轻松地培养可食用微藻；不断变化的绿色让培养过程清晰可见。
works.idea_en: Make microalgae a domestic crop you can see growing on the wall.
works.idea_zh: 让微藻成为墙上看得见的家庭作物。
works.method: Transparent modules hold spirulina-type cultures lit by daylight; users harvest biomass as it thickens.
works.method_zh: 透明模块里装有螺旋藻类培养液，靠日光生长；藻液变浓时即可收获。

works.title: Chitofarm
works.description: A mealworm-powered biodigester in which mealworms eat polystyrene foam waste; the proposal also used their chitin exoskeletons for biodegradable packaging and the insects as protein.
works.description_zh: 一个由黄粉虫驱动的生物消化器，黄粉虫吃掉聚苯乙烯泡沫垃圾；方案还把它们的几丁质外骨骼做成可降解包装，并把昆虫作为蛋白质来源。
works.idea_en: An insect colony can be a recycling plant, a material source and a farm at once.
works.idea_zh: 一群昆虫可以同时是回收厂、材料来源和农场。
works.method: Tenebrio molitor larvae digest polystyrene with gut microbes; chitin is extracted from moulted exoskeletons.
works.method_zh: 黄粉虫幼虫借助肠道微生物消化聚苯乙烯；从蜕下的外骨骼中提取几丁质。

works.title: Zero Bag
works.description: A water-soluble package made of alginate from seaweed with a film of paper detergent or baking soda attached; the bag dissolves in the wash, leaving no plastic.
works.description_zh: 一种由海藻中的海藻酸盐制成的水溶性包装袋，袋上附有纸片洗涤剂或小苏打薄片；洗衣时袋子会溶解，不留塑料。
works.idea_en: Design packaging that becomes part of how the product is used.
works.idea_zh: 设计能在使用产品时一并“用掉”的包装。
works.method: Sodium alginate film is cast and heat-sealed into bags that dissolve in water.
works.method_zh: 浇注海藻酸钠薄膜并热封成袋，遇水即溶。

works.title: Bee2Bee – Pollination of Monocultures
works.description: A mobile, quick-to-assemble tent-like system for honeybee colonies in monoculture farmland, with sensors that track hive temperature, weight and flight activity.
works.description_zh: 一种可快速搭建、类似帐篷的移动式蜂群系统，用于单一作物农田，内置传感器监测蜂箱温度、重量和飞行活动。
works.idea_en: Pollination services need care infrastructure that moves with the crops.
works.idea_zh: 授粉服务需要能随作物移动的照护设施。
works.method: Sensor data on colony health help beekeepers time treatments without opening hives.
works.method_zh: 蜂群健康的传感数据帮助养蜂人在不开箱的情况下安排处理时间。

works.title: TetraPOT
works.description: A reworked concrete tetrapod sea-defence block that holds mangrove seedlings; as the trees grow, their roots exit through channels, interlock the blocks and form a living coastal defence.
works.description_zh: 一种改良的混凝土四脚防波块，内含红树林幼苗；树长大后，根系从通道中伸出，把各个块体连锁在一起，形成活的海岸防线。
works.idea_en: Grey infrastructure can be a scaffold that living roots gradually take over.
works.idea_zh: 灰色基础设施可以成为脚手架，逐渐被活的根系接管。
works.method: Organic layers inside hollow tetrapods nurture mangroves until roots bind the units together.
works.method_zh: 空心四脚块内的有机层培育红树林，直到根系把各单元连成一体。

works.title: AuREUS
works.description: A translucent panel material with luminescent particles extracted from upcycled fruit and vegetable crop waste, which absorb stray UV light and re-emit visible light onto solar cells at the panel edges.
works.description_zh: 一种半透明面板材料，内含从回收的果蔬农作物废料中提取的发光颗粒，它们吸收散射的紫外光并以可见光形式射向面板边缘的太阳能电池。
works.idea_en: Crops lost to disasters can become windows that generate electricity.
works.idea_zh: 因灾害而损失的农作物可以变成发电的窗户。
works.method: Bio-luminescent compounds from crushed crops are suspended in resin; edge-mounted PV cells collect the re-emitted light.
works.method_zh: 把压碎作物中提取的发光化合物悬浮在树脂中，边缘的光伏电池收集再发射的光。

works.title: Econooc
works.description: A conservation beehive for wild native Irish black bees, grown from mycelium on agricultural by-products to mimic a hollow tree cavity, with a seeded-paper calendar on pollinator-friendly gardening.
works.description_zh: 一个为爱尔兰本地野生黑蜂设计的保护性蜂巢，用菌丝体在农业副产品上生长而成，模仿树洞；还配有一本种子纸日历，介绍对传粉者友好的园艺。
works.idea_en: Grow a habitat that feels like a tree rather than build a box.
works.idea_zh: “种”一个像树洞的栖息地，而不是造一个箱子。
works.method: Mycelium is grown in a mould on straw-type substrates into a thick, insulating hive body.
works.method_zh: 菌丝体在秸秆类基质上于模具中生长，形成厚实保温的蜂巢主体。

works.title: Nemo
works.description: A four-stage service for coral-reef restoration agencies: a planning platform, a transport box for coral fragments and a collaborative drone for outplanting nursery-grown corals.
works.description_zh: 为珊瑚礁修复机构设计的四阶段服务：规划平台、珊瑚碎片运输箱，以及协助移植苗圃培育珊瑚的无人机。
works.idea_en: Scale reef restoration by designing the whole care chain, not a single tool.
works.idea_zh: 通过设计完整的照护链条而不是单一工具，来扩大珊瑚礁修复的规模。
works.method: Service design, product design of transport boxes and an underwater drone concept.
works.method_zh: 包括服务设计、运输箱产品设计和一个水下无人机概念。

works.title: OFlow
works.description: A biofilter for wastewater treatment plants that uses biodegradable scaffolds coated with Pseudomonas fluorescens biofilms to trap small microplastics before effluent reaches rivers.
works.description_zh: 一种用于污水处理厂的生物过滤器，在可降解支架上培养荧光假单胞菌（Pseudomonas fluorescens）生物膜，在出水进入河流前截留细小微塑料。
works.idea_en: A bacterial biofilm's stickiness can be the filter.
works.idea_zh: 细菌生物膜的黏性本身就可以是过滤器。
works.method: Biofilm-coated scaffolds slot into existing treatment stages and capture particles by adhesion.
works.method_zh: 覆盖生物膜的支架可嵌入现有处理环节，通过黏附捕获颗粒。

works.title: Citra, The Bio Leather
works.description: A biodegradable leather-like material made from citrus-peel waste, applied as packaging for a skincare kit.
works.description_zh: 一种用柑橘皮废料制成、可生物降解的类皮革材料，用作护肤套装的包装。
works.idea_en: Fruit peel can become a premium packaging material.
works.idea_zh: 果皮可以变成高端包装材料。
works.method: Citrus peel is ground and bound with natural binders, cast into sheets and dried.
works.method_zh: 把柑橘皮研磨后与天然黏合剂混合，浇注成片并干燥。

works.title: HIIVE
works.description: A beehive designed around the natural behaviour of honeybees and built from sustainable materials, with low-energy sensors that let beekeepers monitor the colony without opening the hive often.
works.description_zh: 一个围绕蜜蜂自然习性设计、用可持续材料建造的蜂箱，配有低功耗传感器，让养蜂人无需频繁开箱即可监测蜂群。
works.idea_en: Design the hive for the bees first and the beekeeper second.
works.idea_zh: 先为蜜蜂设计蜂箱，其次才考虑养蜂人。
works.method: A thick, insulated, tree-cavity-like body houses sensors for temperature, humidity and weight.
works.method_zh: 厚实保温、类似树洞的箱体内装有温度、湿度和重量传感器。

works.title: NLC – The New Life Capsule
works.description: A capsule that co-cultivates microalgae and fungi, releasing a biofertiliser rich in nutrients to boost humus formation and plant growth in arid and degraded soils.
works.description_zh: 一种同时培养微藻和真菌的胶囊，释放富含养分的生物肥料，促进干旱退化土壤中腐殖质的形成和植物生长。
works.idea_en: Microbial partnerships can restart soil life in deserts.
works.idea_zh: 微生物之间的合作可以重新启动沙漠中的土壤生命。
works.method: An algae–fungi consortium grows inside a capsule whose outflow drips into the root zone.
works.method_zh: 藻类-真菌共生体在胶囊内生长，排出液滴入根区。

works.title: Pyrus
works.description: A petroleum-free, wood-like material made from bacterial cellulose left over from kombucha brewing, which can be laser-cut, CNC-machined and sanded like exotic hardwoods.
works.description_zh: 一种不含石油成分的类木材料，由康普茶酿造剩下的细菌纤维素制成，可以像珍稀硬木一样激光切割、数控加工和打磨。
works.idea_en: A brewery by-product can stand in for tropical timber.
works.idea_zh: 酿造副产品可以替代热带木材。
works.method: Kombucha SCOBY pellicles are layered, pressed and cured into dense blocks with wood-like grain.
works.method_zh: 把康普茶菌膜层叠、压制并固化，形成带木纹质感的致密块材。

works.title: Agro Biomaterials
works.description: A kit of ingredients and instructions for making bioplastics at home from organic food waste.
works.description_zh: 一套包含原料和说明的工具包，让人在家用厨余有机垃圾制作生物塑料。
works.idea_en: Material production can be a domestic craft like cooking.
works.idea_zh: 材料生产可以像烹饪一样成为家庭手艺。
works.method: Recipes combine food-waste powders with binders such as starch or gelatin, cast and dried into sheets.
works.method_zh: 配方把厨余粉末与淀粉或明胶等黏合剂混合，浇注干燥成片。

works.title: Bio-Brick
works.description: Masonry units made by binding recycled aggregate with microbially induced calcite precipitation at ambient temperature, without firing or cement.
works.description_zh: 用微生物诱导碳酸钙沉淀在常温下黏结再生骨料制成的砌块，无需烧制或水泥。
works.idea_en: Let bacteria do the binding that kilns and cement do today.
works.idea_zh: 让细菌完成如今由窑炉和水泥完成的黏结工作。
works.method: Urease-producing bacteria and a calcium solution are pumped through moulds of aggregate, precipitating calcite that hardens the brick.
works.method_zh: 把产脲酶细菌和钙溶液泵入装有骨料的模具，沉淀出的方解石使砖块硬化。

works.title: DISPERSEED
works.description: 3D-printed, biodegradable and edible spheres containing native seeds for burned forests; birds and other animals eat and carry them, spreading the seeds after wildfires.
works.description_zh: 3D 打印、可生物降解且可食用的小球，内含本地植物种子，用于火灾后的森林；鸟类和其他动物吃下并携带它们，把种子散播开来。
works.idea_en: Design with seed-dispersing animals as partners in restoration.
works.idea_zh: 把传播种子的动物当作生态修复的合作伙伴来设计。
works.method: Edible biomaterial shells are printed around seed mixes chosen for the burned ecosystem.
works.method_zh: 针对被烧毁的生态系统选配种子，再用可食用生物材料打印外壳包裹。

works.title: Kudarat Bioleather
works.description: A compostable leather alternative made from algae combined with food and fibre waste, designed to be waterproof with good tensile strength.
works.description_zh: 一种可堆肥的皮革替代品，由藻类与食物和纤维废料结合制成，具有防水性和良好的抗拉强度。
works.idea_en: A leather can be made without animals or petrochemicals.
works.idea_zh: 皮革可以不用动物，也不用石化原料。
works.method: Algal biomass is mixed with waste fibres and plasticised, cast and finished into sheets.
works.method_zh: 把藻类生物质与废弃纤维混合并增塑，浇注后整理成片材。

works.title: OXYLON
works.description: An indoor air purifier for public spaces that passes air through a microalgae culture, which takes up pollutants such as CO2 and nitrogen oxides as nutrients.
works.description_zh: 一种用于公共空间的室内空气净化器，让空气流经微藻培养液，微藻把二氧化碳和氮氧化物等污染物当作养分吸收。
works.idea_en: Pollution can be food for a living filter.
works.idea_zh: 污染物可以成为活体过滤器的食物。
works.method: A photobioreactor column bubbles room air through an illuminated algae culture.
works.method_zh: 光生物反应器柱把室内空气鼓泡通过受光照的藻液。

works.title: Biocement Chair (The Essence of Biocement)
works.description: Seating cast from recycled brick aggregate bound by bacterially precipitated calcium carbonate, with no firing, made to communicate biocement research through a usable object.
works.description_zh: 用再生砖骨料浇筑、由细菌沉淀的碳酸钙黏结而成的座椅，无需烧制；它用一件可用的物品来传达生物水泥研究。
works.idea_en: Research materials reach people when they become furniture.
works.idea_zh: 研究中的材料变成家具时，才真正走近人们。
works.method: Sporosarcina pasteurii bacteria precipitate calcite (MICP) through a cast aggregate in successive treatment cycles.
works.method_zh: 巴氏芽孢八叠球菌（Sporosarcina pasteurii）经多轮处理，在浇筑的骨料中沉淀方解石（MICP）。

works.title: Cellsense
works.description: Garment embellishments such as sequins made from algae and regenerated cellulose, including bioluminescent versions, to replace microplastic sequins and glitter.
works.description_zh: 用藻类和再生纤维素制成的服装装饰物，如亮片（包括会发光的版本），用来替代会产生微塑料的亮片和闪粉。
works.idea_en: Even decoration can be biodegradable.
works.idea_zh: 就连装饰也可以是可降解的。
works.method: Algae and cellulose films are cast, cut and coated to produce sparkle and glow.
works.method_zh: 浇注藻类与纤维素薄膜，裁切并涂覆以产生闪光和发光效果。

works.title: O-GA
works.description: Product-design proposal for algae cultivation units in a future renewable-energy countryside, where the algae are processed into bio-oil for vehicles.
works.description_zh: 为未来可再生能源乡村设计的藻类培养装置提案，藻类被加工成供车辆使用的生物燃油。
works.idea_en: Rural landscapes could farm fuel in water rather than dig it from the ground.
works.idea_zh: 乡村地景可以在水中“种”燃料，而不是从地下开采。
works.method: Modular photobioreactor units grow algae whose lipids are converted to bio-oil.
works.method_zh: 模块化光生物反应器培养藻类，再把其中的脂质转化成生物燃油。

works.title: reef dB
works.description: A biophilic metamaterial structure placed around offshore wind turbines that damps underwater operational noise while its form doubles as reef habitat on the North Sea floor.
works.description_zh: 一种放置在海上风机周围的亲生物超材料结构，既能减弱水下运行噪声，其形态又能作为北海海床上的礁石栖息地。
works.idea_en: Energy infrastructure can be designed for the ears and homes of marine life.
works.idea_zh: 能源基础设施可以为海洋生物的听觉和居所而设计。
works.method: Acoustic metamaterial geometry attenuates low-frequency noise and provides crevices for colonisation.
works.method_zh: 声学超材料几何结构衰减低频噪声，同时提供供生物附着的缝隙。

works.title: ALGBIO
works.description: A system that grows microalgae on wastewater and captured CO2, cleaning the water while producing biomass that becomes biofuels, bioplastics and other bioproducts.
works.description_zh: 一个用废水和捕获的二氧化碳培养微藻的系统，在净化水的同时产出生物质，用来生产生物燃料、生物塑料等产品。
works.idea_en: Treat wastewater as a growth medium rather than a disposal problem.
works.idea_zh: 把废水当作培养基，而不是处理难题。
works.method: Photobioreactors fed with wastewater and flue CO2 produce algal biomass for downstream conversion.
works.method_zh: 以废水和烟气二氧化碳供给光生物反应器，产出藻类生物质用于后续转化。

works.title: Carbon Polymerizing System
works.description: An automated system that captures carbon and feeds it to bacteria that ferment it into polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB), a biodegradable plastic.
works.description_zh: 一套自动化系统，捕获碳并喂给细菌，细菌将其发酵成可生物降解的塑料聚羟基丁酸酯（PHB）。
works.idea_en: Captured carbon can become a material instead of being buried.
works.idea_zh: 捕获的碳可以变成材料，而不是被埋掉。
works.method: A capture unit supplies carbon to a bioreactor where PHB-accumulating bacteria grow; the polymer is then extracted.
works.method_zh: 捕获单元向生物反应器供碳，其中积累 PHB 的细菌生长，随后提取聚合物。

works.title: Crikorama
works.description: A compact home machine that manages the whole life cycle of crickets for protein, restarting each generation from the eggs of the previous one.
works.description_zh: 一台紧凑的家用机器，管理蟋蟀从产卵到收获的完整生命周期，用于获取蛋白质，每一代都从上一代的卵重新开始。
works.idea_en: Bringing a whole insect life cycle into the kitchen changes how people relate to the food.
works.idea_zh: 把昆虫的完整生命周期带进厨房，会改变人与食物的关系。
works.method: Chambers for breeding, rearing and harvesting are automated for temperature, feed and water.
works.method_zh: 繁殖、饲养和收获各舱室的温度、饲料和水都实现自动化控制。

works.title: PlantPoxy
works.description: A glue-like culture medium carrying pest-controlling fungi that is coated onto seeds or stems, replacing chemical pesticides with a living biocontrol agent.
works.description_zh: 一种胶状培养基，携带具有防虫能力的真菌，涂覆在种子或茎上，用活的生物防治剂替代化学农药。
works.idea_en: Deliver a living ally with the seed.
works.idea_zh: 让活的“盟友”随种子一起出发。
works.method: Entomopathogenic fungi are embedded in an adhesive nutrient matrix applied as a seed coating.
works.method_zh: 把昆虫病原真菌嵌入有黏性的营养基质，作为种衣剂使用。

works.title: The Reef
works.description: A structure that hosts zebra mussels and optimises their filtering to remove excess agricultural nutrients from water, fighting blue-green algae blooms without chemicals.
works.description_zh: 一种为斑马贻贝提供附着的结构，优化它们的滤水作用以去除水体中过量的农业营养物，用非化学方式对抗蓝藻水华。
works.idea_en: An invasive filter-feeder can be recruited as a water-cleaning partner.
works.idea_zh: 入侵的滤食性动物也可以被招募为净水伙伴。
works.method: Stacked panels maximise surface area and flow for Dreissena polymorpha colonies in affected lakes.
works.method_zh: 层叠面板为受影响湖泊中的斑马贻贝群落提供最大附着面积和水流。

works.title: Hydra
works.description: A modular bioreactor that grows three-dimensional bacterial-cellulose forms directly from waste feedstock, producing wound dressings, biocomposites and textiles such as a grown shoe upper.
works.description_zh: 一个模块化生物反应器，以废料为原料直接生长出三维的细菌纤维素形体，可生产伤口敷料、生物复合材料和纺织品，例如一只“长”出来的鞋面。
works.idea_en: Grow the final shape instead of cutting it from a flat sheet.
works.idea_zh: 直接“长”出最终形状，而不是从平板材料上裁切。
works.method: Cellulose-producing bacteria grow at air–liquid interfaces shaped by the reactor's modular moulds.
works.method_zh: 产纤维素细菌在由反应器模块化模具塑形的气液界面上生长。

works.title: Reef of Hope
works.description: A topologically designed artificial reef made from marine-safe material with upcycled oyster shell, whose geometry improves water flow and helps oyster larvae settle and grow.
works.description_zh: 一种经拓扑优化设计的人工鱼礁，由含回收牡蛎壳的海洋安全材料制成，其几何形态改善水流，帮助牡蛎幼体附着和生长。
works.idea_en: Shape a reef around the larvae that will live on it.
works.idea_zh: 围绕将要在礁上生活的幼体来塑造礁体。
works.method: Computational topology optimisation shapes 3D-printed units; oyster-shell aggregate provides familiar settlement cues.
works.method_zh: 用计算拓扑优化塑造 3D 打印单元；牡蛎壳骨料为幼体提供熟悉的附着信号。
keywords: James Dyson Award 2025 national winner (Hong Kong)

works.title: SoilRevive
works.description: A bioremediation station for heavy-metal-polluted soil that releases microbes to stabilise toxins; units share data and AI times releases according to how plants recover.
works.description_zh: 一个针对重金属污染土壤的生物修复站，释放微生物来固定毒素；各单元共享数据，由人工智能根据植物恢复情况安排释放时机。
works.idea_en: Remediation can listen to the plants it is trying to help.
works.idea_zh: 修复工作可以“倾听”它试图帮助的植物。
works.method: Inspired by Arabidopsis signalling and mycorrhizal networks, networked stations meter microbial inoculants.
works.method_zh: 受拟南芥信号与菌根网络启发，联网的修复站按需释放微生物菌剂。

works.title: Algae Fabrics
works.description: Cellulose is extracted from the cell walls of seaweed that washes up in excess on coasts and spun into a textile yarn, without farmland or irrigation.
works.description_zh: 从大量冲上海岸的海藻细胞壁中提取纤维素并纺成纱线，无需农田和灌溉。
works.idea_en: Beach-cast seaweed can be a textile crop that needs no land.
works.idea_zh: 冲上岸的海藻可以成为一种不占土地的纺织作物。
works.method: Seaweed cellulose fibres are aligned in a liquid bath and spun into yarn.
works.method_zh: 在液体槽中让海藻纤维素纤维取向排列，再纺成纱线。

works.title: Orange Fiber
works.description: A silk-like, biodegradable fibre made from cellulose extracted from the peel and pulp left over from Sicilian citrus-juice production.
works.description_zh: 一种丝绸般、可生物降解的纤维，原料是西西里柑橘榨汁后剩下的果皮和果渣中提取的纤维素。
works.idea_en: Juice-industry waste can become a luxury textile.
works.idea_zh: 果汁产业的废料可以变成奢华面料。
works.method: Citrus cellulose is extracted and spun into acetate-type yarn, developed with Politecnico di Milano.
works.method_zh: 提取柑橘纤维素并纺成醋酸类纱线，与米兰理工大学合作开发。

works.title: Mestic
works.description: Cellulose is extracted from cow manure — already broken down by the cow's digestive enzymes — and processed into bio-based textiles and bioplastics.
works.description_zh: 从牛粪中提取纤维素——这些纤维素已被牛的消化酶初步分解——再加工成生物基纺织品和生物塑料。
works.idea_en: A dairy farm's pollutant can be a fibre feedstock pre-processed by the cow.
works.idea_zh: 奶牛场的污染物可以成为经奶牛“预处理”过的纤维原料。
works.method: Manure is separated, cellulose purified and dissolved, then spun or cast.
works.method_zh: 对牛粪进行分离，提纯并溶解其中的纤维素，再纺丝或浇注成形。

works.title: VEGEA grape leather
works.description: A leather alternative made from grape marc — skins, stalks and seeds discarded in winemaking — processed into coated textiles without heavy metals or toxic solvents.
works.description_zh: 一种用葡萄渣（酿酒丢弃的果皮、果梗和籽）制成的皮革替代品，加工成涂层面料，不含重金属和有毒溶剂。
works.idea_en: Wine's waste can dress the people who drink it.
works.idea_zh: 葡萄酒的废料可以为饮酒的人做衣服。
works.method: Grape-marc fibres and oils are processed into a bio-based coating on a textile backing.
works.method_zh: 把葡萄渣中的纤维和油脂加工成生物基涂层，涂覆在织物底布上。

works.title: Agraloop
works.description: A process that turns food-crop residues such as banana trunks, pineapple leaves, rice straw and oilseed hemp or flax stalks into natural textile fibres.
works.description_zh: 一种把香蕉树干、菠萝叶、稻草以及油用大麻或亚麻秸秆等粮食作物残余物转化为天然纺织纤维的工艺。
works.idea_en: Harvest a second crop — fibre — from what farms currently burn.
works.idea_zh: 从农场如今焚烧的东西中收获第二茬作物——纤维。
works.method: Residues are processed with a low-impact biorefinery into spinnable fibre.
works.method_zh: 用低影响的生物精炼工艺把残余物加工成可纺纤维。

works.title: Algaeing
works.description: Algae biomass formulated into bio-based fibres and textile dyes, with fabrics that the team says release nutrients onto the skin.
works.description_zh: 把藻类生物质配制成生物基纤维和纺织染料，团队称这种面料能向皮肤释放养分。
works.idea_en: Algae can colour and form fabric at once.
works.idea_zh: 藻类可以同时给面料着色并构成面料。
works.method: Algae are grown in closed systems and processed into dye formulations and fibre additives.
works.method_zh: 在封闭系统中培养藻类，再加工成染料配方和纤维添加剂。

works.title: Le Qara lab leather
works.description: Microorganisms fed on Peruvian flower and fruit waste grow a biodegradable leather-like material whose texture, colour and thickness can be tuned during growth.
works.description_zh: 以秘鲁花卉和水果废料喂养微生物，培养出一种可生物降解的类皮革材料，其质地、颜色和厚度可在生长过程中调节。
works.idea_en: Program a material's properties by how you feed the microbes that grow it.
works.idea_zh: 通过喂养微生物的方式来“编程”材料的性能。
works.method: Microbial cellulose grows in trays of waste-based medium and is finished like leather.
works.method_zh: 微生物纤维素在以废料为基础的培养盘中生长，再像皮革一样整理。

works.title: Sustainable Sting
works.description: The hardy, low-water Kenyan giant nettle is cultivated and its stalks processed into a linen-like fabric, with leftovers used for paper and dyes.
works.description_zh: 种植耐旱少水的肯尼亚巨型荨麻，把茎秆加工成类似亚麻的面料，剩余物用来造纸和制染料。
works.idea_en: A wild, drought-tolerant plant can be a textile crop for smallholders.
works.idea_zh: 一种野生耐旱植物可以成为小农的纺织作物。
works.method: Stalks are retted and decorticated to extract bast fibres, then spun and woven.
works.method_zh: 茎秆经沤麻和剥皮提取韧皮纤维，再纺纱织布。

works.title: Galy lab-grown cotton
works.description: Cotton fibre grown from cotton plant cells in bioreactors instead of fields, aiming to cut water, land use and emissions.
works.description_zh: 在生物反应器中用棉花植物细胞培养棉纤维，而不是在田里种植，目标是减少用水、占地和排放。
works.idea_en: A plant product can be grown without growing the whole plant.
works.idea_zh: 不必种出整株植物，也能得到植物的产物。
works.method: Cotton cells are cultured in bioreactors and induced to elongate into cellulose fibres.
works.method_zh: 在生物反应器中培养棉花细胞，诱导其伸长成纤维素纤维。

works.title: BioPuff
works.description: A fibre filler for insulated clothing made from Typha (bulrush) grown on rewetted peatlands, replacing down and polyester fill while restoring carbon-sinking wetlands.
works.description_zh: 一种用于保暖服装的纤维填充物，原料是在再湿化泥炭地上种植的香蒲，替代羽绒和涤纶填充，同时恢复储碳湿地。
works.idea_en: Farm a wetland plant so that growing fashion fibre also restores peat.
works.idea_zh: 种植湿地植物，让生产时尚纤维的同时也在修复泥炭地。
works.method: Typha seed-head fibres are harvested and processed into lofty insulation batts.
works.method_zh: 收获香蒲果穗纤维并加工成蓬松的保暖絮片。

works.title: PLSTC
works.description: Naturally occurring bacteria are bio-engineered to digest polyester and other plastic textile waste into its building blocks and then convert them into edible biomass.
works.description_zh: 对天然细菌进行生物工程改造，使其把涤纶等塑料纺织废料消化成基本单元，再转化为可食用的生物质。
works.idea_en: Plastic clothing could end its life as food.
works.idea_zh: 塑料衣物的生命终点可以是食物。
works.method: Engineered microbes depolymerise PET and use the monomers as carbon for growth.
