works.method_zh: 工程微生物解聚 PET，并以单体作为生长的碳源。

works.title: Rubi
works.description: Industrial CO2 is captured in a cell-free bioreactor where stabilised enzymes turn it into cellulose, which is spun into viscose- and lyocell-type fibres without wood pulp.
works.description_zh: 在无细胞生物反应器中捕获工业二氧化碳，由稳定化的酶把它转化为纤维素，再纺成粘胶和莱赛尔类纤维，无需木浆。
works.idea_en: Make a tree's product without the tree.
works.idea_zh: 不用树，也能得到树的产物。
works.method: An enzymatic cascade inspired by plant photosynthesis builds cellulose from carbon captured at factories.
works.method_zh: 受植物光合作用启发的酶促级联反应，用工厂捕获的碳合成纤维素。

works.title: ALT TEX
works.description: Food waste is fermented into biopolymers that are melt-spun into yarn and woven into a biodegradable alternative to polyester.
works.description_zh: 把食物垃圾发酵成生物聚合物，熔融纺成纱线，织成可生物降解的涤纶替代品。
works.idea_en: Replace fossil polyester with a fermented, compostable one.
works.idea_zh: 用发酵制成的可堆肥“涤纶”替代化石涤纶。
works.method: Microbial fermentation converts food-waste sugars into a polyester-like polymer suitable for melt spinning.
works.method_zh: 微生物发酵把厨余中的糖转化为适合熔融纺丝的类聚酯聚合物。

works.title: KBCols Sciences microbial colours
works.description: Non-GMO natural textile colourants produced by bacteria isolated from India's biodiversity and grown by fermentation instead of petrochemical synthesis.
works.description_zh: 由从印度生物多样性中分离出的非转基因细菌通过发酵生产的天然纺织色素，而不是用石化方法合成。
works.idea_en: A country's microbial diversity is a colour library.
works.idea_zh: 一个国家的微生物多样性就是一座色彩库。
works.method: Pigment-producing bacterial strains are fermented and the pigments extracted for dyeing.
works.method_zh: 发酵产色素的细菌菌株，提取色素用于染色。

works.title: PhycoLabs seaweed fibres
works.description: Textile fibres developed from marine algae to replace fossil-based and land-intensive fibres.
works.description_zh: 用海藻开发的纺织纤维，用来替代化石基和占用大量土地的纤维。
works.idea_en: The ocean can supply fibre without competing with food crops.
works.idea_zh: 海洋可以提供纤维，而不与粮食作物争地。
works.method: Algal polysaccharides are extracted and spun into fibres (process details not public).
works.method_zh: 提取藻类多糖并纺成纤维（工艺细节未公开）。

works.title: Brilliant Dyes
works.description: Phycocyanin and other pigments extracted from cyanobacteria through a low-energy biorefinery, as biodegradable colours for textiles, cosmetics and food.
works.description_zh: 通过低能耗生物精炼从蓝藻中提取藻蓝蛋白等色素，作为可生物降解的颜色用于纺织、化妆品和食品。
works.idea_en: Blue, the hardest natural colour, can be grown by microbes.
works.idea_zh: 最难获得的天然色——蓝色，可以由微生物“种”出来。
works.method: Spirulina-type cyanobacteria are cultivated and their pigment-protein complexes extracted and stabilised.
works.method_zh: 培养螺旋藻类蓝藻，提取并稳定其色素蛋白复合物。

works.title: ArtSilk
works.description: Microorganisms produce spider-silk-inspired proteins that are spun into a high-performance fibre without heat, pressure or harsh chemicals.
works.description_zh: 由微生物生产受蛛丝启发的蛋白质，在不加热、不加压、不用强化学品的条件下纺成高性能纤维。
works.idea_en: Copy how spiders spin, not only what they spin.
works.idea_zh: 模仿蜘蛛如何纺丝，而不只是它们纺出的丝。
works.method: Recombinant spidroin proteins are expressed in microbes and spun in aqueous conditions mimicking the spider's gland.
works.method_zh: 在微生物中表达重组蛛丝蛋白，并在模拟蜘蛛丝腺的水相条件下纺丝。

works.title: Keltex
works.description: Biodegradable leather alternatives made from seaweed farmed along the Tanzanian coast, combining AI-optimised farming with biopolymer extraction.
works.description_zh: 用坦桑尼亚沿海养殖的海藻制成的可生物降解皮革替代品，结合 AI 优化养殖与生物聚合物提取。
works.idea_en: Raise the value of a crop farmed by coastal women.
works.idea_zh: 提升沿海女性养殖作物的价值。
works.method: Seaweed polysaccharides are extracted and formulated into flexible, leather-like sheets.
works.method_zh: 提取海藻多糖，配制成柔韧的类皮革片材。

works.title: MicroBlue
works.description: A biodegradable textile dye brewed by microbial fermentation and formulated to run in existing dyeing machinery.
works.description_zh: 一种通过微生物发酵生产的可生物降解纺织染料，配方可直接用于现有染色设备。
works.idea_en: Biotech colour only scales if mills can use it tomorrow.
works.idea_zh: 生物技术色彩只有在工厂明天就能用时才能规模化。
works.method: Microbes ferment sugars into blue pigment molecules that are concentrated into a drop-in dye.
works.method_zh: 微生物把糖发酵成蓝色色素分子，浓缩成可直接替换的染料。

works.title: Tera Mira
works.description: Seaweed is wet-spun at low temperature and without solvents into a stretch fibre designed to replace elastane, which blocks garment recycling.
works.description_zh: 在低温且不使用溶剂的条件下，把海藻湿法纺成弹力纤维，用来替代妨碍服装回收的氨纶。
works.idea_en: Replace the one ingredient that makes clothes unrecyclable.
works.idea_zh: 替换那一种让衣服无法回收的成分。
works.method: Seaweed-derived polymers are wet-spun into elastic filaments.
works.method_zh: 把海藻来源的聚合物湿法纺成弹性长丝。

works.title: Coral Vita land-based coral farms
works.description: Land-based coral farms that use micro-fragmentation and assisted evolution to grow resilient corals up to 50 times faster than in nature, then outplant them onto degraded reefs.
works.description_zh: 陆基珊瑚养殖场利用微碎片化和辅助进化技术，以比自然快多达 50 倍的速度培育耐逆珊瑚，再移植到退化的珊瑚礁上。
works.idea_en: Restoration can be designed as an industry that grows living infrastructure.
works.idea_zh: 修复可以被设计成一个培育活基础设施的产业。
works.method: Coral fragments fuse and grow in tanks under controlled stress to select heat-tolerant colonies.
works.method_zh: 珊瑚碎片在水箱中融合生长，并在受控胁迫下筛选耐热群体。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2021 winner – Revive Our Oceans

works.title: Sanergy circular sanitation
works.description: Human and organic waste collected from urban sanitation in Nairobi is fed to black soldier fly larvae and composted, producing insect-protein feed and organic fertiliser.
works.description_zh: 从内罗毕城市卫生设施收集的人类粪便和有机垃圾被用来喂养黑水虻幼虫并堆肥，产出昆虫蛋白饲料和有机肥料。
works.idea_en: Design a city's waste system around the insects that can eat it.
works.idea_zh: 围绕能“吃掉”垃圾的昆虫来设计城市的废物系统。
works.method: Hermetia illucens larvae convert organic waste into biomass; residues are composted into fertiliser.
works.method_zh: 黑水虻（Hermetia illucens）幼虫把有机废物转化为生物质，残余物堆肥成肥料。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2021 finalist – Build a Waste-Free World

works.title: Desert Soilization
works.description: Sand is mixed with a paste derived from plant material that binds grains so they hold water and nutrients like soil, allowing crops and grasses to grow on former desert.
works.description_zh: 把沙子与一种植物来源的糊状物混合，使沙粒黏结并像土壤一样保水保肥，让作物和草在原本的沙漠上生长。
works.idea_en: Soil is a structure that can be designed, not only a resource to be found.
works.idea_zh: 土壤是一种可以被设计的结构，而不只是有待发现的资源。
works.method: A cellulose-based binder gives sand particles the constraints that make soil mechanically and ecologically functional.
works.method_zh: 以纤维素为基础的黏结剂赋予沙粒约束，使其在力学和生态上像土壤一样起作用。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2022 finalist – Protect and Restore Nature

works.title: Fleather
works.description: Temple flower offerings are collected before they are dumped into the Ganges and turned into incense, packaging foam and Fleather, a plant-based leather alternative.
works.description_zh: 在寺庙献花被倒入恒河之前把它们收集起来，制成香、包装泡沫以及植物基皮革替代品 Fleather。
works.idea_en: A sacred waste stream can become a material economy that cleans a river.
works.idea_zh: 神圣的废物流可以变成一个清洁河流的材料经济。
works.method: Floral waste is composted and processed; Fleather is made from flower biomass bound and grown with microbial and fungal processes (per Phool).
works.method_zh: 花卉废料经处理后，通过微生物与真菌工艺黏结、生长成 Fleather（据 Phool 介绍）。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2022 finalist – Build a Waste-Free World

works.title: Hutan wildlife corridors
works.description: A community-run programme that reforests corridors along the Kinabatangan river so orangutans, elephants and other species can move again between forest fragments.
works.description_zh: 一个由社区运营的项目，沿京那巴当岸河重新造林形成走廊，让猩猩、大象等物种能再次在破碎的森林之间迁移。
works.idea_en: Design landscapes for the movement of other species.
works.idea_zh: 为其他物种的移动而设计景观。
works.method: Local teams plant native trees and build rope bridges to reconnect habitat patches.
works.method_zh: 本地团队种植本地树种、搭建绳桥，重新连接栖息地斑块。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2022 finalist – Protect and Restore Nature

works.title: LanzaTech gas fermentation
works.description: Carbon-rich industrial off-gases are fed to anaerobic bacteria (Clostridium autoethanogenum) that ferment them into ethanol, used to make fuels, polyester and other products.
works.description_zh: 把富含碳的工业废气喂给厌氧细菌（Clostridium autoethanogenum），细菌将其发酵成乙醇，用来生产燃料、涤纶等产品。
works.idea_en: Pollution can be the diet of a microbe that makes materials.
works.idea_zh: 污染可以成为制造材料的微生物的“饲料”。
works.method: Steel-mill gases (CO, CO2, H2) are bubbled through bioreactors of gas-fermenting bacteria.
works.method_zh: 把钢厂废气（一氧化碳、二氧化碳、氢气）通入气体发酵细菌的生物反应器。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2022 finalist – Fix Our Climate

works.title: Green Gravel
works.description: Small stones are seeded with kelp spores in nurseries and scattered on the seabed, where the young seaweed attaches and regrows kelp forests that store carbon and shelter marine life.
works.description_zh: 在育苗场中让海带孢子附着在小石子上，再把石子撒到海底，幼藻附着生长，重建能储碳并庇护海洋生物的海藻林。
works.idea_en: A handful of seeded gravel is a scalable way to replant an underwater forest.
works.idea_zh: 一把播了种的砾石，就是可规模化重建水下森林的方法。
works.method: Kelp gametophytes are cultured onto gravel in tanks for weeks before outplanting.
works.method_zh: 在水槽中把海带配子体培养在砾石上数周，然后投放。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2022 finalist – Revive Our Oceans

works.title: Aquacycl BioElectrochemical Treatment
works.description: Wastewater treatment that uses naturally occurring bacteria in microbial fuel cells to break down organic pollutants while generating a little electricity.
works.description_zh: 一种污水处理技术，利用微生物燃料电池中的天然细菌分解有机污染物，同时产生少量电能。
works.idea_en: Treatment plants could be power sources run by microbes.
works.idea_zh: 污水处理厂可以是由微生物运转的电源。
works.method: Electroactive bacteria oxidise organics at anodes, transferring electrons through an external circuit.
works.method_zh: 电活性细菌在阳极氧化有机物，通过外电路传递电子。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2023 finalist – Fix Our Climate

works.title: Sea Forest Asparagopsis
works.description: The red seaweed Asparagopsis is farmed and processed into a livestock-feed supplement whose bromoform-rich compounds sharply cut the methane cattle produce.
works.description_zh: 养殖红藻海门冬（Asparagopsis）并加工成牲畜饲料添加剂，其富含溴仿的成分能大幅减少牛的甲烷排放。
works.idea_en: A seaweed can change the climate footprint of another species' digestion.
works.idea_zh: 一种海藻可以改变另一个物种消化过程的气候足迹。
works.method: Asparagopsis compounds inhibit methanogenic archaea in the rumen.
works.method_zh: 海门冬中的化合物抑制瘤胃中的产甲烷古菌。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2023 finalist – Fix Our Climate

works.title: Coast 4C regenerative seaweed
works.description: A regenerative seaweed supply chain built with small-scale fishing communities in the Philippines, giving income while restoring coastal ecosystems and supplying bio-based products.
works.description_zh: 与菲律宾小规模渔业社区共建的再生型海藻供应链，在修复海岸生态系统、供应生物基产品的同时为社区带来收入。
works.idea_en: A supply chain can be designed to repair the coast it draws from.
works.idea_zh: 供应链可以被设计成修复其所依赖的海岸。
works.method: Community seaweed farms, processing and buyer agreements form a traceable chain.
works.method_zh: 社区海藻养殖、加工和收购协议构成可追溯的链条。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2024 finalist – Revive Our Oceans

works.title: Ferment'Up
works.description: Fruit and vegetable skins and seeds from food processing are upcycled by solid-state (dry) fermentation into nutritious food ingredients.
works.description_zh: 用固态（干法）发酵把食品加工产生的果蔬皮和籽升级为营养丰富的食品原料。
works.idea_en: Fermentation can turn by-products back into food.
works.idea_zh: 发酵可以把副产品重新变回食物。
works.method: Selected microorganisms ferment damp plant residues, raising protein and fibre quality.
works.method_zh: 筛选的微生物发酵潮湿的植物残渣，提高蛋白质和纤维品质。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2024 finalist – Build a Waste-Free World

works.title: Mylea mycelium leather
works.description: Fungal mycelium grown on palm-oil and other agricultural waste is processed into Mylea, a low-carbon leather alternative; buying the waste gives farmers a reason to stop burning it.
works.description_zh: 在棕榈油等农业废料上培养的真菌菌丝体被加工成低碳皮革替代品 Mylea；收购这些废料让农民有理由不再焚烧它们。
works.idea_en: A material business can fight air pollution by paying for waste.
works.idea_zh: 材料生意可以通过收购废料来对抗空气污染。
works.method: Mycelium sheets grown on lignocellulosic residues are harvested, tanned-like treated and finished.
works.method_zh: 收获在木质纤维素残余物上生长的菌丝片，进行类似鞣制的处理和整理。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2024 finalist – Clean Our Air

works.title: MiAlgae
works.description: Omega-3-rich microalgae grown by fermentation on whisky-distillery by-products, replacing fish oil in aquaculture feed.
works.description_zh: 以威士忌酒厂副产物为原料、通过发酵培养的富含 omega-3 的微藻，用来替代水产饲料中的鱼油。
works.idea_en: Feed farmed fish without catching wild fish.
works.idea_zh: 不捕野生鱼也能喂养养殖鱼。
works.method: Heterotrophic microalgae ferment distillery co-products in tanks and are dried into feed ingredients.
works.method_zh: 异养微藻在发酵罐中利用酒厂副产物生长，干燥后成为饲料原料。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2024 finalist – Revive Our Oceans

works.title: MIRUM
works.description: A plastic-free leather alternative bound with natural rubber and plant oils instead of polyurethane, from a company whose welding process also fuses natural fibres such as cotton.
works.description_zh: 一种不含塑料的皮革替代品，用天然橡胶和植物油而不是聚氨酯黏结；其公司的“纤维焊接”工艺还能把棉等天然纤维熔合。
works.idea_en: A bio-based material should be bio-based all the way through, including the binder.
works.idea_zh: 生物基材料应当从头到尾都是生物基的，包括黏合剂。
works.method: Natural rubber, plant oils, cork and fillers are compounded and cured on a natural-fibre backing.
works.method_zh: 把天然橡胶、植物油、软木和填料混炼后在天然纤维底布上硫化成形。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2024 finalist – Build a Waste-Free World

works.title: NatureMetrics eDNA monitoring
works.description: Biodiversity is measured from environmental DNA shed by organisms into water and soil; sequencing a sample identifies which species live there.
works.description_zh: 通过生物遗留在水和土壤中的环境 DNA 来测量生物多样性；对样本测序即可识别当地有哪些物种。
works.idea_en: Traces of DNA let many species be counted without seeing them.
works.idea_zh: DNA 痕迹让我们无需看见就能统计众多物种。
works.method: Field kits filter water or soil; lab metabarcoding matches DNA sequences to reference databases.
works.method_zh: 野外采样套件过滤水或土壤，实验室通过宏条形码技术把 DNA 序列与参考数据库比对。
keywords: Earthshot Prize 2024 finalist – Protect and Restore Nature

works.title: Bios Urn
works.description: A biodegradable urn of compacted coconut shell, peat and cellulose that holds cremated ashes together with a tree seed; planted in the ground, it decomposes and the tree grows.
works.description_zh: 一种由压实椰壳、泥炭和纤维素制成的可降解骨灰盒，里面装有骨灰和一颗树种；埋入土中后骨灰盒分解，树苗长出。
works.idea_en: Turn a burial into the start of a tree's life.
works.idea_zh: 把一次安葬变成一棵树生命的开始。
works.method: The upper capsule holds seed and growth medium; the lower chamber holds ashes, separated until roots reach them.
works.method_zh: 上层装有种子和培养基，下层装骨灰，在根系长到之前二者是隔开的。

works.title: 3D Ocean Farming
works.description: Restorative ocean farms that grow kelp on vertical ropes with mussels, oysters and scallops in cages below, needing no feed, fresh water or fertiliser while absorbing carbon and nitrogen.
works.description_zh: 再生型海洋农场：在竖直绳索上养殖海带，下方笼中养殖贻贝、牡蛎和扇贝，不需要饲料、淡水和化肥，同时吸收碳和氮。
works.idea_en: A farm can be designed as a polyculture that improves the water it uses.
works.idea_zh: 农场可以被设计成改善所用水体的混养系统。
works.method: Seeded lines hang from buoys in a vertical water column; species at each depth filter and photosynthesise.
works.method_zh: 播种后的绳索悬挂在浮标下，占据竖直水体；不同深度的物种分别滤食和进行光合作用。

works.title: Sahara Forest Project
works.description: Saltwater-cooled greenhouses, concentrated solar power and desalination are combined to grow food in the desert, while evaporated seawater makes humid zones outside for planting salt-tolerant vegetation.
works.description_zh: 把海水冷却温室、聚光太阳能和海水淡化结合起来在沙漠中种粮，同时蒸发的海水在温室外形成湿润区域，用来种植耐盐植被。
works.idea_en: Couple technologies so each one's by-product feeds the next and revegetates the desert.
works.idea_zh: 把各项技术耦合起来，让每一项的副产品成为下一项的投入，并让沙漠重新长出植被。
works.method: Pilot facilities in Qatar and Jordan integrate evaporative greenhouses, solar and outdoor revegetation plots.
works.method_zh: 在卡塔尔和约旦的试点设施整合了蒸发式温室、太阳能和户外植被恢复地块。

works.title: Seedballs
works.description: Indigenous tree and grass seeds coated in a shell of charcoal dust that protects them from predators until the rains; the balls are scattered by hand, slingshot or aircraft.
works.description_zh: 把本地树木和草种裹进一层炭粉外壳，在雨季来临前保护它们不被动物吃掉；种子球可用手撒、弹弓打或飞机播撒。
works.idea_en: Package a seed so it can wait for the right moment by itself.
works.idea_zh: 给种子一个包装，让它自己等待合适的时机。
works.method: Charcoal dust from waste is bound around seeds; rain breaks the coating and triggers germination.
works.method_zh: 用废弃炭粉包裹种子；雨水使外壳崩解并触发发芽。

works.title: Solein
works.description: A protein-rich food ingredient made by growing hydrogen-oxidising bacteria on CO2, hydrogen from electrolysis and minerals, without farmland.
works.description_zh: 一种富含蛋白质的食品原料，用二氧化碳、电解制氢和矿物质培养氢氧化细菌而成，不需要农田。
works.idea_en: Food can be made from air and electricity.
works.idea_zh: 食物可以用空气和电来制造。
works.method: Gas fermentation of a hydrogen-oxidising bacterium produces single-cell biomass that is dried into a powder.
works.method_zh: 对氢氧化细菌进行气体发酵，得到单细胞生物质，干燥成粉。

works.title: Carbios enzymatic recycling
works.description: An optimised enzyme, derived from one found in compost, breaks PET plastic and polyester textiles down into monomers that can be repolymerised into virgin-quality PET.
works.description_zh: 一种由堆肥中发现的酶优化而来的酶，把 PET 塑料和涤纶纺织品分解成单体，再重新聚合成原生品质的 PET。
works.idea_en: An engineered enzyme can make plastic endlessly recyclable.
works.idea_zh: 一种工程酶可以让塑料无限循环回收。
works.method: A leaf-branch compost cutinase was engineered for thermostability and activity on PET.
works.method_zh: 对叶枝堆肥角质酶（LCC）进行工程改造，提高其热稳定性和对 PET 的活性。

works.title: Flash Forest
works.description: Drones map sites and fire germinated seed pods into the soil to reforest burned and logged land quickly, with pod mixes tailored to native species.
works.description_zh: 无人机测绘场地并把已发芽的种子荚射入土壤，快速为烧毁和采伐过的土地造林，种子组合按本地物种定制。
works.idea_en: Speed and precision in replanting can be designed from the air.
works.idea_zh: 重新造林的速度和精度可以从空中来设计。
works.method: Seed pods with germination aids are fired from drones along mapped planting paths.
works.method_zh: 沿测绘好的种植路径，从无人机上发射含促发芽物质的种子荚。

works.title: BIOMILQ
works.description: Human mammary epithelial cells are cultured in bioreactors to secrete components of human milk outside the body, as an infant-nutrition option closer to breast milk than formula.
works.description_zh: 在生物反应器中培养人类乳腺上皮细胞，使其在体外分泌人乳成分，作为比配方奶更接近母乳的婴儿营养选择。
works.idea_en: Separate a body function from the body and design new forms of care.
works.idea_zh: 把一种身体功能从身体中分离出来，设计新的照护形式。
works.method: Primary mammary cells grow on scaffolds in bioreactors and secrete milk into a collection chamber.
works.method_zh: 原代乳腺细胞在生物反应器中的支架上生长，向收集腔分泌乳汁。

works.title: Great Wrap
works.description: A compostable stretch and cling wrap made from potato waste fermented into a bioplastic that performs like conventional film and breaks down without microplastics.
works.description_zh: 一种可堆肥的缠绕膜和保鲜膜，用土豆废料发酵成的生物塑料制成，性能与常规薄膜相当，降解后不留微塑料。
works.idea_en: Replace a ubiquitous plastic with one fermented from food waste.
works.idea_zh: 用厨余发酵制成的塑料替代一种无处不在的塑料。
works.method: Potato-waste starches are fermented into a biopolymer (PHA-type) blend and blown into film.
works.method_zh: 把土豆废料中的淀粉发酵成生物聚合物（PHA 类）共混料，再吹塑成膜。

works.title: Art Biotop Water Garden
works.description: About 318 trees that had to be uprooted for a hotel development were replanted one by one in a former rice field in Nasu, threaded between some 160 shallow ponds fed by the old paddy water system.
works.description_zh: 为酒店开发而必须移走的约 318 棵树，被一棵一棵地重新种在那须的一片旧稻田里，穿插在约 160 个由原稻田水系供水的浅池之间。
works.idea_en: Architecture can be the careful relocation of a living landscape.
works.idea_zh: 建筑可以是对一片活景观的细致迁移。
works.method: Each tree's position was surveyed and re-planned; ponds and moss re-establish a woodland wetland.
works.method_zh: 逐棵测量并重新规划树的位置；水池和苔藓重建出一片林地湿地。
keywords: Beazley Designs of the Year 2019 nominee (Architecture)

works.title: Bacteria Lamp
works.description: A blown-glass lamp holding agar on which bacteria sampled from meaningful people and places are grown for 24–48 hours, then sealed in stasis and backlit.
works.description_zh: 一盏吹制玻璃灯，里面的琼脂上培养着从重要的人和地方采集的细菌，培养 24–48 小时后被封存定格并背光照亮。
works.idea_en: A person's microbial trace can become a keepsake.
works.idea_zh: 一个人的微生物痕迹可以成为纪念品。
works.method: Swabbed microbes grow on nutrient agar inside the glass; growth is stopped and the vessel sealed, lit by an LED in the stopper.
works.method_zh: 拭子采集的微生物在玻璃内的营养琼脂上生长；随后终止生长并密封，由瓶塞中的 LED 照亮。
keywords: Beazley Designs of the Year 2019 nominee (Product)

works.title: NUATAN
works.description: An oil-free bioplastic blend made entirely from renewable resources that withstands over 100 °C, has a designed lifespan of 1–50 years and composts industrially.
works.description_zh: 一种完全由可再生资源制成、不含石油的生物塑料共混物，可耐 100°C 以上高温，设计寿命为 1–50 年，可工业堆肥。
works.idea_en: Design a material's lifespan as deliberately as its form.
works.idea_zh: 像设计形态一样有意识地设计材料的寿命。
works.method: Blends of PLA (from plant starch) and PHA (from bacterial fermentation) are tuned with the Slovak University of Technology and Panara.
works.method_zh: 与斯洛伐克技术大学和 Panara 合作，调配 PLA（来自植物淀粉）与 PHA（来自细菌发酵）的共混比例。
keywords: Beazley Designs of the Year 2019 nominee (Product)

works.title: Indus
works.description: A wall of modular ceramic tiles with leaf-vein channels filled with microalgae in a seaweed-based hydrogel; as wastewater flows over, the algae absorb heavy metals so artisan communities can reuse water.
works.description_zh: 一面由模块化陶瓷砖组成的墙，砖面叶脉状的沟槽里填满固定在海藻水凝胶中的微藻；废水流过时，藻类吸收重金属，让手工艺社区可以重复用水。
works.idea_en: A decorative craft surface can be a living water-treatment system.
works.idea_zh: 装饰性的手工表面可以是一个活的水处理系统。
works.method: Microalgae immobilised in alginate hydrogel sit in vein channels designed for flow and contact time.
works.method_zh: 固定在海藻酸盐水凝胶中的微藻位于为流速和接触时间设计的叶脉沟槽中。
keywords: Beazley Designs of the Year 2020 nominee (Product)

works.title: Ouroboros Steak
works.description: A DIY kit for growing miniature 'steaks' from one's own cells on mushroom-based scaffolds with expired blood serum, critiquing the sustainability claims of the lab-grown meat industry.
works.description_zh: 一套 DIY 工具包，用过期血清在蘑菇支架上培养自己细胞制成的迷你“牛排”，借此批判细胞培养肉产业的可持续性说法。
works.idea_en: Growing meat from yourself exposes the hidden inputs of cultured meat.
works.idea_zh: 用自己的细胞养肉，揭示了培养肉背后隐藏的投入。
works.method: Human cells are seeded on fungal mycelium scaffolds and fed with expired human blood serum (instead of fetal bovine serum).
works.method_zh: 把人体细胞接种在真菌菌丝体支架上，用过期人血清（而不是胎牛血清）喂养。
keywords: Beazley Designs of the Year 2020 nominee (Product)

works.title: HyO-Cup (The Gourd Project)
works.description: Drinking cups grown by letting bottle-gourd fruits swell inside 3D-printed moulds on the vine and then drying them, so the plant manufactures compostable cups.
works.description_zh: 让葫芦果实在藤上的 3D 打印模具中长大，再晾干，制成饮水杯——由植物“生产”可堆肥的杯子。
works.idea_en: Let the plant do the manufacturing.
works.idea_zh: 让植物来完成制造。
works.method: Young Lagenaria siceraria fruits are enclosed in moulds; mature gourds are harvested, dried and cut.
works.method_zh: 把幼嫩的葫芦（Lagenaria siceraria）果实套进模具；成熟后收获、晾干并切割。

works.title: Forest Crayons
works.description: Crayons pigmented entirely with powdered wood, bark and leaves from Japanese forests, each colour named after its source tree species.
works.description_zh: 完全用日本森林的木粉、树皮和树叶着色的蜡笔，每种颜色以其来源树种命名。
works.idea_en: Let children learn a forest's species through its colours.
works.idea_zh: 让孩子通过颜色认识森林里的物种。
works.method: Forest by-products are dried, milled and mixed with wax binders.
works.method_zh: 把森林副产品干燥、研磨，与蜡质黏合剂混合。
keywords: Dezeen Awards 2021 highly commended – Product design

works.title: The Exploded View Beyond Building
works.description: A pavilion at Dutch Design Week built as an exploded view of a house, showing over 100 bio-based building materials such as mycelium, hemp, reed and straw layer by layer.
works.description_zh: 荷兰设计周上的一座展亭，以房屋“爆炸图”的方式搭建，逐层展示菌丝体、大麻、芦苇和稻草等 100 多种生物基建材。
works.idea_en: A whole house could be built from grown materials — show every layer.
works.idea_zh: 整栋房子都可以用“长”出来的材料建造——把每一层都展示出来。
works.method: Material samples from producers are mounted in their construction order in a timber frame.
works.method_zh: 把各生产商的材料样品按建造顺序安装在木框架中。

works.title: Erosion Mitigation Units (EMUs)
works.description: Modular low-carbon concrete units that interlock to protect eroding shorelines, with textured crevices designed for algae, shellfish and fish, so the defence becomes a reef.
works.description_zh: 模块化的低碳混凝土构件，相互咬合以保护受侵蚀的海岸线，表面带纹理的缝隙专为藻类、贝类和鱼类设计，使防护结构成为一片礁。
works.idea_en: Coastal defence can be designed as habitat.
works.idea_zh: 海岸防护可以被设计成栖息地。
works.method: Cast units with biomimetic surface textures are stacked like a revetment and colonised by marine life.
works.method_zh: 带仿生表面纹理的预制构件像护坡一样堆叠，被海洋生物附着。
keywords: Dezeen Awards 2023 winner – Sustainable building product

works.title: A Breathing Sea Wall: Haikou Jiangdong Beach Park
works.description: A hard concrete seawall in Haikou was replaced with terraced, permeable coastal landscapes that let tides move through and re-establish coastal vegetation and intertidal habitat.
works.description_zh: 海口的一段混凝土硬质海堤被替换为阶梯式、可渗透的海岸景观，让潮水进出，重建海岸植被和潮间带栖息地。
works.idea_en: A sea wall can breathe with the tide instead of blocking it.
works.idea_zh: 海堤可以随潮汐呼吸，而不是阻挡潮汐。
works.method: Terraces of planted, porous materials absorb wave energy and host salt-tolerant plants and intertidal life.
works.method_zh: 种植了植物的多孔阶梯结构吸收波浪能量，容纳耐盐植物和潮间带生物。

works.title: Monc mycelium packaging
works.description: Protective product packaging inserts grown from mushroom mycelium on agricultural waste instead of polystyrene, home-compostable after use.
works.description_zh: 用蘑菇菌丝体在农业废料上生长而成的产品包装内衬，替代聚苯乙烯，用后可在家堆肥。
works.idea_en: Grown packaging is ready for everyday retail.
works.idea_zh: “长”出来的包装已经可以进入日常零售。
works.method: Mycelium colonises agricultural substrate in moulds shaped around each product and is heat-treated to stop growth.
works.method_zh: 菌丝体在按产品形状制作的模具中长满农业基质，再经热处理终止生长。

works.title: Grow Your Own Home: hemp corrugated panels
works.description: Hemp grown on the farm is combined with a plant-derived bio-resin to make corrugated roofing and cladding panels that replace fibre-cement and plastic sheets.
works.description_zh: 把农场自种的大麻纤维与植物来源的生物树脂结合，制成波纹屋面板和外墙板，替代纤维水泥板和塑料板。
works.idea_en: Grow the roof on the same land the building stands on.
works.idea_zh: 在建筑所在的土地上“种”出屋顶。
works.method: Hemp fibre mats are impregnated with a bio-resin and pressed in corrugated moulds.
works.method_zh: 把大麻纤维毡浸渍生物树脂，在波纹模具中压制成形。

works.title: Mycelium Muse
works.description: Seven French women designers were given carte blanche to make collectible objects with Reishi, MycoWorks' sheet material grown from mycelium.
works.description_zh: 七位法国女性设计师获得完全自由，用 MycoWorks 以菌丝体生长而成的片材 Reishi 创作收藏级器物。
works.idea_en: A grown material earns its place in craft through designers' hands.
works.idea_zh: 一种“长”出来的材料要经由设计师之手才能在手工艺中立足。
works.method: Fine Mycelium sheets are grown in trays, tanned and then cut, moulded and assembled by each designer.
works.method_zh: Fine Mycelium 片材在培养盘中生长、鞣制，再由每位设计师裁切、塑形和组装。

works.title: Designs for Flies
works.description: A DIY toolkit, developed with the Kyoto Institute of Technology's insect centre, that lets patients with rare diseases breed genetically modelled fruit flies and screen candidate drugs on them at home.
works.description_zh: 一套 DIY 工具包，与京都工艺纤维大学昆虫中心合作开发，让罕见病患者在家繁育带有疾病基因模型的果蝇，并用它们筛选候选药物。
works.idea_en: Research on orphan diseases could move from pharma labs into patients' homes, with flies as partners.
works.idea_zh: 罕见病研究可以从制药实验室搬到患者家中，由果蝇充当合作者。
works.method: Drosophila lines carrying human disease genes are bred in custom boxes; behaviour changes under candidate compounds are recorded.
works.method_zh: 在定制盒中繁育携带人类疾病基因的果蝇品系，记录它们在候选化合物作用下的行为变化。
keywords: Dutch Design Awards 2016 winner – Service & Systems

works.title: The In Vitro Meat Cookbook
works.description: A speculative cookbook in which lab-grown meat is the recurring ingredient, with essays by scientists, chefs and philosophers, used to open public debate on cultured meat.
works.description_zh: 一本思辨性食谱，培养肉是反复出现的食材，书中收录科学家、厨师和哲学家的文章，借此引发公众对培养肉的讨论。
works.idea_en: Recipes make an abstract technology concrete enough to argue about.
works.idea_zh: 食谱让一项抽象的技术具体到可以讨论。
works.method: Design fiction: imagined dishes (meat ice cream, knitted meat) are illustrated and paired with scientific commentary.
works.method_zh: 设计虚构：想象中的菜肴（肉冰淇淋、编织肉等）配以插图和科学评论。
keywords: Dutch Design Awards 2014 winner – Design Research

works.title: Nano Supermarket
works.description: A travelling supermarket stocked with speculative products based on emerging nano- and biotechnologies, where visitors vote on which futures they want.
works.description_zh: 一家巡回“超市”，货架上摆满基于新兴纳米与生物技术的思辨产品，访客投票选择他们想要的未来。
works.idea_en: Put future products on a shelf so people can decide before they arrive.
works.idea_zh: 把未来产品摆上货架，让人们在它们到来之前就能做出选择。
works.method: Designers contribute product prototypes and packaging; a mobile shop and voting system gather public responses.
works.method_zh: 设计师提交产品原型和包装；流动商店和投票系统收集公众反馈。

works.title: Symbiose
works.description: An advertising column with a controlled climate in which bacteria grow over printed posters, transforming the prints and spreading beyond the paper's edges.
works.description_zh: 一根气候受控的广告柱，细菌在印刷海报上生长，逐渐改变图像并蔓延到纸张之外。
works.idea_en: Graphic design can be a living surface that keeps changing after printing.
works.idea_zh: 平面设计可以是一个在印刷之后仍在变化的活表面。
works.method: Posters printed with nutrient-bearing inks are inoculated and kept warm and humid inside the column.
works.method_zh: 用含营养成分的墨水印制海报，接种细菌后在柱内保持温暖潮湿。
keywords: Dutch Design Awards 2009 winner – Young Designer

works.title: Polydome
works.description: A polyculture greenhouse modelled on a natural ecosystem, combining over 50 crops, two mushroom species, chickens, fish and bees so no synthetic fertiliser or pesticide is needed.
works.description_zh: 一种以自然生态系统为模板的混养温室，结合 50 多种作物、两种蘑菇、鸡、鱼和蜜蜂，无需化肥和农药。
works.idea_en: Design a farm as a community of species that feed and protect each other.
works.idea_zh: 把农场设计成一个相互供养、相互保护的物种群落。
works.method: Species are placed so waste streams, pollination and pest control loop between them.
works.method_zh: 合理安排各物种的位置，让废物、授粉和虫害防治在它们之间形成循环。
keywords: Dutch Design Awards 2012 nominee – Service & Systems

works.title: IABR Down to Earth: WATERSCHOOL M4H+
works.description: A research and learning environment for Rotterdam's Merwe-Vierhavens district that plans a habitat for 6,300 future residents around five local resources: insects, duckweed, seaweed, wood and fungi.
works.description_zh: 为鹿特丹 Merwe-Vierhavens 区打造的研究与学习环境，围绕昆虫、浮萍、海藻、木材和真菌五种本地资源，为 6,300 名未来居民规划栖居。
works.idea_en: Plan a neighbourhood from what can grow there.
works.idea_zh: 从当地能生长的东西出发来规划一个街区。
works.method: About forty designers developed production landscapes and prototypes for each living resource, commissioned by IABR.
works.method_zh: 受 IABR 委托，约四十位设计师为每种生命资源开发生产景观和原型。
keywords: Dutch Design Awards 2022 winner – Design Research

works.title: Nature-Friendly Starter Homes for Swallows
works.description: 3D-printed temporary nests for house and barn swallows made from bio-based, calcium-rich materials; once the birds settle in a new district and build mud nests, the starter homes break down into the soil.
works.description_zh: 为家燕和毛脚燕 3D 打印的临时巢，由生物基、富含钙的材料制成；当燕子在新区安定下来并筑起泥巢后，这些“入门住宅”就降解回土壤。
works.idea_en: Design a home for another species that is meant to be temporary.
works.idea_zh: 为另一个物种设计一个本就打算只是临时的家。
works.method: Printed without concrete, glue or nails from circular calcium-rich feedstock.
works.method_zh: 用循环利用的富钙原料打印，不使用混凝土、胶水或钉子。

works.title: Flax Chair
works.description: A chair made from a biodegradable composite of flax fibre and PLA: needle-punched flax-PLA felt is cut and heat-pressed so the PLA melts and binds the fibres into shell and legs.
works.description_zh: 一把由亚麻纤维与 PLA 可降解复合材料制成的椅子：针刺亚麻-PLA 毡被切割后热压，PLA 熔化并把纤维黏结成椅面和椅腿。
works.idea_en: Design from the whole flax plant, using as much of it as possible.
works.idea_zh: 从整株亚麻出发设计，尽可能多地利用它。
works.method: Developed with Label/Breed and Enkev; rectangles of felt are pressed into folded forms without waste.
works.method_zh: 与 Label/Breed 和 Enkev 合作开发；毡片被压制成折叠形态，不产生废料。

works.title: Human Material Loop
works.description: Discarded human hair — a keratin fibre chemically similar to wool — is turned into yarns, textiles and garments; about 72 million kg of hair is wasted in Europe each year.
works.description_zh: 把废弃的人发——一种化学成分与羊毛相似的角蛋白纤维——制成纱线、面料和服装；欧洲每年约浪费 7200 万公斤头发。
works.idea_en: The most abundant fibre may be growing on our own heads.
works.idea_zh: 最丰富的纤维也许就长在我们自己头上。
works.method: Hair collected from salons is cleaned, carded and spun, then knitted or woven.
works.method_zh: 从理发店收集的头发经清洗、梳理和纺纱，再针织或机织。
keywords: Dutch Design Awards 2022 nominee – Design Research

works.title: Respyre bioreceptive moss concrete
works.description: A bioreceptive concrete that moss colonises spontaneously, turning walls and urban surfaces into air-filtering, cooling green infrastructure; it can be applied as a layer or cast into new elements.
works.description_zh: 一种能让苔藓自发生长的生物亲和性混凝土，把墙面和城市表面变成过滤空气、降温的绿色基础设施；可作为涂层施工，也可浇筑成新构件。
works.idea_en: Design the surface so another species wants to live on it.
works.idea_zh: 把表面设计得让另一个物种愿意住上去。
works.method: A porous, water-retaining concrete mix with up to 70% recycled cement is seeded with moss.
works.method_zh: 多孔保水的混凝土配方（含高达 70% 的再生水泥）被接种苔藓。
keywords: Dutch Design Awards 2024 Young Designer spotlight

works.title: JiTiBa algae wastewater treatment
works.description: Wastewater treatment in which microalgae immobilised in gel beads clean sewage while recovering nutrients.
works.description_zh: 一种污水处理技术：固定在凝胶珠中的微藻净化污水，同时回收其中的养分。
works.idea_en: Algae can make wastewater a nutrient source for the city.
works.idea_zh: 藻类可以把污水变成城市的养分来源。
works.method: Algae-laden beads are held in reactors where they take up nitrogen and phosphorus and are easily separated.
works.method_zh: 载藻凝胶珠置于反应器中吸收氮和磷，且易于分离。
keywords: Dutch Design Awards 2025 nominee – Emerging Talent

works.title: Aerseeds
works.description: Aerodynamic seed and nutrient pods made from food waste that are dispersed by wind like winged seeds to reach degraded or hard-to-access land.
works.description_zh: 用食物垃圾制成的空气动力学种子养分包，像翅果一样随风散播，抵达退化或难以到达的土地。
works.idea_en: Borrow a tree's dispersal strategy to scale reforestation.
works.idea_zh: 借用树木的传播策略来扩大造林规模。
works.method: Pods shaped after samaras are moulded from a food-waste biomaterial and packed with seeds and nutrients.
works.method_zh: 按翅果形状模塑食物垃圾生物材料，内装种子和养分。

works.title: Vivomer packaging
works.description: Packaging made from Vivomer, a PHA biopolymer produced by microorganisms through fermentation; soil and ocean bacteria recognise it as food, so it biodegrades without industrial composting.
works.description_zh: 用 Vivomer 制成的包装——一种由微生物发酵生产的 PHA 生物聚合物；土壤和海洋细菌把它当作食物，因此无需工业堆肥就能降解。
works.idea_en: Make packaging from something microbes both make and eat.
works.idea_zh: 用微生物既能生产又能吃掉的东西来做包装。
works.method: Microbes accumulate PHA granules when fed; the extracted polymer is moulded into jars and closures.
works.method_zh: 微生物在喂养中积累 PHA 颗粒；提取出的聚合物被模塑成罐子和盖子。
keywords: Terra Carta Design Lab 2022 highly commended

works.title: Notpla Seaweed Paper
works.description: Paper for packaging in which part of the virgin wood pulp is replaced with seaweed by-products from Notpla's other processes, reaching 30% seaweed on industrial lines.
works.description_zh: 一种包装用纸，用 Notpla 其他工艺产生的海藻副产品替代部分原生木浆，在工业产线上已达到 30% 的海藻含量。
works.idea_en: Seaweed can reduce the trees in paper.
works.idea_zh: 海藻可以减少纸张中的树木用量。
works.method: Seaweed fibre residues are blended into pulp and run on conventional paper machines.
works.method_zh: 把海藻纤维残渣混入纸浆，在常规造纸机上生产。

works.title: Primordial
works.description: Scalable, low-cost photobioreactor technology for cultivating microalgae that capture CO2 while producing biomass.
works.description_zh: 一种可规模化的低成本光生物反应器技术，用来培养微藻，在吸收二氧化碳的同时产出生物质。
works.idea_en: Cheap vessels are what let algae carbon capture spread.
works.idea_zh: 廉价的培养容器才能让藻类碳捕获普及开来。
works.method: Simplified reactor geometries and materials reduce the cost of lighting, mixing and harvesting.
works.method_zh: 通过简化反应器的几何形态和材料，降低光照、搅拌和收获的成本。

works.title: Resting Reef
works.description: A funeral service and marine cemetery in which cremated remains become part of artificial reef structures on the seabed, designed to be colonised by marine life.
works.description_zh: 一种殡葬服务与海洋墓园：骨灰被融入海底的人工礁结构中，这些礁体专为海洋生物附着而设计。
works.idea_en: A grave can become a home for other species.
works.idea_zh: 坟墓可以成为其他物种的家。
works.method: Ash-containing reef units are shaped for settlement, placed on degraded seabeds and monitored.
works.method_zh: 含骨灰的礁体单元按利于附着的形态制作，放置在退化的海床上并加以监测。

works.title: Home Grown
works.description: A touchpad whose casing and components are made from bio-based, locally sourced materials and crafts, as an alternative to plastic electronics.
works.description_zh: 一款触控板，外壳和部件均由本地来源的生物基材料和手工艺制成，替代塑料电子产品。
works.idea_en: Electronics can be clad in grown, local materials.
works.idea_zh: 电子产品可以包裹在本地“长”出来的材料里。
works.method: Bio-based casings are made with local crafts around standard electronic internals.
works.method_zh: 围绕标准电子元件，用本地手工艺制作生物基外壳。

works.title: Weird Ecologies
works.description: Devices that latch onto existing infrastructure in toxic landscapes and help toxin-tolerant organisms grow, managing contaminated sites through bioremediation instead of fencing them off.
works.description_zh: 一组装置，附着在有毒地景中的现有基础设施上，帮助耐毒生物生长，用生物修复而不是隔离来管理污染场地。
works.idea_en: Work with the organisms that already thrive in damaged places.
works.idea_zh: 与已经在受损之地繁盛的生物合作。
works.method: Clip-on habitats deliver substrate and water to hyperaccumulator plants and microbes.
works.method_zh: 卡扣式栖息装置为超富集植物和微生物提供基质和水分。

works.title: BIOPOD
works.description: Human-scale floating ecosystem modules that host marsh vegetation to clean urban water, rewild fringe marsh along city waterfronts and involve the public in citizen-science monitoring.
works.description_zh: 人体尺度的漂浮生态模块，种植湿地植被来净化城市水体，在城市滨水区恢复边缘湿地，并让公众参与公民科学监测。
works.idea_en: Bring back the marsh edge that city walls removed.
works.idea_zh: 找回被城市护岸抹去的湿地边缘。
works.method: Buoyant planted modules support salt-marsh plants whose roots filter water and shelter organisms.
works.method_zh: 漂浮种植模块承载盐沼植物，其根系过滤水体并庇护生物。

works.title: Shellf Life
works.description: Discarded mollusc shells from the seafood industry are turned into a biomaterial for products and architectural surfaces.
works.description_zh: 把海鲜产业丢弃的软体动物贝壳变成用于产品和建筑表面的生物材料。
works.idea_en: Seafood waste is a biogenic stone.
works.idea_zh: 海鲜废料是一种生物来源的“石材”。
works.method: Calcium-carbonate shells are cleaned, ground and bound into castable composites.
works.method_zh: 清洗并研磨碳酸钙贝壳，黏结成可浇注的复合材料。

works.title: Cyanoskin
works.description: A living paint containing cyanobacteria that turns building façades into surfaces that absorb pollution and fix CO2, thickening over time as the microbes photosynthesise.
works.description_zh: 一种含蓝藻的活体涂料，把建筑立面变成吸收污染、固定二氧化碳的表面，并随微生物光合作用逐渐增厚。
works.idea_en: Paint a wall with something that breathes.
works.idea_zh: 用会呼吸的东西粉刷墙面。
works.method: Cyanobacteria are embedded in a breathable binder that keeps them alive on outdoor surfaces.
works.method_zh: 把蓝藻嵌入透气黏合剂中，使其在户外表面存活。
keywords: Terra Carta Design Lab 2024 highly commended

works.title: SEAGRAFT
works.description: A planting method and tool for restoring seagrass meadows by setting seeds and rhizomes efficiently into muddy or sandy seabeds.
works.description_zh: 一种恢复海草床的种植方法与工具，能高效地把海草种子和根状茎植入泥质或沙质海床。
works.idea_en: Design the tool that lets underwater meadows be replanted at scale.
works.idea_zh: 设计能让水下草甸得以大规模重新种植的工具。
works.method: A hand tool anchors seedlings and rhizome fragments at the right depth in soft sediment.
works.method_zh: 一种手持工具把幼苗和根茎片段以合适深度固定在松软沉积物中。

works.title: WildWatch
works.description: A speed-control and wildlife-detection system for animal crossings on forest roads: proximity sensors detect approaching animals and trigger lights and warnings to prevent collisions.
works.description_zh: 一种用于林区道路动物通道的限速与野生动物检测系统：近距离传感器探测接近的动物，触发灯光和警示，防止碰撞。
works.idea_en: Roads can be designed to notice other species.
works.idea_zh: 道路可以被设计成能“注意到”其他物种。
works.method: Roadside sensor posts detect animal movement and activate illumination and driver warnings in low visibility.
works.method_zh: 路边的传感桩检测动物活动，在低能见度下启动照明和驾驶员警示。

works.title: Care for Milk
works.description: Leftover milk collected from neighbourhood households becomes a casein bioplastic glaze for ceramics, forming a waterproof layer whose colour varies with the milk.
works.description_zh: 从邻里家中收集的剩牛奶被做成陶瓷用的酪蛋白生物塑料釉层，形成防水层，颜色随牛奶种类而变化。
works.idea_en: A kitchen waste can waterproof a vessel.
works.idea_zh: 厨房废料可以让器皿防水。
works.method: Milk penetrates the pores of fired clay and is heat-cured into a casein film.
works.method_zh: 牛奶渗入烧制陶土的孔隙，加热固化成酪蛋白膜。

works.title: The New Age of Trichology
works.description: Human hair collected from salons is spun into yarn and rope with traditional rope makers; Visser has made climbing ropes, bags and swings from it.
works.description_zh: 从理发店收集的人发与传统制绳匠一起纺成纱线和绳索；Visser 用它做了攀岩绳、包和秋千。
works.idea_en: Hair waste is strong enough to hold a person.
works.idea_zh: 废弃头发强韧到足以承受一个人的重量。
works.method: Hair is washed, carded and spun, then laid into rope on traditional rope walks.
works.method_zh: 头发经清洗、梳理和纺纱后，在传统制绳场中搓成绳。

works.title: Living Colours
works.description: A textile research project that embraces the fading of plant-based dyes, charting how natural colours change over time so textiles become living surfaces.
works.description_zh: 一个接纳植物染料褪色的纺织研究项目，记录天然色彩随时间的变化，让纺织品成为“活”的表面。
works.idea_en: Design with fading instead of fighting it.
works.idea_zh: 顺应褪色来设计，而不是对抗它。
works.method: Fabrics and papers dyed with plant dyes are exposed to light and catalogued as they discolour.
works.method_zh: 用植物染料染色的布和纸暴露在光照下，记录它们的褪色过程。

works.title: Living Pixels
works.description: An 'ink nursery' in which pigment-producing bacteria from soil, skin, plants and mouths are cultured to grow a full colour spectrum, processed into inks for printing and painting.
works.description_zh: 一个“墨水苗圃”：培养来自土壤、皮肤、植物和口腔的产色素细菌，长出完整色谱，再加工成印刷和绘画用的墨水。
works.idea_en: Grow a colour palette instead of synthesising it.
works.idea_zh: “种”出一套色板，而不是合成它。
works.method: Pigmented bacterial biomass is harvested and processed into liquid inks.
works.method_zh: 收获带色素的细菌生物质并加工成液态墨水。

works.title: Coleoptera
works.description: A bioplastic made from the wing cases of mealworm beetles discarded by insect farms, converted into chitin and chitosan and pressed into sheets; over 2,500 beetles make one small sheet.
works.description_zh: 一种用昆虫养殖场丢弃的黄粉虫甲虫鞘翅制成的生物塑料，鞘翅被转化为几丁质和壳聚糖后压成片材；一小片需要 2,500 多只甲虫。
works.idea_en: Insect farming waste is a source of plastic-like material.
works.idea_zh: 昆虫养殖的废料是类塑料材料的来源。
works.method: Elytra are demineralised and deacetylated to chitosan, cast and pressed.
works.method_zh: 鞘翅经脱矿和脱乙酰处理成壳聚糖，再浇注压制。

works.title: Pendant Lights
works.description: Lamps made from beech wood infected by white-rot fungi, normally chipped as waste; the fungal decay makes the wood more translucent and other fungi leave coloured patterns.
works.description_zh: 用受白腐真菌侵染的山毛榉木制作的灯具——这种木材通常被削成木片丢弃；真菌腐朽使木材更透光，其他真菌则留下彩色纹样。
works.idea_en: Fungal decay can be a finish rather than a defect.
works.idea_zh: 真菌腐朽可以是一种表面效果，而不是缺陷。
works.method: Spalted wood is turned thin so light passes through fungus-altered cell walls.
works.method_zh: 把被真菌侵染的木材车薄，让光穿过被真菌改变的细胞壁。

works.title: No-ink
works.description: Discarded tulip heads from North Holland bulb fields are dried and their petals laminated with compostable PLA into a sheet material; pigments are also extracted from the petals.
works.description_zh: 把北荷兰球茎田里丢弃的郁金香花头晒干，花瓣与可堆肥的 PLA 层压成片材；同时从花瓣中提取色素。
works.idea_en: A flower industry's waste petals can be a colour and a material.
works.idea_zh: 花卉产业废弃的花瓣可以是颜色，也可以是材料。
works.method: Dried petals are laminated in PLA film; spent petals are processed for dye extraction.
works.method_zh: 干花瓣被层压在 PLA 薄膜中；处理后的花瓣用于提取染料。

works.title: Ivorish
works.description: An ivory substitute made at Waag's Open Wetlab by pulverising human milk teeth and mixing the powder with a binder, questioning the ethics of animal ivory.
works.description_zh: 在 Waag 开放湿实验室把人类乳牙研磨成粉并与黏合剂混合制成的象牙替代品，借此追问动物象牙的伦理。
works.idea_en: If ivory is precious, why not use our own?
works.idea_zh: 如果象牙珍贵，为什么不用我们自己的？
works.method: Teeth are ground to dentine powder, bound and polished into small objects.
works.method_zh: 把牙齿磨成牙本质粉，黏结并抛光成小物件。

works.title: Botanica
works.description: Vessels and objects imagining design as if the oil age never happened, made from pre-Bakelite natural polymers: plant gums, resins, rubber, shellac and animal blood.
works.description_zh: 一组器皿与物件，想象如果石油时代从未发生的设计，使用电木出现之前的天然聚合物：植物胶、树脂、橡胶、虫胶和动物血。
works.idea_en: Look back to natural polymers to imagine design after oil.
works.idea_zh: 回望天然聚合物，想象后石油时代的设计。
works.method: Historical recipes for natural plastics were re-created and cast into vessels.
works.method_zh: 复原天然塑料的历史配方，浇铸成器皿。

works.title: Slakkenpoep-linoleum (Snail-poo linoleum)
works.description: Garden snails are fed coloured paper and their colour-keeping droppings are collected with a feeding machine and processed into a linoleum-like floor material.
works.description_zh: 给花园蜗牛喂彩色纸，用喂养装置收集保留颜色的粪便，再加工成类似油毡的地面材料。
works.idea_en: Other animals can be small factories — with care for their diet.
works.idea_zh: 其他动物可以是小型“工厂”——前提是照顾好它们的饮食。
works.method: A snail-feeding machine collects droppings, which are pressed with binders into sheets.
works.method_zh: 喂养装置收集蜗牛粪便，再与黏合剂一起压成片材。

works.title: Agricola
works.description: Lamps made from fibrous agricultural by-products of fruit, vegetables and cereals, normally burned for biofuel, bound with natural agents such as latex, dammar gum and gamboge.
works.description_zh: 用水果、蔬菜和谷物的纤维性农业副产品制成的灯具——这些副产品通常被当作生物燃料烧掉——并用乳胶、达玛树胶和藤黄等天然黏合剂黏结。
works.idea_en: Crop waste burned for energy can instead become light fittings.
works.idea_zh: 被烧来发电的作物废料可以变成灯具。
works.method: Fibres are moulded with natural resins and gums into translucent shades.
works.method_zh: 用天然树脂和树胶把纤维模塑成半透明灯罩。

works.title: PalmLeather
works.description: Dry, brittle leaf sheaths of the areca palm are soaked in a biological softening solution that restores the toughness and flexibility of the living leaf, giving a leather-like sheet.
works.description_zh: 把干脆易碎的槟榔叶鞘浸泡在生物软化溶液中，恢复活叶的韧性和柔软度，得到类似皮革的片材。
works.idea_en: Restore a dead leaf's living properties instead of adding plastic.
works.idea_zh: 恢复枯叶的“活”性能，而不是添加塑料。
works.method: A plant-based softener penetrates the cell walls, then sheets are embossed and cut into slippers.
works.method_zh: 植物基软化剂渗入细胞壁，再对片材压纹并裁成拖鞋。

works.title: Waste Materials
works.description: A felted wall hanging made from merino wool, raw silk and leftover wool from Jongstra's own flock of Drenthe Heath sheep, coloured with weld grown in her dye garden.
works.description_zh: 一件毛毡壁挂，材料是美利奴羊毛、生丝以及 Jongstra 自己饲养的德伦特荒原羊的剩余羊毛，用她染料园里种植的黄木樨草染色。
works.idea_en: Art can be one link in a farm's living cycle.
works.idea_zh: 艺术可以是农场生命循环中的一环。
works.method: Hand-felting combines farm wools and silk; plant dyes come from the artist's botanical garden.
works.method_zh: 手工毡化结合农场羊毛与丝；植物染料来自艺术家的植物园。

works.title: BeLeaf
works.description: A lightweight biodegradable material made from fallen autumn leaves and natural binders, shown as a birdhouse that shelters wildlife for about a year before decaying into the soil.
works.description_zh: 一种用秋季落叶和天然黏合剂制成的轻质可降解材料，被做成鸟屋，约一年内为野生动物提供庇护，之后分解回土壤。
works.idea_en: Design an object's lifespan to match a bird's season.
works.idea_zh: 让物件的寿命与鸟的季节相匹配。
works.method: Leaves are pressed with natural binders and folded into a birdhouse.
works.method_zh: 把树叶与天然黏合剂压制成形，折成鸟屋。

works.title: BeeHaven
works.description: An urban beehive system whose forms come from 3D scans of tree cavities and are additively manufactured with mycelium; an algorithm places hives where city bees benefit most.
works.description_zh: 一套城市蜂巢系统，其形态来自对树洞的 3D 扫描，并用菌丝体增材制造；算法把蜂巢放在对城市蜜蜂最有利的位置。
works.idea_en: Copy the homes bees choose in nature, and grow them.
works.idea_zh: 模仿蜜蜂在自然中选择的家，并把它“种”出来。
works.method: Scanned cavity geometry is printed as moulds and filled with mycelium substrate; site selection uses environmental analysis and A* search.
works.method_zh: 扫描的树洞几何被打印成模具并填入菌丝体基质；选址使用环境分析和 A* 搜索算法。

works.title: GROWinK
works.description: A regenerative printing system that runs CMYK inkjet printing with fungal pigments and dormant bacterial spores instead of petroleum inks, so prints become living, temporary media.
works.description_zh: 一种再生型打印系统，用真菌色素和休眠细菌孢子替代石油基墨水进行 CMYK 喷墨打印，让印刷品成为有生命、暂时存在的媒介。
works.idea_en: A print can be alive for a while and then return to soil.
works.idea_zh: 印刷品可以活上一段时间，然后回归土壤。
works.method: Fungal pigment inks and spore suspensions are formulated for inkjet heads.
works.method_zh: 为喷墨打印头配制真菌色素墨水和孢子悬液。

works.title: Phytosphere
works.description: Six plant–machine hybrids in which plants' own bioelectric signals control robotic bodies, letting them move and adjust their environment within a plant community.
works.description_zh: 六个植物-机器混合体，植物自身的生物电信号控制机器人身体，让它们在植物群落中移动并调整环境。
works.idea_en: Give plants agency over where they go.
works.idea_zh: 让植物自己决定去哪里。
works.method: Electrodes read plant bioelectric potentials and map them to motors that move pots toward light or water.
works.method_zh: 电极读取植物的生物电位，映射到驱动花盆朝光或水移动的电机。

works.title: Kelpi high-barrier coating
works.description: Seaweed-derived coatings for paper and card that match the barrier performance of plastic films, letting fibre packaging replace single-use plastics.
works.description_zh: 用于纸张和纸板的海藻来源涂层，阻隔性能可与塑料薄膜相当，让纤维包装取代一次性塑料。
works.idea_en: A thin seaweed layer can remove plastic from paper packaging.
works.idea_zh: 薄薄一层海藻就能把塑料从纸包装中去掉。
works.method: Seaweed polysaccharides are formulated into barrier coatings applied on paper lines.
works.method_zh: 把海藻多糖配制成阻隔涂料，在造纸线上涂覆。

works.title: Sealeo biodegradable thermal packaging
works.description: Thermal packaging for pharmaceutical cold chains that combines a seaweed biofoam with a seaweed hydrogel coolant, keeping contents cool up to 2.5 times longer and fully compostable.
works.description_zh: 一种用于药品冷链的保温包装，结合海藻生物泡沫和海藻水凝胶冷却剂，保冷时间最长可达 2.5 倍，且完全可堆肥。
works.idea_en: Replace foam boxes and gel packs with materials from the sea.
works.idea_zh: 用来自海洋的材料替代泡沫箱和冰袋。
works.method: Seaweed polymers are foamed into insulating panels and gelled into refreezable coolant packs.
works.method_zh: 海藻聚合物被发泡成保温板，并凝胶化制成可重复冷冻的冷却包。

works.title: Bacterial Cellulose Foam
works.description: A lightweight, fire-resistant, compostable foam made by bacteria that grow cellulose networks from renewable feedstocks, aimed at packaging, insulation, furniture and apparel.
works.description_zh: 一种轻质、阻燃、可堆肥的泡沫材料，由细菌用可再生原料生长出纤维素网络，面向包装、保温、家具和服装。
works.idea_en: Grow foam instead of blowing it from oil.
works.idea_zh: “种”出泡沫，而不是用石油发泡。
works.method: Bacteria produce cellulose in a foamed medium; the structure is stabilised in a low-energy process.
works.method_zh: 细菌在发泡培养基中产生纤维素，再以低能耗工艺稳定结构。

works.title: Algae Harvester
works.description: A household fridge with an integrated photobioreactor that reuses the fridge's waste heat to grow edible spirulina for a small daily harvest.
works.description_zh: 一台集成光生物反应器的家用冰箱，利用冰箱的废热培养可食用螺旋藻，每天可少量收获。
works.idea_en: Appliances can host food organisms using the energy they waste.
works.idea_zh: 家电可以用自己浪费的能量来养育食物生物。
works.method: Heat from the compressor warms an illuminated algae chamber built into the fridge body.
works.method_zh: 压缩机的热量为冰箱内置的光照藻室加温。

works.title: Algee
works.description: A modular soft-seating system shaped after algae forms and 3D printed from PHB, a biodegradable plastic produced by cyanobacteria, so the furniture can 'grow' by adding modules.
works.description_zh: 一套以藻类形态为灵感的模块化软座系统，用蓝藻生产的可降解塑料 PHB 3D 打印而成，可通过增加模块让家具“生长”。
works.idea_en: Furniture can be printed from a plastic grown by microbes.
works.idea_zh: 家具可以用微生物“种”出来的塑料打印。
works.method: Cyanobacterial PHB filament is printed into lattice modules.
works.method_zh: 用蓝藻 PHB 线材打印成网格模块。

works.title: Mycelium & Fiber
works.description: A textile–mycelium composite in which the fungus Trametes hirsuta grows through silk, flax and cotton textile structures that guide its growth into light, stable, biodegradable parts.
works.description_zh: 一种纺织-菌丝体复合材料，真菌毛栓菌（Trametes hirsuta）在丝、亚麻和棉的织物结构中生长，被引导成轻质、稳定、可降解的构件。
works.idea_en: Weave a scaffold that tells the fungus where to grow.
works.idea_zh: 织一个告诉真菌往哪里长的支架。
works.method: Inoculated textiles are shaped in moulds; mycelium binds the fibres as it colonises them.
works.method_zh: 接种后的织物在模具中定形，菌丝体在长满纤维时把它们黏结在一起。

works.title: The MECC
works.description: A modular façade panel for landfills and gasworks that houses living methanotrophic microbes in a carrageenan hydrogel to oxidise methane, with sensors monitoring the community.
works.description_zh: 一种用于垃圾填埋场和燃气厂的模块化立面板，在卡拉胶水凝胶中容纳活的甲烷氧化菌以氧化甲烷，并由传感器监测菌群。
works.idea_en: A building skin can host microbes that clean the air.
works.idea_zh: 建筑表皮可以容纳净化空气的微生物。
works.method: Methanotrophs in hydrogel cells are exposed to air flows; panel bodies are printed from wood-fibre PLA.
works.method_zh: 水凝胶单元中的甲烷氧化菌暴露在气流中；面板主体用木纤维 PLA 打印。

works.title: AstroFeast
works.description: Dried nutritional sheets of living yeast for long space missions, rehydrated with water only and kept in containers where the food keeps evolving.
works.description_zh: 为长期太空任务设计的活酵母干营养片，只需加水复水，并存放在让食物持续“进化”的容器中。
works.idea_en: Food on a spaceship can be alive and changing.
works.idea_zh: 宇宙飞船上的食物可以是活的、会变化的。
works.method: Yeast cultures are dried into sheets and revived in nature-inspired vessels.
works.method_zh: 把酵母菌培养物干燥成片，再在仿自然形态的容器中复活。

works.title: Algae-Symbiont
works.description: Living microalgae cultures built into an air-purifying table and wall module; an Arduino-controlled pump circulates room air through the algae, which absorb CO2 and release oxygen.
works.description_zh: 把活微藻培养融入一张空气净化桌和一个墙面模块；由 Arduino 控制的气泵让室内空气流经藻液，藻类吸收二氧化碳、释放氧气。
works.idea_en: Furniture can be a place where people live with algae.
works.idea_zh: 家具可以是人与藻类共同生活的地方。
works.method: Tubes of microalgae are lit and aerated by a microcontroller-driven pump.
works.method_zh: 微藻管在微控制器驱动的气泵下接受光照和通气。

works.title: After Life
works.description: Personalised memorial reefs 3D-printed from cremation ashes, shellfish waste and algae as an alternative to conventional funerals, designed to support coral and marine life.
works.description_zh: 用骨灰、贝类废料和藻类 3D 打印的个性化纪念礁，作为传统葬礼的替代，旨在支持珊瑚和海洋生物。
works.idea_en: Remembrance can become habitat for other species.
works.idea_zh: 纪念可以成为其他物种的栖息地。
works.method: Generative design shapes reef forms that are printed and placed at sea.
works.method_zh: 用生成式设计塑造礁体形态，打印后放入海中。

works.title: Sea Glass
works.description: Glass made from diatoms, microalgae that pull silicon from seawater to build silica cell walls, so silica can be grown and CO2 captured instead of mining sand.
works.description_zh: 用硅藻制成的玻璃——硅藻从海水中获取硅来构建二氧化硅细胞壁——因此可以“种”出二氧化硅并捕获二氧化碳，而不必开采沙子。
works.idea_en: Glass could be grown by microalgae instead of mined.
works.idea_zh: 玻璃可以由微藻“种”出来，而不是开采得来。
works.method: Diatom biomass is cultured, the organic matter removed and the silica frustules melted into glass.
works.method_zh: 培养硅藻生物质，去除有机物后把硅质外壳熔成玻璃。

works.title: Living Tex'Celium
works.description: Mycelium grown on agricultural and wood waste around jute textiles forms stronger, recyclable composites; flexible modules are grown and 'bio-welded' on site by the living fungus.
works.description_zh: 在黄麻织物周围的农业和木材废料上培养菌丝体，形成更强韧、可回收的复合材料；柔性模块在现场生长，并由活真菌“生物焊接”在一起。
works.idea_en: Let the fungus join building parts after they are placed.
works.idea_zh: 让真菌在构件就位后把它们连接起来。
works.method: Jute-reinforced mycelium modules are placed while alive so hyphae grow across joints under digital guidance.
works.method_zh: 黄麻增强的菌丝体模块在存活状态下安装，菌丝在数字引导下长过接缝。

works.title: Negotiating Boundaries (Seacrete)
works.description: Seacrete, a building material from waste seashells designed to be shared with marine ecosystems: as it weathers in coastal settings it enriches habitats for non-human life.
works.description_zh: Seacrete 是一种用废弃贝壳制成、本就打算与海洋生态系统共享的建筑材料：在海岸环境中风化时，它为非人类生命丰富栖息地。
works.idea_en: Design a material whose weathering is a gift to other species.
works.idea_zh: 设计一种风化过程本身就是送给其他物种礼物的材料。
works.method: Shell aggregate and binders are cast into textured coastal elements that erode into habitat.
works.method_zh: 把贝壳骨料与黏合剂浇铸成带纹理的海岸构件，侵蚀后变成栖息地。

works.title: Brio
works.description: Plastic-eating mealworms and superworms chew polystyrene waste into patterns, and the insect-shaped pieces are cast into vases and knives, with the designer guiding the insects as collaborators.
works.description_zh: 会“吃”塑料的黄粉虫和大麦虫把聚苯乙烯垃圾啃出图案，这些被昆虫塑形的碎片再被翻模成花瓶和刀具，设计师引导昆虫作为合作者。
works.idea_en: Let insects carve non-recyclable waste.
works.idea_zh: 让昆虫来雕刻无法回收的垃圾。
works.method: Superworms (Zophobas morio) eat into polystyrene blocks; the resulting forms are moulded and cast.
works.method_zh: 大麦虫（Zophobas morio）啃食聚苯乙烯块，形成的形态被翻模浇铸。

works.title: AIPER
works.description: A start-up producing microbial biopigments for textiles and cosmetics by fermentation, feeding the microbes on agricultural waste.
works.description_zh: 一家通过发酵生产微生物生物色素的初创公司，面向纺织和化妆品，以农业废料作为微生物的养料。
works.idea_en: Colour can come from microbes fed on farm waste.
works.idea_zh: 颜色可以来自以农业废料为食的微生物。
works.method: Pigment-producing strains ferment agro-residues; pigments are extracted and formulated.
works.method_zh: 产色素菌株发酵农业残余物，再提取并配制色素。

works.title: HyphaL
works.description: A studio monitor loudspeaker whose enclosure is made entirely of mycelium composite and hemp fibre, apart from screws and driver, using the material's acoustic damping.
works.description_zh: 一款录音棚监听音箱，除螺丝和扬声器单元外，箱体完全由菌丝体复合材料和大麻纤维制成，利用其声学阻尼特性。
works.idea_en: A grown material can be a precision acoustic component.
works.idea_zh: “长”出来的材料可以是精密的声学部件。
works.method: Hemp-fibre substrate is grown with mycelium in a speaker-cabinet mould and heat-treated.
works.method_zh: 大麻纤维基质在音箱柜模具中与菌丝体一起生长，再经热处理。

works.title: Interwoven
works.description: An installation that measures the electrical impulses fungi use to signal in their mycelial networks and translates them into projection and sound; touching the fungus changes the signal.
works.description_zh: 一件装置，测量真菌在菌丝网络中传递信号所用的电脉冲，并转化为投影和声音；触摸真菌会改变信号。
works.idea_en: Make a fungus's electrical life perceptible to people.
works.idea_zh: 让人能感知真菌的电活动。
works.method: Electrodes in the substrate record spiking potentials, which drive generative visuals and audio.
works.method_zh: 基质中的电极记录尖峰电位，用来驱动生成式影像和声音。

works.title: Mycolith
works.description: A biofabrication strategy that uses mycelium to bind and stabilise regolith for building habitats in space, reducing the materials shipped from Earth.
works.description_zh: 一种生物制造策略，用菌丝体黏结并稳定月壤/火星土，用于建造太空栖居地，减少从地球运输的材料。
works.idea_en: Grow off-world buildings from local dust and fungi.
works.idea_zh: 用当地尘土和真菌在地外“种”出建筑。
works.method: Mycelium is grown through regolith simulant mixed with nutrients to form solid blocks.
works.method_zh: 让菌丝体在混有养分的模拟月壤中生长，形成坚固的块体。

works.title: GROWN BLUR
works.description: Ikat textiles dyed with cultivated microalgae pigments instead of synthetic dyes, adapting ikat's resist-dye-before-weaving logic to algae dyeing.
works.description_zh: 用培养微藻的色素而非合成染料染色的伊卡织物，把伊卡“先扎染后织造”的逻辑移用到藻类染色上。
works.idea_en: Pair a traditional textile technique with a grown dye.
works.idea_zh: 让传统织造技法与“长”出来的染料结合。
works.method: Warp threads are resist-tied and dipped in microalgae pigment baths before weaving.
works.method_zh: 经线先扎结防染，浸入微藻色素染液后再织造。

works.title: Printing Herbarium
works.description: Living moss is applied to textile surfaces to create textures instead of water-intensive screen printing, co-creating a collection with the plants.
works.description_zh: 把活苔藓施加到织物表面形成纹理，替代耗水的丝网印刷，与植物共同创作一个系列。
works.idea_en: Let a plant be the printing medium.
works.idea_zh: 让植物成为印刷媒介。
works.method: Moss fragments in a growth medium are applied through stencils and cultivated on fabric.
works.method_zh: 把混在培养基中的苔藓碎片通过镂空版施加到织物上并培育。

works.title: Alchemical Mycology
works.description: Vivid pigments are extracted from wild-harvested and lab-grown fungi and developed into colourants for textiles and paint.
works.description_zh: 从野外采集和实验室培养的真菌中提取鲜艳色素，开发成纺织和绘画用的着色剂。
works.idea_en: Fungi are a renewable palette.
works.idea_zh: 真菌是一种可再生的调色板。
works.method: Fungal pigments are extracted with solvents and fixed with mordants onto fibres or bound into paints.
works.method_zh: 用溶剂提取真菌色素，借助媒染剂固定在纤维上，或调制成颜料。

works.title: Mr. Kombucha's Lab
works.description: An open-source platform that teaches people to grow kombucha SCOBY and turn it into leather- and plastic-like everyday objects.
works.description_zh: 一个开源平台，教人培养康普茶菌膜（SCOBY）并把它做成类皮革、类塑料的日常物件。
works.idea_en: Material innovation can be shared as recipes anyone can grow.
works.idea_zh: 材料创新可以作为人人都能“种”的配方来分享。
works.method: Guides cover breeding cultures, drying pellicles and forming objects, with a sharing community.
works.method_zh: 指南涵盖菌种培养、菌膜干燥和物件成形，并配有分享社区。

works.title: The Purhyphae Project
works.description: Fungal mycelium is grown on shredded natural and synthetic textile waste, degrading it and forming leather-like mats.
works.description_zh: 在粉碎的天然和合成纺织废料上培养真菌菌丝体，使其降解废料并形成类皮革的菌毡。
works.idea_en: Feed old clothes to fungi and harvest a new material.
works.idea_zh: 把旧衣服喂给真菌，收获新材料。
works.method: Textile shreds serve as substrate; mycelium mats are harvested, pressed and finished.
works.method_zh: 纺织碎料作为基质；收获菌丝毡后压制并整理。

works.title: The Soothing Cup
works.description: A menstrual cup coated with a seaweed-based hydrogel plus an incubator in which users grow anti-inflammatory bacteria on their own cup, making a care ritual with microbes.
works.description_zh: 一个涂有海藻基水凝胶的月经杯，配有培养箱，让使用者在自己的杯子上培养抗炎细菌，形成与微生物相处的照护仪式。
works.idea_en: Intimate products can be designed as relationships with microbes.
works.idea_zh: 私密用品可以被设计成与微生物的关系。
works.method: Probiotic bacteria are cultured on an alginate-type hydrogel layer before use.
works.method_zh: 使用前在海藻酸盐类水凝胶层上培养益生菌。

works.title: Yearning for Colour
works.description: Discarded hospital fabrics are dyed with pigments grown by bacteria sourced from nature, using little water and no harmful chemicals; the bacteria's growth patterns shape the garments.
works.description_zh: 用从自然中采集的细菌所产生的色素给废弃医院布料染色，用水少且不使用有害化学品；细菌的生长图案塑造了服装。
works.idea_en: Let bacteria co-design the pattern as well as the colour.
works.idea_zh: 让细菌不仅决定颜色，也共同设计图案。
works.method: Fabrics are inoculated with pigment-producing bacteria and incubated so colour spreads as the colonies grow.
works.method_zh: 给布料接种产色素细菌并培养，颜色随菌落生长而扩散。

works.title: CyanoFabbrica
works.description: Cyanobacteria's ability to biomineralise is used to bind substrates into objects, making the organism a co-producer whose binding determines each unique form.
works.description_zh: 利用蓝藻的生物矿化能力把基质黏结成物件，让这种生物成为共同生产者，它的黏结方式决定了每件作品的独特形态。
works.idea_en: Share authorship of form with a microbe.
works.idea_zh: 与微生物分享形态的“作者权”。
works.method: Cyanobacteria precipitate calcium carbonate among granular material in moulds under light.
works.method_zh: 在光照下，蓝藻在模具中的颗粒材料之间沉淀碳酸钙。

works.title: Mycomerge
works.description: A stool built as a multi-layer bio-based component in which living mycelium binds natural fibres, so every part can be grown.
works.description_zh: 一张凳子，由多层生物基构件组成，活菌丝体把天然纤维黏结在一起，每个部件都可以“种”出来。
works.idea_en: Grow the whole object, joints included.
works.idea_zh: 把整个物件“种”出来，包括连接部位。
works.method: Natural-fibre layers are inoculated and stacked so hyphae fuse them into one piece.
works.method_zh: 对天然纤维层接种后叠放，菌丝把它们融合成一体。

works.title: MYCOsella
works.description: A chair grown from a fully biodegradable mycelium-based material, exploring growth-based production and a life cycle that ends in compost.
works.description_zh: 一把用完全可降解的菌丝体材料“种”出来的椅子，探索以生长为基础的生产方式和以堆肥告终的生命周期。
works.idea_en: Design the end of a chair's life together with its making.
works.idea_zh: 在制造椅子的同时就设计好它生命的终点。
works.method: Mycelium substrate is grown in a chair mould and dried.
works.method_zh: 菌丝体基质在椅子模具中生长后干燥。

works.title: AeR
works.description: A system that bioprints photosynthetic microorganisms such as cyanobacteria and lichens into modular wall surfaces, with users choosing bio-inks and scaffolds to tune their indoor microclimate.
works.description_zh: 一个把蓝藻、地衣等光合微生物生物打印到模块化墙面上的系统，用户选择生物墨水和支架来调节室内微气候。
works.idea_en: Print a living wall the way you choose paint.
works.idea_zh: 像选油漆一样打印一面活墙。
works.method: Bio-inks carrying living cells are extruded onto printed scaffolds that are mounted indoors.
works.method_zh: 把含活细胞的生物墨水挤出到打印支架上，再安装在室内。

works.title: Protomycokion
works.description: A building column 3D-printed from living mycelium and waste fibres following an algorithmic design and then grown to solidity: structural, water-resistant and sound-absorbing.
works.description_zh: 一根按算法设计、用活菌丝体和废弃纤维 3D 打印后再生长至坚固的建筑柱：具有承重、防水和吸音性能。
works.idea_en: Print the form, then let the fungus finish the structure.
works.idea_zh: 先打印出形态，再让真菌完成结构。
works.method: A living mycelium–fibre paste is extruded in layers; colonisation fuses them before drying.
works.method_zh: 逐层挤出含活菌丝体的纤维浆料；菌丝长满后把各层融合，再干燥。

works.title: Scobio
works.description: A colourless, biodegradable film grown by microbes from Scottish gin-distillery waste to replace plastic packaging film; it is also antimicrobial and water-retentive.
works.description_zh: 一种无色、可降解的薄膜，由微生物利用苏格兰金酒酒厂废料生长而成，用来替代塑料包装膜；它还具有抗菌和保湿性。
works.idea_en: A distillery's waste can grow packaging.
works.idea_zh: 酒厂的废料可以“长”出包装。
works.method: Bacterial cellulose is grown on spent distillery liquid and processed into clear sheets.
works.method_zh: 在酒厂废液上培养细菌纤维素，再加工成透明片材。

works.title: The Algae Grower
works.description: A home photobioreactor for growing and harvesting fresh spirulina, about 5 g a day, the recommended adult intake.
works.description_zh: 一种家用光生物反应器，用来培养和收获新鲜螺旋藻，每天约 5 克，相当于成人建议摄入量。
works.idea_en: Make microalgae a fresh home-grown food.
works.idea_zh: 让微藻成为自家种植的新鲜食物。
works.method: An illuminated culture vessel with a harvesting filter lets users collect biomass daily.
works.method_zh: 带光照的培养容器配有收获滤网，用户每天可收集藻泥。

works.title: Biomaterials & Music (silk violin)
works.description: A violin made from a composite of silkworm silk and spider silk with a binder, whose fibre mix tunes the instrument's acoustics.
works.description_zh: 一把用蚕丝和蛛丝复合材料加黏合剂制成的小提琴，纤维配比决定了乐器的声学特性。
works.idea_en: Tune sound by choosing which animal's fibre to use.
works.idea_zh: 通过选择哪种动物的纤维来调校声音。
works.method: Silk fibre layers are laminated with resin in varying ratios to tune stiffness and damping.
works.method_zh: 按不同比例把丝纤维层与树脂层压，调节刚度和阻尼。

works.title: Bacterial Dye – the Pigment of the Future
works.description: Textiles dyed directly by pigment-producing bacteria, developed with DTU laboratories and Gabriel Textile, reaching bright colours with little water and no toxic chemicals.
works.description_zh: 由产色素细菌直接染色的纺织品，与丹麦技术大学实验室和 Gabriel Textile 合作开发，用水少、无有毒化学品也能获得鲜艳色彩。
works.idea_en: Bacterial dyeing can be scaled for industry.
works.idea_zh: 细菌染色可以扩大到工业规模。
works.method: Fabric is inoculated with pigment bacteria and incubated; process parameters are tuned for scale.
works.method_zh: 对布料接种产色素细菌并培养，调节工艺参数以便规模化。

works.title: Not a Matter of Taste
works.description: Edible bowls made by combining bacterially grown cellulose with pettu, a pine-inner-bark flour used in wartime Finland.
works.description_zh: 把细菌培养的纤维素与芬兰战时食用的松树内皮粉（pettu）结合，制成可食用的碗。
works.idea_en: Revive a neglected food as biodegradable tableware.
works.idea_zh: 把被遗忘的食物复兴为可降解餐具。
works.method: Bacterial cellulose sheets are moulded with pettu flour and dried into bowls.
works.method_zh: 把细菌纤维素片与松皮粉一起模塑，干燥成碗。

works.title: Leaves Biocoffin
works.description: A burial shroud-coffin of biodegradable, reclaimed materials whose rope is coated with a dye containing fungal spores that grow after burial to decompose the body and neutralise toxins.
works.description_zh: 一种由可降解回收材料制成的裹尸袋式棺，其绳索涂有含真菌孢子的染料；下葬后真菌生长，分解遗体并中和毒素。
works.idea_en: A funeral can be a collaboration with decomposer fungi.
works.idea_zh: 葬礼可以是与分解者真菌的合作。
works.method: Spore-laden dye is applied to the lattice rope; moisture in soil triggers fungal growth.
works.method_zh: 把含孢子的染料涂在网格绳上；土壤中的湿气触发真菌生长。

works.title: Coral Reef Rescuer
works.description: A manta-ray-like 'mother' robot with 'child' units that supports the regeneration of coral reefs damaged by overfishing, warming, acidification and pollution.
works.description_zh: 一个形似蝠鲼的“母”机器人和若干“子”单元，帮助受过度捕捞、升温、酸化和污染破坏的珊瑚礁再生。
works.idea_en: Robots can be designed as caretakers for reefs.
works.idea_zh: 机器人可以被设计成珊瑚礁的照料者。
works.method: The mother unit carries child robots that deploy coral fragments and monitor reef health.
works.method_zh: 母机携带子机器人，由它们投放珊瑚碎片并监测珊瑚礁健康。

works.title: Cactunes
works.description: Household cacti fitted with touch sensors and audio devices become musical instruments, challenging the reflex not to touch them.
works.description_zh: 装上触摸传感器和音频设备的家用仙人掌变成了乐器，挑战人们“别碰仙人掌”的本能。
works.idea_en: A plant you avoid touching can become an instrument you play.
works.idea_zh: 一株你避免触碰的植物，可以变成你演奏的乐器。
works.method: Capacitive sensing through the cactus spines triggers sounds from a speaker base.
works.method_zh: 通过仙人掌刺进行电容感应，触发底座扬声器发声。

works.title: Post/Biotics
works.description: A citizen-science toolkit and pop-up lab with which students test local plants and soils for antimicrobial compounds, proposing open-source antibiotic discovery.
works.description_zh: 一套公民科学工具包和快闪实验室，让学生检测本地植物和土壤中的抗菌物质，提出开源的抗生素发现方式。
works.idea_en: Antibiotic discovery can happen in classrooms, not only in pharma labs.
works.idea_zh: 抗生素发现可以发生在教室里，而不只在制药实验室中。
works.method: Soil and plant extracts are tested against harmless bacteria on agar plates; results are shared online.
works.method_zh: 在琼脂平板上用无害细菌测试土壤和植物提取物，结果在线共享。

works.title: Breaking the Wall of Lithium Recovery with Bacteria
works.description: An artistic research project in which extremophile bacteria from lithium-rich environments recover lithium from discarded batteries instead of it being extracted from Atacama salt flats.
works.description_zh: 一个艺术研究项目：用来自富锂环境的嗜极细菌从废旧电池中回收锂，而不是从阿塔卡马盐湖开采锂。
works.idea_en: Microbes could replace extraction with recovery.
works.idea_zh: 微生物可以用“回收”取代“开采”。
works.method: Fieldwork collects bacteria from salt flats; lab collaborations test bioleaching of battery waste; results are shown as installation.
works.method_zh: 田野工作从盐湖采集细菌，实验室合作测试对电池废料的生物浸出，成果以装置形式展出。
keywords: Falling Walls Art & Science Breakthrough of the Year 2026

works.title: liquid strata
works.description: Installations that use machine learning on scientific datasets to make tangible interfaces to little-known deep-sea phenomena such as marine snow.
works.description_zh: 一组装置，利用机器学习处理科学数据集，为海洋雪等鲜为人知的深海现象打造可触摸的界面。
works.idea_en: Make overlooked deep-sea life perceptible without pretending to represent it fully.
works.idea_zh: 让被忽视的深海生命变得可感知，而不假装能完全再现它。
works.method: Models trained on oceanographic imagery and data generate forms shown in physical, interactive displays.
works.method_zh: 用海洋学图像和数据训练模型，生成的形态在实体互动装置中呈现。

works.title: Echoes of the Abyss
works.description: Research into chemical munitions dumped on the Baltic and Adriatic seabeds, developed aboard the TARA research vessel and turned into immersive sound and installation work.
works.description_zh: 一项关于倾倒在波罗的海和亚得里亚海海床上的化学弹药的研究，在 TARA 科考船上展开，并转化为沉浸式声音与装置作品。
works.idea_en: Bring the hidden toxic legacy for marine life into public perception.
works.idea_zh: 让海洋生物所承受的隐秘毒性遗产进入公众感知。
works.method: Hydrophone recordings, sediment data and archival research are composed into spatial sound installations.
works.method_zh: 把水听器录音、沉积物数据和档案研究组合成空间声音装置。

works.title: Ouroboros (algae bioplastic LP records)
works.description: Circular LP records pressed from algae-based bioplastic, with Kat Austen's album about the Lusatia coal region as prototype; the research covers material, manufacture and sound.
works.description_zh: 用藻类生物塑料压制的循环黑胶唱片，以 Kat Austen 关于卢萨蒂亚煤矿区的专辑为原型；研究涵盖材料、制造和声音美学。
works.idea_en: A music medium can be grown instead of made from oil.
works.idea_zh: 音乐载体可以“长”出来，而不是用石油制成。
works.method: Algae-derived bioplastic is formulated for record pressing and tested for groove fidelity.
works.method_zh: 配制适合唱片压制的藻类生物塑料，并测试音槽还原度。

works.title: Stranger to the Trees
works.description: Birch trees were grown in soil laced with microplastics and their physiological responses translated into sound and sculpture, examining pollution from the trees' perspective.
works.description_zh: 在混有微塑料的土壤中种植桦树，把树木的生理反应转化为声音和雕塑，从树的视角审视污染。
works.idea_en: Listen to how trees experience our plastics.
works.idea_zh: 倾听树如何经历我们的塑料。
works.method: Sensors track sap flow and other physiology; data drive a sound composition and sculptural forms.
works.method_zh: 传感器追踪树液流动等生理数据，用来驱动声音作品和雕塑形态。

works.title: Ocular Germination
works.description: The artist germinates Begonia seeds with her own basal tears, turning her body into an ecosystem that merges human and botanical realms.
works.description_zh: 艺术家用自己的基础泪液让秋海棠种子发芽，把自己的身体变成融合人类与植物领域的生态系统。
works.idea_en: The human body can be a habitat for plant life.
works.idea_zh: 人的身体可以是植物生命的栖息地。
works.method: Tears are collected and used as the germination medium for seeds in the studio.
works.method_zh: 收集泪液，作为工作室中种子的发芽介质。

works.title: Hybrid
works.description: A documentary artwork on xenotransplantation research in which pigs are gene-edited with CRISPR to become organ donors for humans, taking viewers into the lab and to the animals.
works.description_zh: 一件关于异种器官移植研究的纪实艺术作品：猪被 CRISPR 基因编辑，成为人类的器官供体；作品把观众带进实验室、带到这些动物身边。
works.idea_en: Interspecies genetic engineering needs public debate that includes the animals.
works.idea_zh: 跨物种基因工程需要一场把动物也纳入其中的公共讨论。
works.method: Film and installation based on access to xenotransplant labs and interviews with scientists.
works.method_zh: 基于进入异种移植实验室的拍摄和对科学家的访谈，制作影片与装置。

works.title: E.glowli
works.description: A set of BioBricks enabling bioluminescence in E. coli in many colours, for biosensor reporters and as light sources, shown in a bacterial 'bubble lamp' and photos lit only by bacteria.
works.description_zh: 一组让大肠杆菌发出多种颜色生物光的 BioBrick，可作生物传感报告基因或光源，并以细菌“泡泡灯”和仅由细菌照明的照片展示。
works.idea_en: Engineered microbes can be a designed light source.
works.idea_zh: 工程微生物可以是一种被设计出来的光源。
works.method: Luciferase genes from fireflies and bacteria were standardised and tuned for different colours.
works.method_zh: 把萤火虫和细菌的荧光素酶基因标准化，并调校出不同颜色。

works.title: iGarden
works.description: A BioBrick toolkit for engineering garden plants via Agrobacterium, with a 'genetic fence' against gene spread and parts for new flavours, allergen knockdown and petal colour.
works.description_zh: 一套通过农杆菌改造园艺植物的 BioBrick 工具包，包含防止基因扩散的“基因围栏”，以及用于新风味、降低过敏原和改变花瓣颜色的元件。
works.idea_en: Imagine synthetic biology as home gardening.
works.idea_zh: 把合成生物学想象成家庭园艺。
works.method: Plant expression parts were built for Arabidopsis and strawberry with containment logic.
works.method_zh: 为拟南芥和草莓构建带有防扩散逻辑的植物表达元件。

works.title: E. coli pen
works.description: A pen that uses no ink but a medium of genetically modified E. coli expressing more than four colours at various intensities from a single culture, presented as a tool for art.
works.description_zh: 一支不用墨水的笔，笔中是转基因大肠杆菌培养液，一种培养物就能以不同强度表达四种以上颜色，被视为艺术创作工具。
works.idea_en: Draw with living colour.
works.idea_zh: 用活的颜色作画。
works.method: Coloured protein genes under tunable promoters let one strain produce several hues.
works.method_zh: 在可调启动子下表达有色蛋白基因，让一个菌株产生多种色调。

works.title: AuxIn
works.description: Engineered E. coli that swim toward plant roots, secrete the hormone auxin to boost root growth against soil erosion, and carry a containment module.
works.description_zh: 工程大肠杆菌会游向植物根系，分泌生长素促进根系生长以对抗水土流失，并带有防扩散模块。
works.idea_en: Design a microbe as a gardener for eroding soil.
works.idea_zh: 把微生物设计成守护流失土壤的园丁。
works.method: Three modules: Phyto-Route (chemotaxis to roots), Auxin Xpress (auxin synthesis) and Gene Guard (containment).
works.method_zh: 三个模块：Phyto-Route（向根趋化）、Auxin Xpress（合成生长素）和 Gene Guard（防扩散）。

works.title: Aseatobacter
works.description: Work with the cellulose-making bacterium Acetobacter xylinum aiming to engineer grown material with colour, strength and water resistance, including designs for a bacterial-cellulose chair.
works.description_zh: 利用产纤维素细菌木醋杆菌（Acetobacter xylinum），尝试让生长出的材料带有颜色、更高强度和疏水性，并设计了一把细菌纤维素椅子。
works.idea_en: Engineer the organism to build material properties in, not add them later.
works.idea_zh: 改造生物，让材料性能“长”在里面，而不是事后添加。
works.method: Genetic parts for pigment and binding proteins were planned for the cellulose producer.
works.method_zh: 为产纤维素菌规划了色素和结合蛋白的基因元件。

works.title: Plastic Republic
works.description: A proposal to engineer marine bacteria with stronger adhesion so their biofilms gather ocean microplastics into 'plastic islands', with a design fiction selling them as new land.
works.description_zh: 一个提案：改造海洋细菌使其黏附性更强，让生物膜把海洋微塑料聚集成“塑料岛”；配套的设计虚构把这些岛当作新土地出售。
works.idea_en: A cleanup idea can also be a satire of land and ownership.
works.idea_zh: 一个清理方案也可以是对土地与所有权的讽刺。
works.method: Roseobacter and E. coli adhesion genes were proposed to aggregate particles into biofilm rafts.
works.method_zh: 提出利用玫瑰杆菌和大肠杆菌的黏附基因，把颗粒聚集成生物膜筏。

works.title: Organofoam
works.description: Inspired by Ecovative's mycelium packaging, a standardised toolkit for genetically engineering lignin-degrading fungi, for example to protect mycelium materials from mould.
works.description_zh: 受 Ecovative 菌丝体包装启发，开发了一套对木质素降解真菌进行基因工程改造的标准化工具包，例如保护菌丝体材料免受霉菌污染。
works.idea_en: Genetic tools can extend what grown materials can do.
works.idea_zh: 基因工具可以拓展“长”出来的材料的能力。
works.method: Transformation vectors and parts were built for basidiomycete fungi used in mycelium composites.
works.method_zh: 为菌丝体复合材料所用的担子菌构建了转化载体和元件。

works.title: Aqualose
works.description: Customisable ultrafiltration membranes made from bacterial cellulose for low-cost water purification, including cellulose production in E. coli and an art-and-design strand prototyping uses.
works.description_zh: 用细菌纤维素制作的可定制超滤膜，用于低成本净水，包括在大肠杆菌中实现纤维素生产，并设有艺术与设计小组为材料原型化应用。
works.idea_en: Grow a water filter with bacteria.
works.idea_zh: 用细菌“种”出净水滤膜。
works.method: Gluconacetobacter cellulose was functionalised with binding domains; E. coli was engineered to secrete cellulose.
works.method_zh: 给葡糖醋杆菌纤维素加上结合结构域进行功能化；改造大肠杆菌分泌纤维素。

works.title: The Smell of Us
works.description: A probiotic alternative to antibacterial deodorants, with a BioBrick smell library for mixing 'genetic perfumes' and a CRISPR method to isolate naturally odourless skin bacteria.
works.description_zh: 一种替代抗菌除臭剂的益生菌方案，包括用于调配“基因香水”的 BioBrick 气味库，以及用 CRISPR 分离天然无味皮肤细菌的方法。
works.idea_en: Body odour is designed by the skin microbiome, so design the microbiome.
works.idea_zh: 体味由皮肤微生物组塑造，那就设计微生物组。
works.method: Scent-pathway parts and CRISPR-based selection were built for skin commensals.
works.method_zh: 为皮肤共生菌构建了气味通路元件和基于 CRISPR 的筛选方法。

works.title: KADO (Angle)
works.description: A woven sculpture made entirely of grasses, branches and reeds that the artist grows in his garden, stitched with thread; it keeps changing shape and colour as the plants dry.
works.description_zh: 一件完全由艺术家在自家花园种植的草、枝条和芦苇编织而成、以线缝合的雕塑；随着植物干燥，它的形状和颜色不断变化。
works.idea_en: Craft can begin by growing the material yourself.
works.idea_zh: 工艺可以从亲手种植材料开始。
works.method: Garden-grown plant stems are harvested, dried and stitched into an angular woven form.
works.method_zh: 收获花园里种的植物茎秆，干燥后缝编成有棱角的编织形体。

works.title: Tatami ReFab
works.description: A furniture collection 3D-printed from a composite of biodegradable resin and igusa rush grass, the plant used for tatami mats, reviving a vanishing tradition.
works.description_zh: 一套用可降解树脂与蔺草（榻榻米原料）复合材料 3D 打印的家具，复兴一项正在消失的传统。
works.idea_en: A traditional plant material can be reborn through digital fabrication.
works.idea_zh: 传统植物材料可以通过数字制造获得新生。
works.method: Igusa fibres are compounded with bio-resin and printed on a large-format printer (with ExtraBold).
works.method_zh: 把蔺草纤维与生物树脂混合，用大幅面打印机（与 ExtraBold 合作）打印。

works.title: Avocado Seed Brick
works.description: A brick made from discarded avocado seeds bound with a binder produced from Sargassum seaweed, combining two waste streams into a building material.
works.description_zh: 一种用废弃牛油果核和马尾藻制成的黏合剂结合而成的砖，把两种废物流变成建筑材料。
works.idea_en: Two nuisances can become one material.
works.idea_zh: 两种麻烦可以变成一种材料。
works.method: Ground avocado seed is bound with alginate-type binder from Sargassum and moulded.
works.method_zh: 把研磨的牛油果核与来自马尾藻的海藻酸盐类黏合剂结合并模压成形。

works.title: Plant and Algae T-Shirt
works.description: A T-shirt made from wood-pulp cellulose fibres and printed with algae-based ink, designed so the whole garment biodegrades in soil or compost.
works.description_zh: 一件用木浆纤维素纤维制成、以藻类墨水印花的 T 恤，整件衣服都能在土壤或堆肥中降解。
works.idea_en: Design clothing whose end of life is compost.
works.idea_zh: 设计一件生命终点是堆肥的衣服。
works.method: Eucalyptus/beech pulp fibres are knitted; algae grown in bioreactors are turned into ink for the print.
works.method_zh: 用桉树/山毛榉浆纤维针织；把在生物反应器中培养的藻类制成印花墨水。
